          · exact hs.2 u (by omega) hut
        have hmin := Nat.find_min' hex hp
        change s ≤ s - 1 at hmin
        omega
    have hfull : (I.executedDuring S s t).card = m * (t - s) :=
      I.executedDuring_card (fun u hu hut => I.full_of_many_alive hS hF (hs.2 u hu (by omega)))
    have hacc := I.backlog_accounting hS hst
    have harr := I.arrival_work_bound (a := s) (b := t) hO hL
    rw [hfull] at hacc
    have htL : t + L - s = t - s + L := by omega
    rw [htL] at harr
    have hm1 : m - 1 + 1 = m := by omega
    nlinarith

end Scheduling.Instance

decl_811.name: Scheduling.card_before_orderEmb
decl_811.label: card_before_orderEmb
decl_811.statement: ∀ {L : ℕ} (W : Finset (Fin L)) (q : Fin W.card), {i ∈ W | i < (W.orderEmbOfFin ⋯) q}.card = ↑q
decl_811.source:
theorem card_before_orderEmb {L : ℕ} (W : Finset (Fin L)) (q : Fin W.card) :
    (W.filter (fun i => i < W.orderEmbOfFin rfl q)).card = q.val := by
  let e := W.orderEmbOfFin rfl
  have he : W.filter (fun i => i < e q) = (Iio q).image e := by
    ext i
    constructor
    · intro hi
      obtain ⟨hiW, hiq⟩ := mem_filter.mp hi
      let p := (W.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨i, hiW⟩
      have hp : e p = i := congrArg Subtype.val ((W.orderIsoOfFin rfl).apply_symm_apply ⟨i, hiW⟩)
      refine mem_image.mpr ⟨p, mem_Iio.mpr ?_, hp⟩
      exact e.lt_iff_lt.mp (by rwa [hp])
    · rintro hi
      obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hi
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨W.orderEmbOfFin_mem rfl p, e.strictMono (mem_Iio.mp hp)⟩
  change (W.filter (fun i => i < e q)).card = q.val
  rw [he, card_image_of_injective _ e.injective, Fin.card_Iio]

/-- The layer order of each job has equally many wide and narrow layers,
and no prefix has more narrow layers than wide layers. -/

decl_14.name: Scheduling.BalancedLayers
decl_14.label: BalancedLayers
decl_14.source:
structure BalancedLayers (jobs L : ℕ) where
  wide : Fin jobs → Finset (Fin L)
  half : ∀ j, 2 * (wide j).card = L
  balanced_prefix : ∀ j (i : Fin L), i.val ≤ 2 * ((wide j).filter (fun w => w < i)).card

namespace BalancedLayers
variable {jobs L : ℕ} (F : BalancedLayers jobs L)

decl_20.name: Scheduling.BalancedLayers.wide_early
decl_20.label: BalancedLayers.wide_early
decl_20.statement:
∀ {jobs L : ℕ} (F : Scheduling.BalancedLayers jobs L) (j : Fin jobs) (q : Fin (F.wide j).card),
  ↑(((F.wide j).orderEmbOfFin ⋯) q) ≤ 2 * ↑q
decl_20.source:
theorem wide_early (j : Fin jobs) (q : Fin (F.wide j).card) :
    ((F.wide j).orderEmbOfFin rfl q).val ≤ 2 * q.val := by
  have h := F.balanced_prefix j ((F.wide j).orderEmbOfFin rfl q)
  rwa [card_before_orderEmb] at h

/-- Each wide layer contributes `2(m-1)` leaves, listed in layer order. -/

decl_16.name: Scheduling.BalancedLayers.leafGroup
decl_16.label: BalancedLayers.leafGroup
decl_16.statement:
{jobs L : ℕ} →
  (F : Scheduling.BalancedLayers jobs L) →
    {m : ℕ} → 2 ≤ m → (j : Fin jobs) → (k : Fin (m * L)) → L ≤ ↑k → Fin (F.wide j).card
decl_16.source:
def leafGroup {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (j : Fin jobs) (k : Fin (m * L))
    (hk : L ≤ k.val) : Fin (F.wide j).card :=
  ⟨(k.val - L) / (2 * (m - 1)), by
    have hp : 0 < 2 * (m - 1) := by omega
    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hp).mpr
    have hh := F.half j
    have hm1 : m - 1 + 1 = m := by omega
    have he : k.val - L + L = k.val := Nat.sub_add_cancel hk
    have hlt := k.isLt
    nlinarith⟩

decl_15.name: Scheduling.BalancedLayers.forest
decl_15.label: BalancedLayers.forest
decl_15.statement: {jobs L : ℕ} → Scheduling.BalancedLayers jobs L → {m : ℕ} → 2 ≤ m → 0 < L → Scheduling.LayeredForest jobs (m * L)
decl_15.source:
def forest {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) : LayeredForest jobs (m * L) where
  depth _ := L
  depth_pos _ := hL
  depth_le _ := by nlinarith
  leafLevel j k := if hk : k.val < L then ⟨0, hL⟩ else
    (F.wide j).orderEmbOfFin rfl (F.leafGroup hm j k (by omega))

decl_17.name: Scheduling.BalancedLayers.leaf_level_bound
decl_17.label: BalancedLayers.leaf_level_bound
decl_17.statement:
∀ {jobs L : ℕ} (F : Scheduling.BalancedLayers jobs L) {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (j : Fin jobs)
  (k : Fin (m * L)), L ≤ ↑k → (F.forest hm hL).level j k * (m - 1) ≤ ↑k - L
decl_17.source:
theorem leaf_level_bound {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L)
    (j : Fin jobs) (k : Fin (m * L)) (hk : L ≤ k.val) :
    (F.forest hm hL).level j k * (m - 1) ≤ k.val - L := by
  have hn : ¬ k.val < L := by omega
  have he := F.wide_early j (F.leafGroup hm j k hk)
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (m - 1) he
  have hdiv := Nat.div_mul_le_self (k.val - L) (2 * (m - 1))
  dsimp [LayeredForest.level, forest]
  rw [if_neg hn, dif_neg hn]
  change ((F.wide j).orderEmbOfFin rfl (F.leafGroup hm j k hk)).val * (m - 1) ≤ k.val - L
  dsimp [leafGroup] at hmul ⊢
  nlinarith

decl_18.name: Scheduling.BalancedLayers.offline_schedule
decl_18.label: BalancedLayers.offline_schedule
decl_18.statement:
∀ {jobs L : ℕ} (F : Scheduling.BalancedLayers jobs L) {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L),
  ∃ O, ((F.forest hm hL).toInstance L).Valid m O ∧ ((F.forest hm hL).toInstance L).FlowBound O L
decl_18.source:
theorem offline_schedule {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) :
    ∃ O, ((F.forest hm hL).toInstance L).Valid m O ∧
      ((F.forest hm hL).toInstance L).FlowBound O L := by
  let G := F.forest hm hL
  let I := G.toInstance L
  let pos := fun v : Fin (jobs * (m * L)) => (LayeredForest.position v).val
  have hpos : ∀ v, pos v < m * L := fun v => (LayeredForest.position v).isLt
  refine ⟨fun v => batchedTime m L (I.owner v).val (pos v), ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply I.batched_valid hm pos hpos LayeredForest.coordinates_injective (by intros; rfl)
    intro u v huv
    have hk := G.edge_from_key L huv
    have he := huv.2
    change (LayeredForest.position u).val + 1 =
      G.level (LayeredForest.job v) (LayeredForest.position v) at he
    refine ⟨hk.1, ?_⟩
    by_cases hv : pos v < L
    · simpa only [if_pos hv] using hk.2
    · rw [if_neg hv]
      change ((LayeredForest.position u).val + 1) * (m - 1) ≤
        (LayeredForest.position v).val - L
      rw [he]
      exact F.leaf_level_bound hm hL _ _ (Nat.le_of_not_gt hv)
  · exact I.batched_flowBound hm pos hpos (by intros; rfl)

/-- The optimum is exactly the release spacing, as required by batched
arrivals. The lower bound follows from the exact `mL` work in each job. -/

decl_19.name: Scheduling.BalancedLayers.optimum_eq
decl_19.label: BalancedLayers.optimum_eq
decl_19.statement:
∀ {jobs L : ℕ} (F : Scheduling.BalancedLayers jobs L) {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L),
  0 < jobs → ((F.forest hm hL).toInstance L).optimum m ⋯ = L
decl_19.source:
theorem optimum_eq {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (hj : 0 < jobs) :
    ((F.forest hm hL).toInstance L).optimum m (by omega) = L := by
  let G := F.forest hm hL
  let I := G.toInstance L
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by omega
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hflow⟩ := F.offline_schedule hm hL
  apply Nat.le_antisymm (I.optimum_le hm0 hO hflow)
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hp⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm0
  have hwork := I.job_work_bound hP hp ⟨0, hj⟩
  rw [G.jobVertices_card] at hwork
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hwork hm0

end BalancedLayers
end Scheduling

decl_280.name: Scheduling.Instance.batchRemaining
decl_280.label: Instance.batchRemaining
decl_280.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → ℕ → Finset (Fin vertices)
decl_280.source:
noncomputable def batchRemaining (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (r t : ℕ) :
    Finset (Fin vertices) := univ.filter (fun v => I.release (I.owner v) = r ∧ t ≤ S v)

/-- Lemma 17: residual work of jobs sharing release r fits into the last
L-z slots of an offline schedule, where z counts prefix-idle slots under FIFO.
This result does not require the other arrivals to be batched. -/

decl_282.name: Scheduling.Instance.batch_remaining_work_bound
decl_282.label: Instance.batch_remaining_work_bound
decl_282.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L r t : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    I.IsFIFO m S →
      I.Valid m O → I.FlowBound O L → r ≤ t → (I.batchRemaining S r t).card ≤ m * (L - (I.partialSlots m S r t).card)
decl_282.source:
theorem batch_remaining_work_bound {m L r t : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    (hrt : r ≤ t) :
    (I.batchRemaining S r t).card ≤ m * (L - (I.partialSlots m S r t).card) := by
  classical
  have h := card_le_slots O m (r + (I.partialSlots m S r t).card) (r + L)
    (I.batchRemaining S r t) hO.capacity (by
      intro v hv
      have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      have hp := I.partial_progress hS hF hO (I.owner v) t (by rw [hv'.1]; exact hrt) v rfl hv'.2
      have hb := hL v
      rw [hv'.1] at hp hb
      exact ⟨hp, hb⟩)
  have heq : r + L - (r + (I.partialSlots m S r t).card) =
      L - (I.partialSlots m S r t).card := by omega
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

decl_281.name: Scheduling.Instance.batch_prefix_idle_lt
decl_281.label: Instance.batch_prefix_idle_lt
decl_281.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L r t : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    I.IsFIFO m S →
      I.Valid m O → I.FlowBound O L → r ≤ t → (I.batchRemaining S r t).Nonempty → (I.partialSlots m S r t).card < L
decl_281.source:
theorem batch_prefix_idle_lt {m L r t : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    (hrt : r ≤ t) (hu : (I.batchRemaining S r t).Nonempty) :
    (I.partialSlots m S r t).card < L := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hu
  have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  have h := I.partial_slots_lt hS hF hO hL (I.owner v) (by rw [hv'.1]; exact hrt) ⟨v, rfl, hv'.2⟩
  simpa [hv'.1] using h

end Scheduling.Instance

namespace Scheduling.Accounting
open Finset

/-- Integer record inequalities force exponential growth of the prefix-idle
counts. Indices run from newest to oldest, reversing the order in Lemma 18. -/

decl_8.name: Scheduling.Accounting.geometric_record_sum
decl_8.label: Accounting.geometric_record_sum
decl_8.statement: ∀ (z : ℕ → ℕ) (q : ℕ), (∀ i < q, 1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, z j ≤ z i) → 2 ^ q ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range q, z i
decl_8.source:
theorem geometric_record_sum (z : ℕ → ℕ) (q : ℕ)
    (hz : ∀ i < q, 1 + ∑ j ∈ range i, z j ≤ z i) :
    2 ^ q ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ range q, z i := by
  induction q with
  | zero => simp
  | succ q ih =>
    have hp := ih (by intro i hi; exact hz i (by omega))
    have hq := hz q (by omega)
    rw [sum_range_succ, pow_succ]
    omega

decl_7.name: Scheduling.Accounting.geometric_record_oldest
decl_7.label: Accounting.geometric_record_oldest
decl_7.statement: ∀ (z : ℕ → ℕ) {q L : ℕ}, 0 < q → (∀ i < q, 1 + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, z j ≤ z i) → z (q - 1) < L → 2 ^ (q - 1) < L
decl_7.source:
theorem geometric_record_oldest (z : ℕ → ℕ) {q L : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hz : ∀ i < q, 1 + ∑ j ∈ range i, z j ≤ z i)
    (hL : z (q - 1) < L) : 2 ^ (q - 1) < L := by
  have hsum := geometric_record_sum z (q - 1) (by intro i hi; exact hz i (by omega))
  have hlast := hz (q - 1) (by omega)
  omega

end Scheduling.Accounting

decl_91.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.offline_schedule
decl_91.label: BatchedAdversary.offline_schedule
decl_91.statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L),
  2 * (L / 2) = L →
    ∀ (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
      {Q : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)},
      Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun ⋯ A L (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
          (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.initial jobs m L hm) Q records →
        ∃ O, (Q.toInstance L ⋯).Valid m O ∧ (Q.toInstance L ⋯).FlowBound O L
decl_91.source:
theorem offline_schedule (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records) :
    ∃ O, (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).Valid m O ∧
      (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).FlowBound O L := by
  let hw : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL
  let I := Q.toInstance L hw
  obtain ⟨staticRule, hr⟩ := h.flexible.recorded
  have hcard : ∀ j, (recordedKeys records j).card = L := by
    intro j
    rw [hr.keys_card]
    exact final_job_length hm hL heven A h j
  have hparent : ∀ u v, I.edge u v → Q.parent (job v) (position v) = some (position u) := by
    intro u v he
    have hpos : (position v).val < Q.boundary (job v) := by
      have hlt := (position v).isLt
      simp only [boundary, hr.completion.finished]
      omega
    have hp := he.2
    rwa [if_pos hpos] at hp
  have hsource : ∀ u v, I.edge u v → position u ∈ recordedKeys records (job v) := by
    intro u v he
    rcases hr.parent_origins _ _ _ (hparent u v he) with hnone | ⟨r, hr', ho, hk⟩
    · simp [initial] at hnone
    · exact mem_image.mpr ⟨r, List.mem_toFinset.mpr
        (List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hr', decide_eq_true ho⟩), hk⟩
  let pos := fun v : Fin (jobs * (m * L)) => keyFirstPosition (recordedKeys records (job v)) (position v)
  have hpos : ∀ v, pos v < m * L := fun v => keyFirstPosition_lt _ _
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun v => (I.owner v, pos v)) := by
    intro u v he
    have ho : job u = job v := congrArg (fun p : Fin jobs × ℕ => p.1) he
    have hp : pos u = pos v := congrArg (fun p : Fin jobs × ℕ => p.2) he
    dsimp only [pos] at hp
    rw [ho] at hp
    have hv := keyFirstPosition_injective (recordedKeys records (job v)) hp
    exact LayeredForest.coordinates_injective (Prod.ext ho (congrArg Fin.val hv))
  have hedge : ∀ u v, I.edge u v → pos u < L ∧
      (if pos v < L then pos u < pos v else (pos u + 1) * (m - 1) ≤ pos v - L) := by
    intro u v he
    have ho : job u = job v := he.1
    have hu := hsource u v he
    have hup : pos u < L := by
      dsimp only [pos]
      rw [ho]
      exact (keyFirstPosition_key_lt _ _ hu).trans_eq (hcard (job v))
    refine ⟨hup, ?_⟩
    by_cases hv : pos v < L
    · rw [if_pos hv]
      dsimp only [pos]
      rw [ho]
      exact keyFirstPosition_edge _ hu (I.rank_increases he)
    · rw [if_neg hv]
      have hvkey : position v ∉ recordedKeys records (job v) := by
        intro hh
        have hb := keyFirstPosition_key_lt _ _ hh
        rw [hcard] at hb
        exact hv hb
      have hcut := history_parent_cut hm hL heven A h (initial_budget hm hL heven)
        (by simp) (job v) (position v) (position u) (hparent u v he)
      simp only [List.nil_append] at hcut
      rcases hcut with hnone | ⟨p, n, hpu, hpv, hwork, hkeys⟩
      · simp [initial] at hnone
      · dsimp only [pos]
        rw [ho]
        simpa only [hcard] using
          keyFirstPosition_leaf_after_cut (by omega : 0 < m) _ _ _ hu hvkey hpu hpv hwork hkeys
  refine ⟨fun v => batchedTime m L (I.owner v).val (pos v), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact I.batched_valid hm pos hpos hinj (by intros; rfl) hedge
  · exact I.batched_flowBound hm pos hpos (by intros; rfl)

decl_92.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.optimum_eq
decl_92.label:
Batched exact optimum
OPT = L
decl_92.statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L),
  2 * (L / 2) = L →
    0 < jobs →
      ∀ (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
        {Q : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)},
        Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun ⋯ A L (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
            (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.initial jobs m L hm) Q records →
          (Q.toInstance L ⋯).optimum m ⋯ = L
decl_92.source:
theorem optimum_eq (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (hj : 0 < jobs) (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))} {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records) :
    (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).optimum m (by omega) = L := by
  let I := Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by omega
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hflow⟩ := offline_schedule hm hL heven A h
  apply Nat.le_antisymm (I.optimum_le hm0 hO hflow)
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hp⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm0
  have hwork := I.job_work_bound hP hp ⟨0, hj⟩
  rw [Q.jobVertices_card] at hwork
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hwork hm0

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

decl_80.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.jobWideService_mono_start
decl_80.label: BatchedAdversary.jobWideService_mono_start
decl_80.statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (records : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs) (S : Scheduling.Assignment)
  {a u b : ℕ},
  a ≤ u →
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.jobWideService m records j S u b ≤
      Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.jobWideService m records j S a b
decl_80.source:
theorem jobWideService_mono_start (m : ℕ) (records : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) {a u b : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ u) :
    jobWideService m records j S u b ≤ jobWideService m records j S a b := by
  apply card_le_card
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨hw, hlo, hhi⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hw, ha.trans hlo, hhi⟩

decl_103.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideService_eq_sum_jobs
decl_103.label: BatchedAdversary.wideService_eq_sum_jobs
decl_103.statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (records : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (a b : ℕ)
  (J : Finset (Fin jobs)),
  (∀ (v : Fin (jobs * work)),
      Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded m records (Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v) v →
        a ≤ S v → S v < b → Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v ∈ J) →
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideService m records S a b =
      ∑ j ∈ J, Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.jobWideService m records j S a b
decl_103.source:
theorem wideService_eq_sum_jobs (m : ℕ) (records : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (a b : ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin jobs))
    (howners : ∀ v, WideRecorded m records (job v) v → a ≤ S v → S v < b → job v ∈ J) :
    wideService m records S a b = ∑ j ∈ J, jobWideService m records j S a b := by
  unfold wideService
  rw [card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := job) (fun v hv =>
    howners v (mem_filter.mp hv).2.1 (mem_filter.mp hv).2.2.1 (mem_filter.mp hv).2.2.2)]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  unfold jobWideService
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hw, ht⟩, ho⟩
    rw [ho] at hw
    exact ⟨hw, ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨hw, ht⟩
    exact ⟨⟨by simpa only [hw.1] using hw, ht⟩, hw.1⟩

/-- Per-job cutoffs and the full-slot lower bound imply the aggregate
recurrence after sorting the cutoffs of jobs that can execute this epoch. -/

decl_42.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.cutoffs_passivity
decl_42.label: BatchedAdversary.cutoffs_passivity
decl_42.statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ} (records : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (i c : ℕ)
  (J : Finset (Fin jobs)) (T : Fin jobs → ℕ),
  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.JobCutoffs m L records S i T →
    J.card ≤ c →
      (∀ (v : Fin (jobs * (m * L))),
          Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded m records (Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v) v →
            i * L ≤ S v → S v < (i + 1) * L → Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v ∈ J) →
        (∀ (u : ℕ),
            i * L ≤ u →
              u ≤ (i + 1) * L →
                (m - c) * ((i + 1) * L - u) ≤ Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideService m records S u ((i + 1) * L)) →
          ∃ ds, ds.length ≤ c ∧ Scheduling.BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds m c (L :: ds)
decl_42.source:
theorem cutoffs_passivity (records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))) (i c : ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin jobs))
    (T : Fin jobs → ℕ) (hcut : JobCutoffs m L records S i T) (hcard : J.card ≤ c)
    (howners : ∀ v, WideRecorded m records (job v) v → i * L ≤ S v →
      S v < (i + 1) * L → job v ∈ J)
    (hlower : ∀ u, i * L ≤ u → u ≤ (i + 1) * L →
      (m - c) * ((i + 1) * L - u) ≤ wideService m records S u ((i + 1) * L)) :
    ∃ ds : List ℕ, ds.length ≤ c ∧ BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds m c (L :: ds) := by
  let xs := J.toList.mergeSort (fun x y => decide (T x ≤ T y))
  have hp : xs.Perm J.toList := List.mergeSort_perm _ _
  have hlen : xs.length ≤ c := by
    rw [hp.length_eq, Finset.length_toList]
    exact hcard
  have hsort : xs.Pairwise (fun x y => T x ≤ T y) := by
    simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using
      (List.pairwise_mergeSort (le := fun x y : Fin jobs => decide (T x ≤ T y))
        (by intro x y z hxy hyz; simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at *; omega)
        (by intro x y; simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]; omega) J.toList)
  have hsum : ∀ u, i * L ≤ u → (xs.map (fun j => jobWideService m records j S u ((i + 1) * L))).sum =
      wideService m records S u ((i + 1) * L) := by
    intro u hu
    rw [(hp.map _).sum_eq, Finset.sum_map_toList]
    symm
    exact wideService_eq_sum_jobs m records S u ((i + 1) * L) J
      (fun v hw hvlo hvhi => howners v hw (hu.trans hvlo) hvhi)
  have hb := BatchedForcing.sorted_cutoffs_passivity m c (i * L) ((i + 1) * L) xs T
    (fun j u => jobWideService m records j S u ((i + 1) * L)) hlen hsort
    (fun j _ => ⟨(hcut j).1, (hcut j).2.1⟩)
    (by intro u hlo hhi; rw [hsum u hlo]; exact hlower u hlo hhi)
    (by
      intro j _ u hlo _
      have hh := (jobWideService_mono_start m records j S hlo).trans (hcut j).2.2.1
      have hx := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * m - 1)
        (show (i + 1) * L - T j + 1 ≤ (i + 1) * L - T j + 2 by omega)
      exact hh.trans hx)
    (fun j _ u hu => (hcut j).2.2.2 u hu) (by nlinarith)
  have hlength : (i + 1) * L - i * L = L := by
    rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  exact ⟨xs.map (fun j => (i + 1) * L - T j), by simpa only [List.length_map] using hlen,
    by simpa only [hlength] using hb⟩

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

decl_73.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.idleEarlier_mono_same_epoch
decl_73.label: BatchedAdversary.idleEarlier_mono_same_epoch
decl_73.statement:
∀ {jobs work m L : ℕ} (S : Scheduling.Assignment) {e u : ℕ},
  e ≤ u →
    e / L = u / L → Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.IdleEarlier m L S e → Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.IdleEarlier m L S u
decl_73.source:
theorem idleEarlier_mono_same_epoch (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work))
    {e u : ℕ} (heu : e ≤ u) (hepoch : e / L = u / L)
    (h : IdleEarlier m L S e) : IdleEarlier m L S u := by
  obtain ⟨t, hlo, hhi, hc⟩ := h
  exact ⟨t, by rwa [← hepoch], hhi.trans_le heu, hc⟩

decl_56.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth_wide_implies_choose
decl_56.label: BatchedAdversary.finalWidth_wide_implies_choose
decl_56.statement:
∀ {jobs work m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    ∀ (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs) (p : ℕ) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (t : ℕ),
      Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth m L history j p S t = 2 * m - 1 →
        Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.ChooseWide m L history j S t
decl_56.source:
theorem finalWidth_wide_implies_choose (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs) (p : ℕ)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (t : ℕ)
    (hw : finalWidth m L history j p S t = 2 * m - 1) :
    ChooseWide m L history j S t := by
  by_contra hn
  simp only [finalWidth, if_neg hn] at hw
  have hh := min_le_right (work - p) 1
  omega

/-- With unspent wide-layer budget, a full wide layer fits in the
remaining work. Thus truncation cannot turn a wide choice into a narrow
layer. -/

decl_54.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth_narrow_implies_not_choose
decl_54.label: BatchedAdversary.finalWidth_narrow_implies_not_choose
decl_54.statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    2 * (L / 2) = L →
      ∀ (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (j : Fin jobs) (p : ℕ) (S : Scheduling.Assignment)
        (t : ℕ),
        Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j ≤ Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j →
          p =
              (2 * m - 1) * Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j +
                Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j →
            Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth m L history j p S t = 1 →
              ¬Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.ChooseWide m L history j S t
decl_54.source:
theorem finalWidth_narrow_implies_not_choose (hm : 2 ≤ m) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (j : Fin jobs) (p : ℕ)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))) (t : ℕ)
    (hbalance : narrowCount history j ≤ wideCount m history j)
    (hprefix : p = (2 * m - 1) * wideCount m history j + narrowCount history j)
    (hn : finalWidth m L history j p S t = 1) :
    ¬ ChooseWide m L history j S t := by
  intro hc
  have htotal : (2 * m - 1) * (L / 2) + L / 2 = m * L := by
    have hb : 2 * m - 1 + 1 = 2 * m := by omega
    nlinarith
  have hw := hc.1
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * m - 1)
    (show wideCount m history j + 1 ≤ L / 2 by omega)
  have hfit : 2 * m - 1 ≤ m * L - p := by
    have hs : p + (2 * m - 1) ≤ m * L := by nlinarith
    omega
  simp only [finalWidth, if_pos hc, min_eq_right hfit] at hn
  omega

decl_55.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth_narrow_threshold
decl_55.label: BatchedAdversary.finalWidth_narrow_threshold
decl_55.statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    2 * (L / 2) = L →
      ∀ (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (j : Fin jobs) (p : ℕ) (S : Scheduling.Assignment)
        (t : ℕ),
        Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j ≤ Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j →
          p =
              (2 * m - 1) * Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j +
                Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j →
            Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j < L / 2 →
              Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth m L history j p S t = 1 →
                (2 * m - 1) * (L - t % L) ≤ Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S t
decl_55.source:
theorem finalWidth_narrow_threshold (hm : 2 ≤ m) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (j : Fin jobs) (p : ℕ)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))) (t : ℕ)
    (hbalance : narrowCount history j ≤ wideCount m history j)
    (hprefix : p = (2 * m - 1) * wideCount m history j + narrowCount history j)
    (hquota : wideCount m history j < L / 2)
    (hn : finalWidth m L history j p S t = 1) :
    (2 * m - 1) * (L - t % L) ≤ epochWideWork m L history j S t := by
  have hc := finalWidth_narrow_implies_not_choose hm heven history j p S t hbalance hprefix hn
  by_contra hh
  exact hc ⟨hquota, Or.inr (Or.inr (by omega))⟩

decl_57.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth_wide_threshold
decl_57.label: BatchedAdversary.finalWidth_wide_threshold
decl_57.statement:
∀ {jobs work m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    0 < L →
      ∀ (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs) (p : ℕ) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (t : ℕ),
        Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j ≤ Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j →
          Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit (2 * m - 1) (L - t % L)
              (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j) (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j)
              (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S t) →
            ¬Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.IdleEarlier m L S t →
              Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth m L history j p S t = 2 * m - 1 →
                Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S t < (2 * m - 1) * (L - t % L)
decl_57.source:
theorem finalWidth_wide_threshold (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L)
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs) (p : ℕ)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (t : ℕ)
    (hbalance : narrowCount history j ≤ wideCount m history j)
    (hcredit : BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit (2 * m - 1) (L - t % L)
      (wideCount m history j) (narrowCount history j) (epochWideWork m L history j S t))
    (hfull : ¬ IdleEarlier m L S t)
    (hw : finalWidth m L history j p S t = 2 * m - 1) :
    epochWideWork m L history j S t < (2 * m - 1) * (L - t % L) := by
  have hc := finalWidth_wide_implies_choose hm history j p S t hw
  apply hcredit.wide_below (by omega) (by have := Nat.mod_lt t hL; omega) hbalance
  rcases hc.2 with hg | hi | hx
  · exact Or.inl hg
  · exact False.elim (hfull hi)
  · exact Or.inr hx

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

decl_100.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideRecorded_append
decl_100.label: BatchedAdversary.wideRecorded_append
decl_100.statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (r : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)
  (j : Fin jobs) (v : Fin (jobs * work)),
  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded m (history ++ [r]) j v ↔
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded m history j v ∨
      Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v = j ∧
        r.owner = j ∧
          r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∧
            r.start ≤ ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) ∧ ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) < r.stop
decl_100.source:
theorem wideRecorded_append (m : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (r : LayerRecord jobs work) (j : Fin jobs) (v : Fin (jobs * work)) :
    WideRecorded m (history ++ [r]) j v ↔ WideRecorded m history j v ∨
      (job v = j ∧ r.owner = j ∧ r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∧
        r.start ≤ (position v).val ∧ (position v).val < r.stop) := by
  unfold WideRecorded
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ho, s, hs, hrest⟩
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hs with hs | hs
    · exact Or.inl ⟨ho, s, hs, hrest⟩
    · have he : s = r := List.mem_singleton.mp hs
      subst s
      exact Or.inr ⟨ho, hrest⟩
  · rintro (⟨ho, s, hs, hrest⟩ | ⟨ho, hrest⟩)
    · exact ⟨ho, s, List.mem_append_left _ hs, hrest⟩
    · exact ⟨ho, r, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_singleton_self r), hrest⟩

decl_98.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount_append
decl_98.label: BatchedAdversary.wideCount_append
decl_98.statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (r : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)
  (j : Fin jobs),
  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j =
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j + if r.owner = j ∧ r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 then 1 else 0
decl_98.source:
theorem wideCount_append (m : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (r : LayerRecord jobs work) (j : Fin jobs) :
    wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j = wideCount m history j +
      if r.owner = j ∧ r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 then 1 else 0 := by
  by_cases ho : r.owner = j <;> by_cases hw : r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 <;>
    simp [wideCount, List.filter_append, ho, hw]

decl_85.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount_append
decl_85.label: BatchedAdversary.narrowCount_append
decl_85.statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (r : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)
  (j : Fin jobs),
  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j =
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j + if r.owner = j ∧ r.stop - r.start = 1 then 1 else 0
decl_85.source:
theorem narrowCount_append (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (r : LayerRecord jobs work) (j : Fin jobs) :
    narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j = narrowCount history j +
      if r.owner = j ∧ r.stop - r.start = 1 then 1 else 0 := by
  by_cases ho : r.owner = j <;> by_cases hw : r.stop - r.start = 1 <;>
    simp [narrowCount, List.filter_append, ho, hw]

decl_93.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.owner_interval_card_le
decl_93.label: BatchedAdversary.owner_interval_card_le
decl_93.statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (j : Fin jobs) (a b : ℕ),
  {v |
        Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v = j ∧
          a ≤ ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) ∧ ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) < b}.card ≤
    b - a
decl_93.source:
theorem owner_interval_card_le (j : Fin jobs) (a b : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v : Fin (jobs * work) => job v = j ∧ a ≤ (position v).val ∧
      (position v).val < b)).card ≤ b - a := by
  have hc := card_le_card_of_injOn (fun v : Fin (jobs * work) => (position v).val)
    (s := univ.filter (fun v => job v = j ∧ a ≤ (position v).val ∧ (position v).val < b))
    (t := Ico a b) (by intro v hv; exact mem_Ico.mpr (mem_filter.mp hv).2.2) (by
      intro u hu v hv he
      exact LayeredForest.coordinates_injective (Prod.ext
        ((mem_filter.mp hu).2.1.trans (mem_filter.mp hv).2.1.symm) he))
  simpa only [Nat.card_Ico] using hc

decl_44.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork_append_le
decl_44.label: BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork_append_le
decl_44.statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (m L : ℕ) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (r : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)
  (j : Fin jobs) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (t : ℕ),
  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L (history ++ [r]) j S t ≤
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S t + (r.stop - r.start)
decl_44.source:
theorem epochWideWork_append_le (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (r : LayerRecord jobs work) (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (t : ℕ) :
    epochWideWork m L (history ++ [r]) j S t ≤ epochWideWork m L history j S t + (r.stop - r.start) := by
  let old := univ.filter (fun v => WideRecorded m history j v ∧ (t / L) * L ≤ S v ∧ S v < t)
  let layer := univ.filter (fun v : Fin (jobs * work) => job v = j ∧
    r.start ≤ (position v).val ∧ (position v).val < r.stop)
  have hs : univ.filter (fun v => WideRecorded m (history ++ [r]) j v ∧
      (t / L) * L ≤ S v ∧ S v < t) ⊆ old ∪ layer := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨hw, ht⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    rcases (wideRecorded_append m history r j v).mp hw with hw | hw
    · exact mem_union_left _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hw, ht⟩)
    · exact mem_union_right _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hw.1, hw.2.2.2⟩)
  have hc := (card_le_card hs).trans (card_union_le old layer)
  exact hc.trans (Nat.add_le_add_left (owner_interval_card_le j r.start r.stop) old.card)

decl_45.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork_append_unchanged
decl_45.label: BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork_append_unchanged
decl_45.statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (m L : ℕ) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (r : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)
  (j : Fin jobs) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (t : ℕ),
  r.owner ≠ j ∨ r.stop - r.start ≠ 2 * m - 1 →
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L (history ++ [r]) j S t =
      Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S t
decl_45.source:
theorem epochWideWork_append_unchanged (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (r : LayerRecord jobs work) (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (t : ℕ)
    (hr : r.owner ≠ j ∨ r.stop - r.start ≠ 2 * m - 1) :
    epochWideWork m L (history ++ [r]) j S t = epochWideWork m L history j S t := by
  unfold epochWideWork
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, wideRecorded_append]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hw | hw, ht⟩
    · exact ⟨hw, ht⟩
    · rcases hr with howner | hwidth
      · exact False.elim (howner hw.2.1)
      · exact False.elim (hwidth hw.2.2.1)
  · rintro ⟨hw, ht⟩; exact ⟨Or.inl hw, ht⟩

decl_47.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork_time_closed
decl_47.label: BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork_time_closed
decl_47.statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (m L : ℕ) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs)
  (S : Scheduling.Assignment) {t u : ℕ},
  t ≤ u →
    t / L = u / L →
      (∀ (v : Fin (jobs * work)), Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded m history j v → S v < t) →
        Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S u =
          Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S t
decl_47.source:
theorem epochWideWork_time_closed (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) {t u : ℕ}
    (htu : t ≤ u) (hepoch : t / L = u / L)
    (hclosed : ∀ v, WideRecorded m history j v → S v < t) :
    epochWideWork m L history j S u = epochWideWork m L history j S t := by
  unfold epochWideWork
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, hepoch]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hw, hlo, _⟩; exact ⟨hw, hlo, hclosed v hw⟩
  · rintro ⟨hw, hlo, hhi⟩; exact ⟨hw, hlo, hhi.trans_le htu⟩

decl_48.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork_zero_closed
decl_48.label: BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork_zero_closed
decl_48.statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (m L : ℕ) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs)
  (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (t : ℕ),
  (∀ (v : Fin (jobs * work)), Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded m history j v → S v < t / L * L) →
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S t = 0
decl_48.source:
theorem epochWideWork_zero_closed (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (t : ℕ)
    (hclosed : ∀ v, WideRecorded m history j v → S v < (t / L) * L) :
    epochWideWork m L history j S t = 0 := by
  unfold epochWideWork
  apply card_eq_zero.mpr
  apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro v hv
  have hh := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  have ht := hclosed v hh.1
  omega

decl_49.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epoch_start_after
decl_49.label: BatchedAdversary.epoch_start_after
decl_49.statement: ∀ {L t u : ℕ}, 0 < L → t ≤ u → t / L ≠ u / L → t ≤ u / L * L
decl_49.source:
theorem epoch_start_after {L t u : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (htu : t ≤ u) (hne : t / L ≠ u / L) :
    t ≤ (u / L) * L := by
  have hdiv : t / L ≤ u / L := Nat.div_le_div_right htu
  have hlt : t / L < u / L := by omega
  exact Nat.le_of_lt ((Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hL).mp hlt)

decl_94.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.remaining_epoch_strict
decl_94.label: BatchedAdversary.remaining_epoch_strict
decl_94.statement: ∀ {L t u : ℕ}, 0 < L → t < u → t / L = u / L → L - u % L < L - t % L
decl_94.source:
theorem remaining_epoch_strict {L t u : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (htu : t < u)
    (hepoch : t / L = u / L) :
    L - u % L < L - t % L := by
  have ht := Nat.div_add_mod t L
  have hu := Nat.div_add_mod u L
  rw [hepoch] at ht
  have hmt := Nat.mod_lt t hL
  have hmu := Nat.mod_lt u hL
  omega

/-- Completing a layer preserves threshold credit for the actual service
counter. When the completion enters a new epoch, all older completed
layers disappear from that counter. -/

decl_41.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.credit_after_record
decl_41.label: BatchedAdversary.credit_after_record
decl_41.statement:
∀ {jobs work m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    0 < L →
      ∀ (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (r : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work) (j : Fin jobs)
        (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (e u : ℕ),
        r.owner = j →
          e < u →
            r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∨ r.stop - r.start = 1 →
              Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j ≤ Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j →
                (∀ (v : Fin (jobs * work)), Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded m history j v → S v < e) →
                  (e / L = u / L →
                      Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit (2 * m - 1) (L - e % L)
                        (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j)
                        (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j)
                        (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S e)) →
                    (e / L = u / L →
                        r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 →
                          Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j ≤
                              Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j ∨
                            Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S e < (2 * m - 1) * (L - e % L)) →
                      (e / L = u / L →
                          r.stop - r.start = 1 →
                            (2 * m - 1) * (L - e % L) ≤ Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L history j S e) →
                        Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit (2 * m - 1) (L - u % L)
                          (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j)
                          (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j)
                          (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWork m L (history ++ [r]) j S u)
decl_41.source:
theorem credit_after_record (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L)
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (r : LayerRecord jobs work)
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (e u : ℕ)
    (ho : r.owner = j) (heu : e < u)
    (hshape : r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∨ r.stop - r.start = 1)
    (hbalance : narrowCount history j ≤ wideCount m history j)
    (hclosed : ∀ v, WideRecorded m history j v → S v < e)
    (hcredit : e / L = u / L → BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit (2 * m - 1) (L - e % L)
      (wideCount m history j) (narrowCount history j) (epochWideWork m L history j S e))
    (hwide : e / L = u / L → r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 →
      wideCount m history j ≤ narrowCount history j ∨
        epochWideWork m L history j S e < (2 * m - 1) * (L - e % L))
    (hnarrow : e / L = u / L → r.stop - r.start = 1 →
      (2 * m - 1) * (L - e % L) ≤ epochWideWork m L history j S e) :
    BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit (2 * m - 1) (L - u % L)
      (wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j) (narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j)
      (epochWideWork m L (history ++ [r]) j S u) := by
  have hb : 0 < 2 * m - 1 := by omega
  have hbne : 2 * m - 1 ≠ 1 := by omega
  have hd : 0 < L - e % L := by have := Nat.mod_lt e hL; omega
  rcases hshape with hw | hn
  · simp only [wideCount_append, narrowCount_append, ho, hw, hbne,
      and_self, if_true, and_false, if_false, Nat.add_zero]
    have hwork := epochWideWork_append_le m L history r j S u
    rw [hw] at hwork
    by_cases hepoch : e / L = u / L
    · rw [epochWideWork_time_closed m L history j S heu.le hepoch hclosed] at hwork
      exact (hcredit hepoch).wide_step hb hd hbalance (hwide hepoch hw) hwork
    · have hs := epoch_start_after hL heu.le hepoch
      have hz := epochWideWork_zero_closed m L history j S u
        (fun v hv => (hclosed v hv).trans_le hs)
      rw [hz, Nat.zero_add] at hwork
      exact BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit.first_wide hbalance hwork
  · have hw : r.stop - r.start ≠ 2 * m - 1 := by omega
    simp only [wideCount_append, narrowCount_append, ho, hn, Ne.symm hbne,
      and_self, if_true, and_false, if_false, Nat.add_zero]
    rw [epochWideWork_append_unchanged m L history r j S u (Or.inr hw)]
    by_cases hepoch : e / L = u / L
    · rw [epochWideWork_time_closed m L history j S heu.le hepoch hclosed]
      exact (hcredit hepoch).narrow_step hb hbalance (hnarrow hepoch hn)
        (remaining_epoch_strict hL heu hepoch)
    · have hs := epoch_start_after hL heu.le hepoch
      rw [epochWideWork_zero_closed m L history j S u
        (fun v hv => (hclosed v hv).trans_le hs)]
      exact BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit.first_narrow

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

decl_109.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit
decl_109.label: BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit
decl_109.statement: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop
decl_109.source:
def ThresholdCredit (b d w n x : ℕ) : Prop :=
  x ≤ b * (w - n) ∨ (b * d ≤ x ∧ d ≤ w - n)

decl_111.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit.first_wide
decl_111.label: BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit.first_wide
decl_111.statement: ∀ {b d w n x : ℕ}, n ≤ w → x ≤ b → Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit b d (w + 1) n x
decl_111.source:
theorem ThresholdCredit.first_wide {b d w n x : ℕ} (hbalance : n ≤ w) (hx : x ≤ b) :
    ThresholdCredit b d (w + 1) n x := by
  left
  have hs : 1 ≤ w + 1 - n := by omega
  have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_left b hs
  omega

decl_110.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit.first_narrow
decl_110.label: BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit.first_narrow
decl_110.statement: ∀ {b d w n : ℕ}, Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit b d w n 0
decl_110.source:
theorem ThresholdCredit.first_narrow {b d w n : ℕ} : ThresholdCredit b d w n 0 := by
  left
  omega

/-- Even when a wide layer is permitted by the prefix guard, the work
counter is below the passivity threshold. Thus the guard does not restart
wide service after passivity. -/

decl_113.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit.wide_below
decl_113.label: BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit.wide_below
decl_113.statement:
∀ {b d w n x : ℕ},
  0 < b → 0 < d → n ≤ w → Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit b d w n x → w ≤ n ∨ x < b * d → x < b * d
decl_113.source:
theorem ThresholdCredit.wide_below {b d w n x : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hbalance : n ≤ w) (hcredit : ThresholdCredit b d w n x)
    (hchoose : w ≤ n ∨ x < b * d) : x < b * d := by
  rcases hchoose with hguard | hx
  · have he : w - n = 0 := by omega
    rcases hcredit with ha | hp
    · rw [he, Nat.mul_zero] at ha
      have hbd := Nat.mul_pos hb hd
      omega
    · rw [he] at hp
      omega
  · exact hx

decl_114.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit.wide_step
decl_114.label: BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit.wide_step
decl_114.statement:
∀ {b d d' w n x x' : ℕ},
  0 < b →
    0 < d →
      n ≤ w →
        Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit b d w n x →
          w ≤ n ∨ x < b * d → x' ≤ x + b → Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit b d' (w + 1) n x'
decl_114.source:
theorem ThresholdCredit.wide_step {b d d' w n x x' : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hbalance : n ≤ w) (hcredit : ThresholdCredit b d w n x)
    (hchoose : w ≤ n ∨ x < b * d) (hwork : x' ≤ x + b) :
    ThresholdCredit b d' (w + 1) n x' := by
  have hsmall := hcredit.wide_below hb hd hbalance hchoose
  have ha : x ≤ b * (w - n) := hcredit.resolve_right (by intro h; omega)
  have hs : w + 1 - n = (w - n) + 1 := by omega
  left
  rw [hs, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
  omega

decl_112.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit.narrow_step
decl_112.label: BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit.narrow_step
decl_112.statement:
∀ {b d d' w n x : ℕ},
  0 < b →
    n ≤ w →
      Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit b d w n x →
        b * d ≤ x → d' + 1 ≤ d → Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit b d' w (n + 1) x
decl_112.source:
theorem ThresholdCredit.narrow_step {b d d' w n x : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hbalance : n ≤ w) (hcredit : ThresholdCredit b d w n x)
    (hthreshold : b * d ≤ x) (htime : d' + 1 ≤ d) :
    ThresholdCredit b d' w (n + 1) x := by
  have hsurplus : d ≤ w - n := by
    rcases hcredit with ha | hp
    · exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left (hthreshold.trans ha) hb
    · exact hp.2
  right
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left b (show d' ≤ d by omega)).trans hthreshold
  · omega

/-- A trace of completed layers within one epoch. The counter can rise
by at most one layer's width at a wide completion and cannot rise at a
narrow completion. Time advances by at least one slot per layer. -/

decl_104.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.CreditTrace
decl_104.label: BatchedForcing.CreditTrace
decl_104.statement: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop
decl_104.source:
inductive CreditTrace (b : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop
  | initial (d w n x : ℕ) (hbalance : n ≤ w) (hcredit : ThresholdCredit b d w n x) :
      CreditTrace b d w n x
  | wide {d w n x : ℕ} (prev : CreditTrace b d w n x)
      (d' x' : ℕ) (htime : d' < d) (hchoose : w ≤ n ∨ x < b * d)
      (hwork : x' ≤ x + b) : CreditTrace b d' (w + 1) n x'
  | narrow {d w n x : ℕ} (prev : CreditTrace b d w n x)
      (d' : ℕ) (htime : d' < d) (hthreshold : b * d ≤ x) :
      CreditTrace b d' w (n + 1) x

decl_105.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.CreditTrace.credit
decl_105.label: BatchedForcing.CreditTrace.credit
decl_105.statement:
∀ {b d w n x : ℕ},
  0 < b → Scheduling.BatchedForcing.CreditTrace b d w n x → n ≤ w ∧ Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit b d w n x
decl_105.source:
theorem CreditTrace.credit {b d w n x : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h : CreditTrace b d w n x) :
    n ≤ w ∧ ThresholdCredit b d w n x := by
  induction h with
  | initial d w n x hbalance hcredit => exact ⟨hbalance, hcredit⟩
  | wide prev d' x' htime hchoose hwork ih =>
    exact ⟨by omega, ih.2.wide_step hb (by omega) ih.1 hchoose hwork⟩
  | @narrow d w n x prev d' htime hthreshold ih =>
    have hs : d ≤ w - n := by
      rcases ih.2 with ha | hp
      · exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left (hthreshold.trans ha) hb
      · exact hp.2
    exact ⟨by omega, ih.2.narrow_step hb ih.1 hthreshold (by omega)⟩

end Scheduling.BatchedForcing

decl_116.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.list_sum_le_mul_sum
decl_116.label: BatchedForcing.list_sum_le_mul_sum
decl_116.statement:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (xs : List α) (f g : α → ℕ) (b : ℕ),
  (∀ x ∈ xs, f x ≤ b * g x) → (List.map f xs).sum ≤ b * (List.map g xs).sum
decl_116.source:
theorem list_sum_le_mul_sum {α : Type*} (xs : List α) (f g : α → ℕ) (b : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ xs, f x ≤ b * g x) : (xs.map f).sum ≤ b * (xs.map g).sum := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hh := h x List.mem_cons_self
    have ht := ih (fun y hy => h y (List.mem_cons_of_mem x hy))
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Nat.mul_add]
    omega

decl_115.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.list_sum_le_length_mul
decl_115.label: BatchedForcing.list_sum_le_length_mul
decl_115.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (xs : List α) (f : α → ℕ) (b : ℕ), (∀ x ∈ xs, f x ≤ b) → (List.map f xs).sum ≤ xs.length * b
decl_115.source:
theorem list_sum_le_length_mul {α : Type*} (xs : List α) (f : α → ℕ) (b : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ xs, f x ≤ b) : (xs.map f).sum ≤ xs.length * b := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hh := h x List.mem_cons_self
    have ht := ih (fun y hy => h y (List.mem_cons_of_mem x hy))
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.length_cons, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
    omega

decl_118.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.passivityBounds_map
decl_118.label: BatchedForcing.passivityBounds_map
decl_118.statement:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (m c : ℕ) (xs : List α) (D : α → ℕ),
  (∀ (before : List α) (x : α) (after : List α),
      xs = before ++ x :: after → (m - c) * D x ≤ (2 * m - 1) * (c + (List.map (fun y => D y + 2) after).sum)) →
    Scheduling.BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds m c (List.map D xs)
decl_118.source:
theorem passivityBounds_map {α : Type*} (m c : ℕ) (xs : List α) (D : α → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ before x after, xs = before ++ x :: after →
      (m - c) * D x ≤ (2 * m - 1) * (c + (after.map (fun y => D y + 2)).sum)) :
    PassivityBounds m c (xs.map D) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => exact PassivityBounds.nil
  | cons x xs ih =>
    apply PassivityBounds.cons
    · rw [List.map_map]
      exact h [] x xs rfl
    · apply ih
      intro before y after he
      exact h (x :: before) y after (by simp only [List.cons_append, he])

/-- Summing per-job cutoff bounds in chronological cutoff order gives
exactly the suffix inequalities used by the geometric recurrence. -/

decl_120.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.sorted_cutoffs_passivity
decl_120.label: BatchedForcing.sorted_cutoffs_passivity
decl_120.statement:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (m c a z : ℕ) (xs : List α) (T : α → ℕ) (F : α → ℕ → ℕ),
  xs.length ≤ c →
    List.Pairwise (fun x y => T x ≤ T y) xs →
      (∀ x ∈ xs, a ≤ T x ∧ T x ≤ z) →
        (∀ (u : ℕ), a ≤ u → u ≤ z → (m - c) * (z - u) ≤ (List.map (fun x => F x u) xs).sum) →
          (∀ x ∈ xs, ∀ (u : ℕ), a ≤ u → u ≤ z → F x u ≤ (2 * m - 1) * (z - T x + 2)) →
            (∀ x ∈ xs, ∀ (u : ℕ), T x ≤ u → F x u ≤ 2 * m - 1) →
              a ≤ z → Scheduling.BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds m c ((z - a) :: List.map (fun x => z - T x) xs)
decl_120.source:
theorem sorted_cutoffs_passivity {α : Type*} (m c a z : ℕ) (xs : List α)
    (T : α → ℕ) (F : α → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hlen : xs.length ≤ c)
    (hsort : xs.Pairwise (fun x y => T x ≤ T y))
    (htimes : ∀ x ∈ xs, a ≤ T x ∧ T x ≤ z)
    (hcapacity : ∀ u, a ≤ u → u ≤ z → (m - c) * (z - u) ≤ (xs.map (fun x => F x u)).sum)
    (htotal : ∀ x ∈ xs, ∀ u, a ≤ u → u ≤ z → F x u ≤ (2 * m - 1) * (z - T x + 2))
    (hsuffix : ∀ x ∈ xs, ∀ u, T x ≤ u → F x u ≤ 2 * m - 1)
    (haz : a ≤ z) :
    PassivityBounds m c ((z - a) :: xs.map (fun x => z - T x)) := by
  apply PassivityBounds.cons
  · have hu := hcapacity a le_rfl haz
    have hh := list_sum_le_mul_sum xs (fun x => F x a) (fun x => z - T x + 2)
      (2 * m - 1) (fun x hx => htotal x hx a le_rfl haz)
    simp only [List.map_map]
    have hadd := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * m - 1)
      (Nat.le_add_left (xs.map (fun x => z - T x + 2)).sum c)
    exact hu.trans (hh.trans hadd)
  · apply passivityBounds_map
    intro before x after he
    have hx : x ∈ xs := he ▸ List.mem_append_right before List.mem_cons_self
    have hbefore : ∀ y ∈ before, y ∈ xs := fun y hy => he ▸ List.mem_append_left _ hy
    have hafter : ∀ y ∈ after, y ∈ xs := fun y hy =>
      he ▸ List.mem_append_right before (List.mem_cons_of_mem x hy)
    have horder : ∀ y ∈ before, T y ≤ T x := by
      rw [he, List.pairwise_append] at hsort
      intro y hy
      exact hsort.2.2 y hy x List.mem_cons_self
    have hlen' : before.length + 1 ≤ c := by
      rw [he, List.length_append, List.length_cons] at hlen
      omega
    have htime := htimes x hx
    have hu := hcapacity (T x) htime.1 htime.2
    have hb := list_sum_le_length_mul before (fun y => F y (T x)) (2 * m - 1)
      (fun y hy => hsuffix y (hbefore y hy) (T x) (horder y hy))
    have hxbound := hsuffix x hx (T x) le_rfl
    have ha := list_sum_le_mul_sum after (fun y => F y (T x)) (fun y => z - T y + 2)
      (2 * m - 1) (fun y hy => htotal y (hafter y hy) (T x) htime.1 htime.2)
    rw [he, List.map_append, List.sum_append, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] at hu
    have hprefix := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 * m - 1) hlen'
    nlinarith

end Scheduling.BatchedForcing

decl_64.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.full_epoch_passivity
decl_64.label: Aggregate passivity recurrence
decl_64.statement:
∀ {jobs m L c : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L),
  2 * (L / 2) = L →
    ∀ (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
      {Q : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)},
      Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun ⋯ A L (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
          (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.initial jobs m L hm) Q records →
        (Q.toInstance L ⋯).FlowBound (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L ⋯)) (c * L) →
          ∀ (i : ℕ),
            (∀ (t : ℕ), i * L ≤ t → t < (i + 1) * L → {v | A.schedule (Q.toInstance L ⋯) v = t}.card = m) →
              ∃ ds, ds.length ≤ c ∧ Scheduling.BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds m c (L :: ds)
decl_64.source:
theorem full_epoch_passivity (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records)
    (hflow : (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).FlowBound
      (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) (c * L)) (i : ℕ)
    (hfull : ∀ t, i * L ≤ t → t < (i + 1) * L →
      (univ.filter (fun v => A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) v = t)).card = m) :
    ∃ ds : List ℕ, ds.length ≤ c ∧ BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds m c (L :: ds) := by
  let I := Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)
  let S := A.schedule I
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := full_epoch_job_cutoffs hm hL heven A h i hfull
  apply cutoffs_passivity records S i c (I.alive S (i * L)) T hT
    (I.regular_alive_card_le hL (by intros; rfl) hflow i)
  · intro v _ hlo hhi
    have hr := I.regular_epoch_no_arrivals (i := i) (A.valid I) hL (by intros; rfl) v hhi
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hr, v, rfl, hlo⟩
  · intro u hlo _
    exact full_epoch_wide_lower hm hL heven A h hflow hlo le_rfl
      (by intro t ht; exact hfull t (hlo.trans (mem_Ico.mp ht).1) (mem_Ico.mp ht).2)

/-- In the actual threshold construction, the geometric epoch length
forces an idle slot in every epoch under the small-flow hypothesis. -/

decl_61.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.forcing_epoch_deficit
decl_61.label: BatchedAdversary.forcing_epoch_deficit
decl_61.statement:
∀ {jobs m L c : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L),
  2 * (L / 2) = L →
    0 < c →
      2 * c ≤ m →
        L = 8 * c * 5 ^ c →
          ∀ (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
            {Q : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)},
            Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun ⋯ A L (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
                (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.initial jobs m L hm) Q records →
              (Q.toInstance L ⋯).FlowBound (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L ⋯)) (c * L) →
                ∀ (i : ℕ), (Q.toInstance L ⋯).epochWork (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L ⋯)) L i < m * L
decl_61.source:
theorem forcing_epoch_deficit (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m) (hscale : L = 8 * c * 5 ^ c)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records)
    (hflow : (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).FlowBound
      (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) (c * L)) (i : ℕ) :
    (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).epochWork
      (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) L i < m * L := by
  let I := Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)
  let S := A.schedule I
  by_contra hnot
  have hfull : ∀ t, i * L ≤ t → t < (i + 1) * L →
      (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card = m := by
    intro t hlo hhi
    have hcap := (A.valid I).capacity t
    change (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card ≤ m at hcap
    by_contra hne
    have hidle : (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card < m := by omega
    exact hnot (I.epochWork_lt_of_idle (A.valid I) hL (mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hlo, hhi⟩) hidle)
  obtain ⟨ds, hlen, hb⟩ := full_epoch_passivity hm hL heven A h hflow i hfull
  apply BatchedForcing.no_full_epoch (by omega) hc hcm hlen
  simpa only [← hscale] using hb

decl_60.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.flow_lower
decl_60.label: BatchedAdversary.flow_lower
decl_60.statement:
∀ {jobs m L c : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L),
  2 * (L / 2) = L →
    0 < c →
      2 * c ≤ m →
        L = 8 * c * 5 ^ c →
          ∀ (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
            {Q : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)},
            Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun ⋯ A L (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
                (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.initial jobs m L hm) Q records →
              jobs = c * (m * L) → c * L ≤ (Q.toInstance L ⋯).maxFlow (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L ⋯))
decl_60.source:
theorem flow_lower (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m) (hscale : L = 8 * c * 5 ^ c)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records) (hn : jobs = c * (m * L)) :
    c * L ≤ (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).maxFlow
      (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) := by
  let I := Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)
  apply I.regular_every_epoch_flow_lower (by omega) hL hc hn (A.valid I) (by intros; rfl)
    (fun j => Q.jobVertices_card L _ j)
  intro hflow i _
  exact forcing_epoch_deficit hm hL heven hc hcm hscale A h hflow i

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

decl_106.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds
decl_106.label: BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds
decl_106.source:
inductive PassivityBounds (m c : ℕ) : List ℕ → Prop
  | nil : PassivityBounds m c []
  | cons (d : ℕ) (tail : List ℕ)
      (bound : (m - c) * d ≤ (2 * m - 1) * (c + (tail.map (· + 2)).sum))
      (rest : PassivityBounds m c tail) : PassivityBounds m c (d :: tail)

decl_119.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.passivity_step
decl_119.label: BatchedForcing.passivity_step
decl_119.source:
theorem passivity_step {m c d s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hc : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (h : (m - c) * d ≤ (2 * m - 1) * (c + s)) :
    d + 2 ≤ 4 * c + 2 + 4 * s := by
  have hp : 0 < m - c := by omega
  have hb : 2 * m - 1 ≤ 4 * (m - c) := by omega
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (c + s) hb
  have hd : d ≤ 4 * (c + s) := by
    have hh : (m - c) * d ≤ (m - c) * (4 * (c + s)) := by nlinarith
    exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hh hp
  omega

decl_108.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds.sum_bound
decl_108.label: BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds.sum_bound
decl_108.statement:
∀ {m c : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    2 * c ≤ m →
      ∀ {ds : List ℕ},
        Scheduling.BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds m c ds →
          4 * (List.map (fun x => x + 2) ds).sum + (4 * c + 2) ≤ (4 * c + 2) * 5 ^ ds.length
decl_108.source:
theorem PassivityBounds.sum_bound {m c : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hc : 2 * c ≤ m)
    {ds : List ℕ} (h : PassivityBounds m c ds) :
    4 * (ds.map (· + 2)).sum + (4 * c + 2) ≤ (4 * c + 2) * 5 ^ ds.length := by
  induction h with
  | nil => simp
  | cons d tail bound rest ih =>
    have hd := passivity_step hm hc bound
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.length_cons, pow_succ]
    nlinarith

/-- The geometric estimate used in the batched lower bound. The service
inequalities must still be derived from the adaptive execution. -/

decl_107.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds.epoch_length_bound
decl_107.label: BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds.epoch_length_bound
decl_107.statement:
∀ {m c L : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    2 * c ≤ m →
      ∀ {ds : List ℕ},
        Scheduling.BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds m c (L :: ds) → ds.length ≤ c → L + 2 ≤ (4 * c + 2) * 5 ^ c
decl_107.source:
theorem PassivityBounds.epoch_length_bound {m c L : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hc : 2 * c ≤ m)
    {ds : List ℕ} (h : PassivityBounds m c (L :: ds)) (hlen : ds.length ≤ c) :
    L + 2 ≤ (4 * c + 2) * 5 ^ c := by
  cases h with
  | cons d tail bound rest =>
    have hd := passivity_step hm hc bound
    have hs := rest.sum_bound hm hc
    have hp : 5 ^ ds.length ≤ 5 ^ c := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hlen
    have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (4 * c + 2) hp
    omega

decl_117.name: Scheduling.BatchedForcing.no_full_epoch
decl_117.label: Geometric contradiction
decl_117.statement:
∀ {m c : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    0 < c →
      2 * c ≤ m → ∀ {ds : List ℕ}, ds.length ≤ c → ¬Scheduling.BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds m c (8 * c * 5 ^ c :: ds)
decl_117.source:
theorem no_full_epoch {m c : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hc : 0 < c) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    {ds : List ℕ} (hlen : ds.length ≤ c) :
    ¬ PassivityBounds m c ((8 * c * 5 ^ c) :: ds) := by
  intro h
  have hb := h.epoch_length_bound hm hcm hlen
  have hp : 0 < 5 ^ c := pow_pos (by omega) c
  nlinarith

end Scheduling.BatchedForcing

namespace Scheduling.Instance
open Finset
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

/-- With one deficit in every epoch, `cmL` jobs suffice for the final
backlog contradiction. This is the counting step of the batched lower
bound, conditional on its epoch-forcing property. -/

decl_439.name: Scheduling.Instance.regular_every_epoch_flow_lower
decl_439.label: Instance.regular_every_epoch_flow_lower
decl_439.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L c : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  0 < m →
    0 < L →
      0 < c →
        jobs = c * (m * L) →
          I.Valid m S →
            (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.release j = ↑j * L) →
              (∀ (j : Fin jobs), (I.jobVertices j).card = m * L) →
                (I.FlowBound S (c * L) → ∀ i < jobs, I.epochWork S L i < m * L) → c * L ≤ I.maxFlow S
decl_439.source:
theorem regular_every_epoch_flow_lower {m L c : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L) (hc : 0 < c) (hn : jobs = c * (m * L))
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hrelease : ∀ j, I.release j = j.val * L)
    (hwork : ∀ j, (I.jobVertices j).card = m * L)
    (hidle : I.FlowBound S (c * L) → ∀ i < jobs, I.epochWork S L i < m * L) :
    c * L ≤ I.maxFlow S := by
  by_contra hh
  have hflow : I.FlowBound S (c * L) := (I.flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le S _).mpr (by omega)
  have hp : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos hm hL
  have hcj : c ≤ jobs := by
    rw [hn]
    have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (show 1 ≤ m * L from hp)
    simpa only [Nat.mul_one] using h
  have hy := I.regular_young_backlog hcj hL hrelease hwork hflow
  rw [← I.regular_idleBacklog_eq hS hL hwork] at hy
  have hacc : jobs ≤ Accounting.idleBacklog (m * L) (I.epochWork S L) jobs := by
    simpa only [Nat.one_mul] using
      Accounting.forcing_epochs_accumulate (c := 1) (K := jobs) (by omega)
        (by simpa only [Nat.one_mul] using hidle hflow)
  have hc1 : c - 1 + 1 = c := by omega
  nlinarith

end Scheduling.Instance

decl_33.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit
decl_33.label: BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit
decl_33.statement: {jobs : ℕ} → (m L : ℕ) → List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L)) → Fin jobs → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → ℕ → Prop
decl_33.source:
structure RevealCredit (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))) (e width : ℕ) : Prop where
  closed_before : ∀ v, WideRecorded m history j v → S v < e
  credit : ¬ IdleEarlier m L S e → wideCount m history j < L / 2 →
    BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit (2 * m - 1) (L - e % L)
      (wideCount m history j) (narrowCount history j) (epochWideWork m L history j S e)
  wide_choice : width = 2 * m - 1 → wideCount m history j ≤ narrowCount history j ∨
    IdleEarlier m L S e ∨ epochWideWork m L history j S e < (2 * m - 1) * (L - e % L)
  narrow_threshold : width = 1 → wideCount m history j < L / 2 →
    (2 * m - 1) * (L - e % L) ≤ epochWideWork m L history j S e

decl_27.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.FrontierCredit
decl_27.label: BatchedAdversary.FrontierCredit
decl_27.statement:
{jobs : ℕ} →
  (m L : ℕ) →
    List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L)) → Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L) → Scheduling.Assignment → Prop

decl_76.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.initial_frontierCredit
decl_76.label: BatchedAdversary.initial_frontierCredit
decl_76.statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m),
  0 < L →
    2 * (L / 2) = L →
      ∀ (S : Scheduling.Assignment),
        (∀ (v : Fin (jobs * (m * L))), ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v) * L ≤ S v) →
          Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.FrontierCredit m L [] (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.initial jobs m L hm) S
decl_76.source:
theorem initial_frontierCredit (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L)))
    (hrelease : ∀ v, (job v).val * L ≤ S v) :
    FrontierCredit m L [] (initial jobs m L hm) S := by
  have hfit : 2 * m - 1 ≤ m * L := by
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left m (show 2 ≤ L by omega)
    omega
  intro j
  refine ⟨j.val * L, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    have ho := (mem_filter.mp hv).2.1
    simpa only [ho] using hrelease v
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro v hv
      obtain ⟨_, r, hr, _⟩ := hv
      simp at hr
    · intro _ _
      left
      simp [epochWideWork, WideRecorded]
    · intro _
      left
      simp [wideCount, narrowCount]
    · intro hn _
      simp only [initial, min_eq_left hfit] at hn
      omega

decl_34.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit.after_record
decl_34.label: BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit.after_record
decl_34.statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    0 < L →
      2 * (L / 2) = L →
        ∀ (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (r : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))
          (j : Fin jobs) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (e width p : ℕ),
          Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit m L history j S e width →
            r.owner = j →
              r.stop - r.start = width →
                e ≤ r.time →
                  width = 2 * m - 1 ∨ width = 1 →
                    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount history j ≤
                        Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m history j →
                      Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j ≤
                          Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j →
                        p =
                            (2 * m - 1) * Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j +
                              Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j →
                          (∀ (v : Fin (jobs * (m * L))),
                              Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v = j →
                                r.start ≤ ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) →
                                  ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) < r.stop → S v ≤ r.time) →
                            Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit m L (history ++ [r]) j S (r.time + 1)
                              (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth m L (history ++ [r]) j p S (r.time + 1))
decl_34.source:
theorem RevealCredit.after_record (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L)
    (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (r : LayerRecord jobs (m * L))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))) (e width p : ℕ)
    (h : RevealCredit m L history j S e width)
    (ho : r.owner = j) (hw : r.stop - r.start = width) (he : e ≤ r.time)
    (hshape : width = 2 * m - 1 ∨ width = 1)
    (hbalance : narrowCount history j ≤ wideCount m history j)
    (hnewbalance : narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j ≤ wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j)
    (hprefix : p = (2 * m - 1) * wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j + narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j)
    (htimes : ∀ v, job v = j → r.start ≤ (position v).val → (position v).val < r.stop →
      S v ≤ r.time) :
    RevealCredit m L (history ++ [r]) j S (r.time + 1)
      (finalWidth m L (history ++ [r]) j p S (r.time + 1)) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    rcases (wideRecorded_append m history r j v).mp hv with hv | hv
    · exact (h.closed_before v hv).trans_le (by omega)
    · have ht := htimes v hv.1 hv.2.2.2.1 hv.2.2.2.2
      omega
  · intro hfull hquota
    have hquota' : wideCount m history j < L / 2 := by
      rw [wideCount_append] at hquota
      omega
    have hfull' : e / L = (r.time + 1) / L → ¬ IdleEarlier m L S e := by
      intro hep hi
      exact hfull (idleEarlier_mono_same_epoch S (by omega) hep hi)
    apply credit_after_record hm hL history r j S e (r.time + 1) ho (by omega)
      (by simpa only [hw] using hshape) hbalance h.closed_before
    · intro hep
      exact h.credit (hfull' hep) hquota'
    · intro hep hr
      rcases h.wide_choice (hw.symm.trans hr) with hg | hi | hx
      · exact Or.inl hg
      · exact False.elim (hfull' hep hi)
      · exact Or.inr hx
    · intro _ hr
      exact h.narrow_threshold (hw.symm.trans hr) hquota'
  · intro hwide
    exact (finalWidth_wide_implies_choose hm _ j p S _ hwide).2
  · intro hn hquota
    exact finalWidth_narrow_threshold hm heven _ j p S _ hnewbalance hprefix hquota hn

decl_35.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit.append_other
decl_35.label: BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit.append_other
decl_35.statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ} (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (r : Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))
  (j : Fin jobs) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (e width : ℕ),
  r.owner ≠ j →
    Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit m L history j S e width →
      Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit m L (history ++ [r]) j S e width
decl_35.source:
theorem RevealCredit.append_other
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (r : LayerRecord jobs (m * L))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))) (e width : ℕ)
    (ho : r.owner ≠ j) (h : RevealCredit m L history j S e width) :
    RevealCredit m L (history ++ [r]) j S e width := by
  have hw : wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j = wideCount m history j := by
    simp only [wideCount_append, ho, false_and, if_false, Nat.add_zero]
  have hn : narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j = narrowCount history j := by
    simp only [narrowCount_append, ho, false_and, if_false, Nat.add_zero]
  have hx := epochWideWork_append_unchanged m L history r j S e (Or.inl ho)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    rcases (wideRecorded_append m history r j v).mp hv with hv | hv
    · exact h.closed_before v hv
    · exact False.elim (ho hv.2.1)
  · simpa only [hw, hn, hx] using h.credit
  · simpa only [hw, hn, hx] using h.wide_choice
  · simpa only [hw, hx] using h.narrow_threshold

decl_62.name: Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.frontierCredit_advance
decl_62.label: BatchedAdversary.frontierCredit_advance
decl_62.statement:
∀ {jobs m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L),
  2 * (L / 2) = L →
    ∀ (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
      (P Q : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)) (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin (m * L))
      (hk : P.closed j ≤ ↑key ∧ ↑key < P.boundary j),
      (∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L ⋯) v ≤ A.schedule (P.toInstance L ⋯) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key))) →
        (∀ (i : Fin jobs),
            P.closed i < m * L → A.schedule (P.toInstance L ⋯) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) ≤ P.finishTime ⋯ A i) →
          ∀ (records : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs (m * L))),
            Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun ⋯ A L (Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A)
                (history ++ [P.record ⋯ A j key])
                (P.advance j key hk
                  ((Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A).size (history ++ [P.record ⋯ A j key]) P j
                    (A.schedule (P.toInstance L ⋯) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1))
                  ⋯ ⋯)
                Q records →
              Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.Budget m L history P →
                Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.FrontierCredit m L history P (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L ⋯)) →
                  have hw := ⋯;
                  have next := history ++ [P.record hw A j key];
                  have t := A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1;
                  Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.FrontierCredit m L next
                    (P.advance j key hk ((Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule jobs m L hm hL A).size next P j t) ⋯ ⋯)
                    (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hw))
decl_62.source:
theorem frontierCredit_advance (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
    (P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)) (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin (m * L))
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
    (hmax : ∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) v ≤
      A.schedule (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)))
    (hearliest : ∀ i, P.closed i < m * L →
      A.schedule (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) ≤
        P.finishTime (L := L) (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A i)
    (records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
    (tail : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A)
      (history ++ [P.record (L := L) (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A j key])
      (P.advance j key hk
        ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).size
          (history ++ [P.record (L := L) (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A j key]) P j
          (A.schedule (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1))
        ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).fits _ _ _ _) ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).positive _ _ _ _))
      Q records)
    (hb : Budget m L history P)
    (hc : FrontierCredit m L history P (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)))) :
    let hw : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL
    let next := history ++ [P.record (L := L) hw A j key]
    let t := A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1
    FrontierCredit m L next (P.advance j key hk ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).size next P j t)
      ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).fits _ _ _ _) ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).positive _ _ _ _))
      (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hw)) := by
  dsimp only
  let hw : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL
  let r := P.record (L := L) hw A j key
  let next := history ++ [r]
  let t := r.time + 1
  let q := (rule jobs m L hm hL A).size next P j t
  let R := P.advance j key hk q ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).fits _ _ _ _)
    ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).positive _ _ _ _)
  let S := A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hw)
  change FrontierCredit m L next R S
  have hfull := HistoryRun.step history P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail
  obtain ⟨staticRule, hr⟩ := hfull.flexible.recorded
  have htimes := hr.final_times r List.mem_cons_self
  have hkey : S (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) = r.time := htimes.2.2.2.1
  have hbnext : Budget m L next R := budget_advance hm hL heven A history P hb j key hk
  have hq : q = finalWidth m L next j (P.boundary j) S t := by
    have hpast := hfull.past_agreement r.time hearliest
    have hchoose := chooseWide_congr m L next j hpast
    change min (m * L - P.boundary j)
      (if ChooseWide m L next j (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw)) t then 2 * m - 1 else 1) = _
    unfold finalWidth
    rw [hchoose]
  intro i
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst i
    obtain ⟨e, he, hcredit⟩ := hc j
    have hekey := he (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) (by
      apply mem_filter.mpr
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, LayeredForest.job_pair j key, by
        simpa only [LayeredForest.position_pair] using hk⟩)
    change e ≤ S (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) at hekey
    rw [hkey] at hekey
    refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro v hv
      obtain ⟨tailRule, ht⟩ := tail.flexible.recorded
      have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      change job v = j ∧ R.closed j ≤ (position v).val ∧ (position v).val < R.boundary j at hv'
      have hp := ht.completion.parent_visible j (position v) hv'.2.2
      have hnew : R.parent j (position v) = some key := by
        have hlo : P.boundary j ≤ (position v).val := by simpa only [R, advance_closed] using hv'.2.1
        have hhi : (position v).val < P.boundary j + q := by simpa only [R, advance_boundary] using hv'.2.2
        exact if_pos ⟨rfl, hlo, hhi⟩
      have hvQ : (position v).val < Q.boundary j := by
        have hf := ht.completion.finished j
        have hpos := (position v).isLt
        dsimp only [boundary]
        omega
      have hedge : (Q.toInstance L hw).edge (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) v := by
        refine ⟨(LayeredForest.job_pair j key).trans hv'.1.symm, ?_⟩
        simp only [hv'.1, if_pos hvQ, LayeredForest.position_pair]
        exact hp.trans hnew
      have htime := (A.valid (Q.toInstance L hw)).precedence hedge
      change S (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) < S v at htime
      rw [hkey] at htime
      exact htime
    · have hshape : P.width j = 2 * m - 1 ∨ P.width j = 1 := by
        rcases (hb j).2.2.2 with ⟨hz, _⟩ | ⟨hw', _⟩ | ⟨hn, _⟩
        · have hbound : P.boundary j = P.closed j := by simp only [boundary, hz, Nat.add_zero]
          omega
        · exact Or.inl hw'
        · exact Or.inr hn
      have hstep := hcredit.after_record hm hL heven history r j S e (P.width j) (P.boundary j)
        rfl (by simp only [r, record, boundary, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]) hekey hshape
        (hb j).2.1 (hbnext j).2.1
        (by simpa only [R, advance_closed] using (hbnext j).2.2.1)
