    have heq := B.observed_frontier_eq hm hv'.2.1
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, ha, by rw [← heq]; exact h.2⟩
  · intro hb
    have h := (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hu⟩ := h.1.2
    have hrel := (B.released_by_eligible hv).le.trans h.1.1
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hr⟩ := I.exists_ready hrel ⟨v, rfl, hu⟩
    have hb' : B.vertexBatch w = b := by simpa [vertexBatch, hw] using hv
    have hobs := (B.observed_ready_iff hm b w).mpr ⟨hb', h.1.1, hr⟩
    have heq := B.observed_frontier_eq hm h.1.1
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, card_pos.mpr ⟨w, hobs⟩, by rw [heq]; exact h.2⟩

decl_160.name: Scheduling.Batching.observed_large_eq
decl_160.label: Batching.observed_large_eq
decl_160.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} (B : Scheduling.Batching I L batches)
  [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m k : ℕ},
  0 < m → (B.observe (B.run m k)).large m = B.large m (B.execution m) (B.run m k).clock
decl_160.source:
theorem observed_large_eq {m k : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    (B.observe (B.run m k)).large m = B.large m (B.execution m) (B.run m k).clock := by
  ext b
  constructor
  · intro hb
    have h := (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    have hp : 0 < ((B.observe (B.run m k)).ready b).card := by omega
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := card_pos.mp hp
    have hv' := (B.observed_ready_iff hm b v).mp hv
    have heq := B.observed_frontier_eq hm hv'.2.1
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, ⟨hv'.2.1, v, hv'.1, hv'.2.2.2.1⟩, by rw [← heq]; exact h⟩
  · intro hb
    have h := (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    have heq := B.observed_frontier_eq hm h.1.1
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by rw [heq]; exact h.2⟩

decl_162.name: Scheduling.Batching.observed_smallFront_eq
decl_162.label: Batching.observed_smallFront_eq
decl_162.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} (B : Scheduling.Batching I L batches)
  [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m k : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    (B.observe (B.run m k)).smallFront m =
      {v | B.vertexBatch v ∈ B.small m (B.execution m) (B.run m k).clock ∧ I.Ready (B.execution m) (B.run m k).clock v}
decl_162.source:
theorem observed_smallFront_eq {m k : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    (B.observe (B.run m k)).smallFront m =
      univ.filter (fun v => B.vertexBatch v ∈ B.small m (B.execution m) (B.run m k).clock ∧
        I.Ready (B.execution m) (B.run m k).clock v) := by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have h := (B.observe (B.run m k)).smallFront_ready hv
    have hr := (B.observed_ready_iff hm (B.vertexBatch v) v).mp h.2
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by rw [← B.observed_small_eq hm]; exact h.1, hr.2.2⟩
  · intro hv
    have h := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hs : B.vertexBatch v ∈ (B.observe (B.run m k)).small m := by rw [B.observed_small_eq hm]; exact h.1
    have he := (mem_filter.mp h.1).2.1.1
    exact mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨B.vertexBatch v, hs,
      (B.observed_ready_iff hm _ v).mpr ⟨rfl, he, h.2⟩⟩

end Scheduling.Batching

decl_419.name: Scheduling.Instance.prefixService
decl_419.label: Instance.prefixService
decl_419.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → ℕ → Finset (Fin vertices)
decl_419.source:
noncomputable def prefixService (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (r t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => S v = t ∧ I.release (I.owner v) ≤ r)

decl_247.name: Scheduling.Instance.PrefixFull
decl_247.label: Instance.PrefixFull
decl_247.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → ℕ → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → ℕ → Prop
decl_247.source:
def PrefixFull (m : ℕ) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (r t : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (I.prefixService S r t).card = m

decl_405.name: Scheduling.Instance.partialSlots
decl_405.label: Instance.partialSlots
decl_405.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → ℕ → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ
decl_405.source:
noncomputable def partialSlots (m : ℕ) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (r t : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Ico r t).filter (fun s => ¬ I.PrefixFull m S r s)

decl_406.name: Scheduling.Instance.partialSlots_succ
decl_406.label: Instance.partialSlots_succ
decl_406.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m r t : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  r ≤ t → (I.partialSlots m S r (t + 1)).card = (I.partialSlots m S r t).card + if I.PrefixFull m S r t then 0 else 1
decl_406.source:
theorem partialSlots_succ {m r t : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (hrt : r ≤ t) :
    (I.partialSlots m S r (t + 1)).card = (I.partialSlots m S r t).card +
      (if I.PrefixFull m S r t then 0 else 1) := by
  classical
  have hi : Ico r (t + 1) = insert t (Ico r t) := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_Ico, mem_insert]
    omega
  rw [partialSlots, hi]
  by_cases h : I.PrefixFull m S r t
  · simp [Finset.filter_insert, h, partialSlots]
  · simp [Finset.filter_insert, h, partialSlots]

decl_420.name: Scheduling.Instance.prefixService_card_le
decl_420.label: Instance.prefixService_card_le
decl_420.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m r t : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S → (I.prefixService S r t).card ≤ m
decl_420.source:
theorem prefixService_card_le {m r t : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) : (I.prefixService S r t).card ≤ m := by
  classical
  apply (card_le_card (t := univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)) ?_).trans (hS.capacity t)
  intro v hv
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, (mem_filter.mp hv).2.1⟩

/-- If a slot is not full on the old-job prefix, FIFO processes every ready
vertex of the target job in that slot. -/

decl_430.name: Scheduling.Instance.ready_processed_of_partial
decl_430.label: Instance.ready_processed_of_partial
decl_430.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m r t : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    I.IsFIFO m S → ¬I.PrefixFull m S r t → ∀ {v : Fin vertices}, I.Ready S t v → I.release (I.owner v) ≤ r → S v = t
decl_430.source:
theorem ready_processed_of_partial {m r t : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) (hp : ¬ I.PrefixFull m S r t)
    {v : Fin vertices} (hv : I.Ready S t v) (hr : I.release (I.owner v) ≤ r) : S v = t := by
  classical
  by_contra hne
  have hg := hF.work_conserving t v hv hne
  have hsub : univ.filter (fun u => S u = t) ⊆ I.prefixService S r t := by
    intro u hu
    have he := (mem_filter.mp hu).2
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, he,
      (hF.fifo_priority t v u hv hne he).trans hr⟩
  apply hp
  apply Nat.le_antisymm (I.prefixService_card_le hS)
  rw [← hg]
  exact card_le_card hsub

/-- Sequential progress measured using an offline schedule: after `p` partial
slots, every remaining vertex has offline slot at least release + p.
This proves the longest-path step without postulating a depth-decrease axiom. -/

decl_407.name: Scheduling.Instance.partial_progress
decl_407.label: Instance.partial_progress
decl_407.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    I.IsFIFO m S →
      I.Valid m O →
        ∀ (j : Fin jobs) (t : ℕ),
          I.release j ≤ t →
            ∀ (v : Fin vertices),
              I.owner v = j → t ≤ S v → I.release j + (I.partialSlots m S (I.release j) t).card ≤ O v
decl_407.source:
theorem partial_progress {m : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) (hO : I.Valid m O)
    (j : Fin jobs) (t : ℕ) (hrt : I.release j ≤ t)
    (v : Fin vertices) (hj : I.owner v = j) (htv : t ≤ S v) :
    I.release j + (I.partialSlots m S (I.release j) t).card ≤ O v := by
  classical
  induction t using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing v with
  | h t ih =>
    by_cases he : t = I.release j
    · subst t
      simpa [partialSlots, hj] using hO.release v
    · have hrprev : I.release j ≤ t - 1 := by omega
      have htprev : t - 1 < t := by omega
      have hvprev : t - 1 ≤ S v := by omega
      have hprev := ih (t - 1) htprev hrprev v hj hvprev
      have ht : t - 1 + 1 = t := by omega
      have hrec := I.partialSlots_succ (m := m) (S := S) hrprev
      rw [ht] at hrec
      by_cases hf : I.PrefixFull m S (I.release j) (t - 1)
      · rw [if_pos hf] at hrec
        omega
      · rw [if_neg hf] at hrec
        have hnotready : ¬ I.Ready S (t - 1) v := by
          intro hready
          have := I.ready_processed_of_partial hS hF hf hready (by rw [hj])
          omega
        have hpred : ∃ u, I.edge u v ∧ t - 1 ≤ S u := by
          by_contra hn
          push Not at hn
          exact hnotready ⟨by rw [hj]; exact hrprev, hvprev,
            by intro u hu; have := hn u hu; omega⟩
        obtain ⟨u, heuv, hu⟩ := hpred
        have hju : I.owner u = j := (I.same_job heuv).trans hj
        have hpu := ih (t - 1) htprev hrprev u hju hu
        have hprec := hO.precedence heuv
        omega

/-- At most L-1 partial slots have occurred while a job is still unfinished. -/

decl_408.name: Scheduling.Instance.partial_slots_lt
decl_408.label: Instance.partial_slots_lt
decl_408.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L t : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    I.IsFIFO m S →
      I.Valid m O →
        I.FlowBound O L →
          ∀ (j : Fin jobs),
            I.release j ≤ t → (∃ v, I.owner v = j ∧ t ≤ S v) → (I.partialSlots m S (I.release j) t).card < L
decl_408.source:
theorem partial_slots_lt {m L t : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) (hO : I.Valid m O)
    (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (j : Fin jobs) (hrt : I.release j ≤ t)
    (hu : ∃ v, I.owner v = j ∧ t ≤ S v) :
    (I.partialSlots m S (I.release j) t).card < L := by
  obtain ⟨v, hj, hv⟩ := hu
  have h := I.partial_progress hS hF hO j t hrt v hj hv
  have hbound := hL v
  rw [hj] at hbound
  omega

decl_421.name: Scheduling.Instance.prefixWork
decl_421.label: Instance.prefixWork
decl_421.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → ℕ → Finset (Fin vertices)
decl_421.source:
noncomputable def prefixWork (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (r t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => r ≤ S v ∧ S v < t ∧ I.release (I.owner v) ≤ r)

decl_422.name: Scheduling.Instance.prefixWork_card
decl_422.label: Instance.prefixWork_card
decl_422.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} (r t : ℕ),
  (I.prefixWork S r t).card = ∑ s ∈ Finset.Ico r t, (I.prefixService S r s).card
decl_422.source:
theorem prefixWork_card {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (r t : ℕ) :
    (I.prefixWork S r t).card = ∑ s ∈ Ico r t, (I.prefixService S r s).card := by
  classical
  have hf : ∀ s ∈ Ico r t,
      (I.prefixWork S r t).filter (fun v => S v = s) = I.prefixService S r s := by
    intro s hs
    have hs' := mem_Ico.mp hs
    ext v
    simp only [prefixWork, prefixService, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact ⟨h.2, h.1.2.2⟩
    · intro h; exact ⟨⟨by omega, by omega, h.2⟩, h.1⟩
  have heq : (I.prefixWork S r t).card =
      ∑ s ∈ Ico r t, ((I.prefixWork S r t).filter (fun v => S v = s)).card :=
    card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (by intro v hv; have h := (mem_filter.mp hv).2; exact mem_Ico.mpr ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩)
  rw [heq]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  rw [hf s hs]

decl_423.name: Scheduling.Instance.prefixWork_le_remaining
decl_423.label: Instance.prefixWork_le_remaining
decl_423.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} (r t : ℕ),
  (I.prefixWork S r t).card ≤ (I.remaining S r).card
decl_423.source:
theorem prefixWork_le_remaining {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (r t : ℕ) :
    (I.prefixWork S r t).card ≤ (I.remaining S r).card := by
  classical
  apply card_le_card
  intro v hv
  have h := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, h.2.2, h.1⟩

/-- Charge m units to full slots and one unit to each partial slot in a
target job's lifetime. All charges are to distinct old-prefix vertices. -/

decl_368.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifo_service_accounting
decl_368.label: Instance.fifo_service_accounting
decl_368.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m t : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    I.IsFIFO m S →
      ∀ (j : Fin jobs) (v : Fin vertices),
        I.owner v = j →
          t ≤ S v + 1 →
            m * (Finset.filter (I.PrefixFull m S (I.release j)) (Finset.Ico (I.release j) t)).card +
                (I.partialSlots m S (I.release j) t).card ≤
              (I.remaining S (I.release j)).card
decl_368.source:
theorem fifo_service_accounting {m t : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) (j : Fin jobs)
    (v : Fin vertices) (hj : I.owner v = j) (ht : t ≤ S v + 1) :
    m * ((Ico (I.release j) t).filter (I.PrefixFull m S (I.release j))).card +
      (I.partialSlots m S (I.release j) t).card ≤ (I.remaining S (I.release j)).card := by
  classical
  have hslot : ∀ s ∈ Ico (I.release j) t,
      (if I.PrefixFull m S (I.release j) s then m else 1) ≤
        (I.prefixService S (I.release j) s).card := by
    intro s hs
    have hs' := mem_Ico.mp hs
    by_cases hf : I.PrefixFull m S (I.release j) s
    · simp only [if_pos hf]; exact le_of_eq hf.symm
    · simp only [if_neg hf]
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hready⟩ := I.exists_ready (S := S) hs'.1 ⟨v, hj, by omega⟩
      have he := I.ready_processed_of_partial hS hF hf hready (by rw [hw])
      have hmem : w ∈ I.prefixService S (I.release j) s :=
        mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, he, by rw [hw]⟩
      exact card_pos.mpr ⟨w, hmem⟩
  have hsum := sum_le_sum hslot
  have heq : (∑ s ∈ Ico (I.release j) t,
      if I.PrefixFull m S (I.release j) s then m else 1) =
      m * ((Ico (I.release j) t).filter (I.PrefixFull m S (I.release j))).card +
      (I.partialSlots m S (I.release j) t).card := by
    rw [sum_ite]
    simp [partialSlots, Nat.mul_comm]
  rw [heq, ← I.prefixWork_card] at hsum
  exact hsum.trans (I.prefixWork_le_remaining _ _)

/-- Theorem 8, as a denominator-free inequality on each vertex's completion
time. It is exactly the factor m + 1 - 1/m, without rounding a rational. -/

decl_371.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifo_vertex_bound
decl_371.label: Instance.fifo_vertex_bound
decl_371.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  0 < m →
    I.Valid m S →
      I.IsFIFO m S →
        I.Valid m O →
          I.FlowBound O L → ∀ (v : Fin vertices), m * (S v + 1 - I.release (I.owner v)) ≤ (m * m + m - 1) * L
decl_371.source:
theorem fifo_vertex_bound {m L : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S)
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (v : Fin vertices) :
    m * (S v + 1 - I.release (I.owner v)) ≤ (m * m + m - 1) * L := by
  classical
  let r := I.release (I.owner v)
  let C := S v + 1
  let P := (I.partialSlots m S r C).card
  let F := ((Ico r C).filter (I.PrefixFull m S r)).card
  have hr : r ≤ S v := hS.release v
  have hp0 := I.partial_slots_lt hS hF hO hL (I.owner v) hr ⟨v, rfl, le_rfl⟩
  have hrec := I.partialSlots_succ (m := m) (S := S) hr
  have hp : P ≤ L := by
    dsimp [P, C, r]
    dsimp [r] at hrec
    split_ifs at hrec <;> omega
  have hpartition : F + P = C - r := by
    dsimp [F, P, partialSlots]
    simpa using card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := Ico r C) (I.PrefixFull m S r)
  have hwork : m * F + P ≤ m * m * L :=
    (I.fifo_service_accounting hS hF (I.owner v) v rfl (t := C) le_rfl).trans
      (I.fifo_backlog_bound hm hS hF hO hL r)
  have hm1 : m - 1 + 1 = m := by omega
  have hmul : (m - 1) * P ≤ (m - 1) * L := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hp
  have heq : (m * m + m - 1) * L = m * m * L + (m - 1) * L := by
    have haux : m * m + m - 1 = m * m + (m - 1) := by omega
    rw [haux, Nat.add_mul]
  change m * (C - r) ≤ _
  rw [← hpartition, Nat.mul_add, heq]
  nlinarith

/-- Theorem 8 for maximum flow time of a concrete FIFO schedule. -/

decl_364.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifo_maxFlow_bound
decl_364.label: Instance.fifo_maxFlow_bound
decl_364.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  0 < m → I.Valid m S → I.IsFIFO m S → I.Valid m O → I.FlowBound O L → m * I.maxFlow S ≤ (m * m + m - 1) * L
decl_364.source:
theorem fifo_maxFlow_bound {m L : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S)
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) :
    m * I.maxFlow S ≤ (m * m + m - 1) * L := by
  classical
  have hj : ∀ j, m * (I.completion S j - I.release j) ≤ (m * m + m - 1) * L := by
    intro j
    have hn : (I.jobVertices j).Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := I.nonempty_job j
      exact ⟨v, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hv⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hv, heq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup (I.jobVertices j) hn (fun v => S v + 1)
    have ho := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have h := I.fifo_vertex_bound hm hS hF hO hL v
    simpa [completion, ← heq, ho] using h
  by_cases hjobs : (univ : Finset (Fin jobs)).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨j, _, heq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup univ hjobs (fun j => I.completion S j - I.release j)
    simpa [maxFlow, ← heq] using hj j
  · have he : (univ : Finset (Fin jobs)) = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hjobs
    simp [maxFlow, he]

end Scheduling.Instance

decl_336.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoPriority
decl_336.label: Instance.fifoPriority
decl_336.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Fin vertices → Lex (ℕ × ℕ)
decl_336.source:
def fifoPriority (v : Fin vertices) : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ :=
  toLex (I.release (I.owner v), v.val)

decl_337.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoPriority_injective
decl_337.label: Instance.fifoPriority_injective
decl_337.statement: ∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices), Function.Injective I.fifoPriority
decl_337.source:
theorem fifoPriority_injective : Function.Injective I.fifoPriority := by
  intro u v he
  exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ => (ofLex x).2) he)

/-- This planner reads only the exposed ready vertices and their release
times. Hidden vertices and edges are used only by the environment below. -/

decl_348.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoSelect
decl_348.label: Instance.fifoSelect
decl_348.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → ℕ → Finset (Fin vertices) → Finset (Fin vertices)
decl_348.source:
def fifoSelect (m : ℕ) (ready : Finset (Fin vertices)) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  ready.filter (fun v => I.fifoPriority v ∈ Packing.slice (ready.image I.fifoPriority) 0 m)

decl_355.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoSelect_subset
decl_355.label: Instance.fifoSelect_subset
decl_355.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (m : ℕ) (ready : Finset (Fin vertices)),
  I.fifoSelect m ready ⊆ ready
decl_355.source:
theorem fifoSelect_subset (m : ℕ) (ready : Finset (Fin vertices)) :
    I.fifoSelect m ready ⊆ ready := filter_subset _ _

decl_351.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoSelect_image
decl_351.label: Instance.fifoSelect_image
decl_351.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (m : ℕ) (ready : Finset (Fin vertices)),
  Finset.image I.fifoPriority (I.fifoSelect m ready) = Scheduling.Packing.slice (Finset.image I.fifoPriority ready) 0 m
decl_351.source:
theorem fifoSelect_image (m : ℕ) (ready : Finset (Fin vertices)) :
    (I.fifoSelect m ready).image I.fifoPriority =
      Packing.slice (ready.image I.fifoPriority) 0 m := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
    exact (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp (Packing.slice_subset _ _ _ hx)
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨v, mem_filter.mpr ⟨hv, hx⟩, rfl⟩

decl_349.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoSelect_card
decl_349.label: Instance.fifoSelect_card
decl_349.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (m : ℕ) (ready : Finset (Fin vertices)),
  (I.fifoSelect m ready).card = min m ready.card
decl_349.source:
theorem fifoSelect_card (m : ℕ) (ready : Finset (Fin vertices)) :
    (I.fifoSelect m ready).card = min m ready.card := by
  rw [← card_image_of_injective _ I.fifoPriority_injective, I.fifoSelect_image,
    Packing.slice_card, Nat.sub_zero, card_image_of_injective _ I.fifoPriority_injective]

decl_350.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoSelect_full
decl_350.label: Instance.fifoSelect_full
decl_350.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} {ready : Finset (Fin vertices)}
  {v : Fin vertices}, v ∈ ready → v ∉ I.fifoSelect m ready → (I.fifoSelect m ready).card = m
decl_350.source:
theorem fifoSelect_full {m : ℕ} {ready : Finset (Fin vertices)} {v : Fin vertices}
    (hv : v ∈ ready) (hn : v ∉ I.fifoSelect m ready) : (I.fifoSelect m ready).card = m := by
  have hnot : I.fifoPriority v ∉ Packing.slice (ready.image I.fifoPriority) 0 m := by
    intro h; exact hn (mem_filter.mpr ⟨hv, h⟩)
  have hf := Packing.first_slice_full (mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩) hnot
  rw [← I.fifoSelect_image, card_image_of_injective _ I.fifoPriority_injective] at hf
  exact hf

decl_353.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoSelect_priority
decl_353.label: Instance.fifoSelect_priority
decl_353.source:
theorem fifoSelect_priority {m : ℕ} {ready : Finset (Fin vertices)} {u v : Fin vertices}
    (hu : u ∈ I.fifoSelect m ready) (hv : v ∈ ready) (hn : v ∉ I.fifoSelect m ready) :
    I.release (I.owner u) ≤ I.release (I.owner v) := by
  have hnot : I.fifoPriority v ∉ Packing.slice (ready.image I.fifoPriority) 0 m := by
    intro h; exact hn (mem_filter.mpr ⟨hv, h⟩)
  have hlt := Packing.first_slice_lt (mem_filter.mp hu).2 (mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩) hnot
  exact Prod.Lex.monotone_fst _ _ hlt.le

/-- Changing hidden DAGs, job ownership, or releases outside the exposed
frontier cannot affect the planner when the ready vertices and their public
release times agree. The two instances may have different numbers of jobs. -/

decl_352.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoSelect_observation_eq
decl_352.label: Instance.fifoSelect_observation_eq
decl_352.source:
theorem fifoSelect_observation_eq {otherJobs : ℕ} (J : Instance otherJobs vertices)
    (m : ℕ) (ready : Finset (Fin vertices))
    (hr : ∀ v ∈ ready, I.release (I.owner v) = J.release (J.owner v)) :
    I.fifoSelect m ready = J.fifoSelect m ready := by
  have hp : ∀ v ∈ ready, I.fifoPriority v = J.fifoPriority v := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [fifoPriority, hr v hv]
  have him : ready.image I.fifoPriority = ready.image J.fifoPriority := by
    apply image_congr
    intro v hv
    exact hp v hv
  apply filter_congr
  intro v hv
  rw [hp v hv, him]

variable [DecidableRel I.edge]

decl_338.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoReady
decl_338.label: Instance.fifoReady
decl_338.statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) → [DecidableRel I.edge] → Finset (Fin vertices) → ℕ → Finset (Fin vertices)

decl_339.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoRun
decl_339.label: Instance.fifoRun
decl_339.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) → [DecidableRel I.edge] → ℕ → ℕ → Finset (Fin vertices)

decl_325.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoAction
decl_325.label: Instance.fifoAction
decl_325.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) → [DecidableRel I.edge] → ℕ → ℕ → Finset (Fin vertices)
decl_325.source:
def fifoAction (m t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  I.fifoSelect m (I.fifoReady (I.fifoRun m t) t)

decl_340.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoRun_mono
decl_340.label: Instance.fifoRun_mono
decl_340.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] (m : ℕ),
  Monotone (I.fifoRun m)
decl_340.source:
theorem fifoRun_mono (m : ℕ) : Monotone (I.fifoRun m) := by
  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
  intro t
  exact subset_union_left

decl_328.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoAction_ready
decl_328.label: Instance.fifoAction_ready
decl_328.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m t : ℕ} {v : Fin vertices},
  v ∈ I.fifoAction m t →
    I.release (I.owner v) ≤ t ∧ v ∉ I.fifoRun m t ∧ ∀ (u : Fin vertices), I.edge u v → u ∈ I.fifoRun m t
decl_328.source:
theorem fifoAction_ready {m t : ℕ} {v : Fin vertices} (hv : v ∈ I.fifoAction m t) :
    I.release (I.owner v) ≤ t ∧ v ∉ I.fifoRun m t ∧
      ∀ u, I.edge u v → u ∈ I.fifoRun m t :=
  (mem_filter.mp (I.fifoSelect_subset _ _ hv)).2

decl_326.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoAction_card
decl_326.label: Instance.fifoAction_card
decl_326.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] (m t : ℕ),
  (I.fifoAction m t).card ≤ m
decl_326.source:
theorem fifoAction_card (m t : ℕ) : (I.fifoAction m t).card ≤ m := by
  unfold fifoAction
  rw [I.fifoSelect_card]
  exact min_le_left _ _

decl_329.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoHorizon
decl_329.label: Instance.fifoHorizon
decl_329.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → ℕ
decl_329.source: def fifoHorizon : ℕ := univ.sup I.release + vertices

decl_366.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifo_ready_exists
decl_366.label: Instance.fifo_ready_exists
decl_366.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge]
  {done : Finset (Fin vertices)} {t : ℕ},
  (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.release j ≤ t) → (∃ v, v ∉ done) → (I.fifoReady done t).Nonempty
decl_366.source:
theorem fifo_ready_exists {done : Finset (Fin vertices)} {t : ℕ}
    (hr : ∀ j, I.release j ≤ t) (hu : ∃ v, v ∉ done) : (I.fifoReady done t).Nonempty := by
  have aux : ∀ n v, I.rank v = n → v ∉ done → (I.fifoReady done t).Nonempty := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro v hv hn
      by_cases hp : ∀ u, I.edge u v → u ∈ done
      · exact ⟨v, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hr _, hn, hp⟩⟩
      · push Not at hp
        obtain ⟨u, he, hu⟩ := hp
        exact ih (I.rank u) (by have := I.rank_increases he; omega) u rfl hu
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hu
  exact aux _ v rfl hv

decl_369.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifo_step_progress
decl_369.label: Instance.fifo_step_progress
decl_369.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m t : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.release j ≤ t) →
      (∃ v, v ∉ I.fifoRun m t) → (I.fifoRun m t).card + 1 ≤ (I.fifoRun m (t + 1)).card
decl_369.source:
theorem fifo_step_progress {m t : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hr : ∀ j, I.release j ≤ t) (hu : ∃ v, v ∉ I.fifoRun m t) :
    (I.fifoRun m t).card + 1 ≤ (I.fifoRun m (t + 1)).card := by
  have hready := I.fifo_ready_exists hr hu
  have hpos : 0 < (I.fifoAction m t).card := by
    rw [fifoAction, I.fifoSelect_card]
    exact lt_min hm (card_pos.mpr hready)
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := card_pos.mp hpos
  have hn := (I.fifoAction_ready hv).2.1
  have hsub : insert v (I.fifoRun m t) ⊆ I.fifoRun m (t + 1) := by
    apply insert_subset_iff.mpr
    exact ⟨mem_union_right _ hv, I.fifoRun_mono m (by omega)⟩
  have hc := card_le_card hsub
  rw [card_insert_of_notMem hn] at hc
  exact hc

decl_370.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifo_terminates
decl_370.label: Instance.fifo_terminates
decl_370.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → ∀ (v : Fin vertices), v ∈ I.fifoRun m I.fifoHorizon
decl_370.source:
theorem fifo_terminates {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin vertices) :
    v ∈ I.fifoRun m I.fifoHorizon := by
  by_contra hv
  have hcount : ∀ k, k ≤ vertices → k ≤ (I.fifoRun m (univ.sup I.release + k)).card := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro _; omega
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk
      have hp := ih (by omega)
      have hn : v ∉ I.fifoRun m (univ.sup I.release + k) := by
        intro hvk
        exact hv (I.fifoRun_mono m (by unfold fifoHorizon; omega) hvk)
      have hr : ∀ j, I.release j ≤ univ.sup I.release + k := by
        intro j; have : I.release j ≤ univ.sup I.release := le_sup (mem_univ j); omega
      have hstep := I.fifo_step_progress hm hr ⟨v, hn⟩
      simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using (show k + 1 ≤ _ from (Nat.add_le_add_right hp 1).trans hstep)
  have hc := hcount vertices le_rfl
  have heq : I.fifoRun m I.fifoHorizon = univ :=
    eq_of_subset_of_card_le (subset_univ _) (by simpa [fifoHorizon] using hc)
  exact hv (heq ▸ mem_univ v)

decl_361.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifo_exists_done
decl_361.label: Instance.fifo_exists_done
decl_361.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → ∀ (v : Fin vertices), ∃ t, v ∈ I.fifoRun m t
decl_361.source:
theorem fifo_exists_done {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin vertices) :
    ∃ t, v ∈ I.fifoRun m t := ⟨I.fifoHorizon, I.fifo_terminates hm v⟩

/-- The execution slot is one less than the first completed-state index.
The search uses just the operational run; the finite horizon only proves
that the search terminates. -/

decl_341.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoSchedule
decl_341.label: Instance.fifoSchedule
decl_341.statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) → [DecidableRel I.edge] → (m : ℕ) → 0 < m → Scheduling.Assignment
decl_341.source:
def fifoSchedule (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : Assignment (vertices := vertices) :=
  fun v => Nat.find (I.fifo_exists_done hm v) - 1

decl_363.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifo_first_done_pos
decl_363.label: Instance.fifo_first_done_pos
decl_363.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (v : Fin vertices), 0 < Nat.find ⋯
decl_363.source:
theorem fifo_first_done_pos {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin vertices) :
    0 < Nat.find (I.fifo_exists_done hm v) := by
  have hv := Nat.find_spec (I.fifo_exists_done hm v)
  by_contra hn
  have he : Nat.find (I.fifo_exists_done hm v) = 0 := by omega
  rw [he] at hv
  simp [fifoRun] at hv

decl_360.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifo_done_iff
decl_360.label: Instance.fifo_done_iff
decl_360.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (v : Fin vertices) (t : ℕ), v ∈ I.fifoRun m t ↔ I.fifoSchedule m hm v < t
decl_360.source:
theorem fifo_done_iff {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin vertices) (t : ℕ) :
    v ∈ I.fifoRun m t ↔ I.fifoSchedule m hm v < t := by
  have hp := I.fifo_first_done_pos hm v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have hf := Nat.find_min' (I.fifo_exists_done hm v) hv
    dsimp [fifoSchedule]
    omega
  · intro hv
    have hf : Nat.find (I.fifo_exists_done hm v) ≤ t := by
      dsimp [fifoSchedule] at hv
      omega
    exact I.fifoRun_mono m hf (Nat.find_spec (I.fifo_exists_done hm v))

decl_357.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifo_action_iff
decl_357.label: Instance.fifo_action_iff
decl_357.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (v : Fin vertices) (t : ℕ), v ∈ I.fifoAction m t ↔ I.fifoSchedule m hm v = t
decl_357.source:
theorem fifo_action_iff {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin vertices) (t : ℕ) :
    v ∈ I.fifoAction m t ↔ I.fifoSchedule m hm v = t := by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have hn := (I.fifoAction_ready hv).2.1
    have hd : v ∈ I.fifoRun m (t + 1) := mem_union_right _ hv
    rw [I.fifo_done_iff hm] at hn hd
    omega
  · intro hv
    have hd : v ∈ I.fifoRun m (t + 1) := (I.fifo_done_iff hm _ _).mpr (by omega)
    have hn : v ∉ I.fifoRun m t := by rw [I.fifo_done_iff hm]; omega
    change v ∈ I.fifoRun m t ∪ I.fifoAction m t at hd
    exact (mem_union.mp hd).resolve_left hn

decl_356.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifo_action_eq
decl_356.label: Instance.fifo_action_eq
decl_356.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ),
  I.fifoAction m t = {v | I.fifoSchedule m hm v = t}
decl_356.source:
theorem fifo_action_eq {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ) :
    I.fifoAction m t = univ.filter (fun v => I.fifoSchedule m hm v = t) := by
  ext v
  simpa only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] using I.fifo_action_iff hm v t

decl_347.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoSchedule_valid
decl_347.label: Instance.fifoSchedule_valid
decl_347.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m),
  I.Valid m (I.fifoSchedule m hm)
decl_347.source:
theorem fifoSchedule_valid {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : I.Valid m (I.fifoSchedule m hm) := by
  constructor
  · intro v
    exact (I.fifoAction_ready ((I.fifo_action_iff hm _ _).mpr rfl)).1
  · intro u v he
    have hready := I.fifoAction_ready ((I.fifo_action_iff hm v _).mpr rfl)
    exact (I.fifo_done_iff hm _ _).mp (hready.2.2 u he)
  · intro t
    rw [← I.fifo_action_eq hm t]
    exact I.fifoAction_card m t

decl_367.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifo_ready_iff
decl_367.label: Instance.fifo_ready_iff
decl_367.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (v : Fin vertices) (t : ℕ), v ∈ I.fifoReady (I.fifoRun m t) t ↔ I.Ready (I.fifoSchedule m hm) t v
decl_367.source:
theorem fifo_ready_iff {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin vertices) (t : ℕ) :
    v ∈ I.fifoReady (I.fifoRun m t) t ↔ I.Ready (I.fifoSchedule m hm) t v := by
  simp only [fifoReady, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Ready, I.fifo_done_iff hm,
    Nat.not_lt]

decl_344.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoSchedule_isFIFO
decl_344.label: Instance.fifoSchedule_isFIFO
decl_344.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m),
  I.IsFIFO m (I.fifoSchedule m hm)
decl_344.source:
theorem fifoSchedule_isFIFO {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : I.IsFIFO m (I.fifoSchedule m hm) := by
  constructor
  · intro t v hv hn
    rw [← I.fifo_action_eq hm t]
    exact I.fifoSelect_full ((I.fifo_ready_iff hm _ _).mpr hv)
      (by change v ∉ I.fifoAction m t; rw [I.fifo_action_iff hm]; exact hn)
  · intro t v u hv hn hu
    exact I.fifoSelect_priority ((I.fifo_action_iff hm _ _).mpr hu)
      ((I.fifo_ready_iff hm _ _).mpr hv)
      (by change v ∉ I.fifoAction m t; rw [I.fifo_action_iff hm]; exact hn)

/-- The general FIFO bound now applies to an explicitly constructed schedule. -/

decl_343.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoSchedule_competitive
decl_343.label: Instance.fifoSchedule_competitive
decl_343.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m),
  m * I.maxFlow (I.fifoSchedule m hm) ≤ (m * m + m - 1) * I.optimum m hm
decl_343.source:
theorem fifoSchedule_competitive {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    m * I.maxFlow (I.fifoSchedule m hm) ≤ (m * m + m - 1) * I.optimum m hm :=
  I.fifo_competitive hm (I.fifoSchedule_valid hm) (I.fifoSchedule_isFIFO hm)

decl_342.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoSchedule_batched_bound
decl_342.label: Instance.fifoSchedule_batched_bound
decl_342.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m),
  0 < jobs →
    I.BatchedArrivals (I.optimum m hm) →
      I.maxFlow (I.fifoSchedule m hm) ≤ (Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m hm) + 2) * I.optimum m hm
decl_342.source:
theorem fifoSchedule_batched_bound {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hj : 0 < jobs)
    (hb : I.BatchedArrivals (I.optimum m hm)) :
    I.maxFlow (I.fifoSchedule m hm) ≤
      (Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m hm) + 2) * I.optimum m hm :=
  I.batched_fifo_competitive hm hj hb (I.fifoSchedule_valid hm) (I.fifoSchedule_isFIFO hm)

end Scheduling.Instance

decl_765.name: Scheduling.StarChain.consistent_flow_lower
decl_765.label: StarChain.consistent_flow_lower
decl_765.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m),
  jobs = (3 * (m - 1) + 1) * m * m →
    ∀ (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (S : Scheduling.Assignment),
      (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long ⋯).Valid m S →
        (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long ⋯).IsFIFO m S →
          (∀ (j : Fin jobs), Scheduling.StarChain.TypeConsistent long ⋯ S j) →
            3 * (m - 1) ≤ (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long ⋯).maxFlow S
decl_765.source:
theorem consistent_flow_lower {jobs m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (hn : jobs = (3 * (m - 1) + 1) * m * m)
    (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (3 * m)))
    (hS : (toInstance long (show 0 < m by omega)).Valid m S)
    (hfifo : (toInstance long (show 0 < m by omega)).IsFIFO m S)
    (hc : ∀ j, TypeConsistent long (show 0 < m by omega) S j) :
    3 * (m - 1) ≤ (toInstance long (show 0 < m by omega)).maxFlow S := by
  let I := toInstance long (show 0 < m by omega)
  let B := 3 * (m - 1) + 1
  let N := 3 * m * m
  have hB : 0 < B := by dsimp [B]; omega
  by_contra hh
  change ¬ 3 * (m - 1) ≤ I.maxFlow S at hh
  have hflow : I.FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)) :=
    (I.flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le S _).mpr (by omega)
  have hidle : ∀ k < N, I.epochWork S B k < m * B := by
    intro k _
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hidle⟩ := block_has_idle hS hfifo hflow hc (k * B)
    have ht' : t ∈ Ico (k * B) ((k + 1) * B) := by
      simpa only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] using ht
    exact I.epochWork_lt_of_idle hS hB ht' hidle
  have hacc : N ≤ Accounting.idleBacklog (m * B) (I.epochWork S B) N := by
    simpa only [Nat.one_mul] using
      Accounting.forcing_epochs_accumulate (c := 1) (K := N) (by omega)
        (by simpa only [Nat.one_mul] using hidle)
  have hvcount : jobs * (3 * m) = N * (m * B) := by rw [hn]; dsimp [N, B]; ring
  have htime : N * B = jobs * 3 := by rw [hn]; dsimp [N, B]; ring
  rw [I.idleBacklog_eq_remaining hS hB hvcount, htime] at hacc
  have hcj : m - 1 ≤ jobs := by
    have hprod := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (m * m) (show 1 ≤ B from hB)
    have hm2 : m ≤ m * m := by nlinarith
    change jobs = B * m * m at hn
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc] at hn
    simp only [Nat.one_mul] at hprod
    omega
  have hwork : ∀ j, (I.jobVertices j).card = m * 3 := by
    intro j
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using jobVertices_card long (show 0 < m by omega) j
  have hflow' : I.FlowBound S ((m - 1) * 3) := by
    simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using hflow
  have hy := I.regular_young_backlog hcj (by omega : 0 < 3) (by intros; rfl) hwork hflow'
  have hsub : m - 1 - 1 + 2 = m := by omega
  change 3 * m * m ≤ _ at hacc
  nlinarith

end Scheduling.StarChain

namespace Scheduling

/-- The FIFO lower bound on trees with constant optimum. The finite
instance is derived from the scheduler's causality and FIFO properties;
no adaptive trace or type-consistency premise remains in the conclusion. -/

decl_830.name: Scheduling.fifo_constant_optimum_lower
decl_830.label:
Theorem 3
FIFO lower bound at constant OPT
decl_830.statement:
∀ {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m),
  (∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices), I.IsFIFO m (A.schedule I)) →
    ∃ jobs vertices I,
      (∀ (u v w : Fin vertices), I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
        I.optimum m ⋯ ≤ 6 ∧ 3 * (m - 1) ≤ I.maxFlow (A.schedule I)
decl_830.source:
theorem fifo_constant_optimum_lower {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (hfifo : ∀ {jobs vertices} (I : Instance jobs vertices), I.IsFIFO m (A.schedule I)) :
    ∃ (jobs vertices : ℕ) (I : Instance jobs vertices),
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 6 ∧
      3 * (m - 1) ≤ I.maxFlow (A.schedule I) := by
  let n := (3 * (m - 1) + 1) * m * m
  obtain ⟨long, hc⟩ := StarChain.exists_type_consistent A (show 0 < m by omega) n
  let I := StarChain.toInstance long (show 0 < m by omega)
  refine ⟨n, n * (3 * m), I, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u v w hu hv
    exact StarChain.at_most_one_parent long (show 0 < m by omega) hu hv
  · exact StarChain.optimum_le_six long hm
  · exact StarChain.consistent_flow_lower hm rfl long (A.schedule I) (A.valid I) (hfifo I) hc

decl_829.name: Scheduling.fifo_competitive_lower
decl_829.label: fifo_competitive_lower
decl_829.statement:
∀ {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m),
  (∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices), I.IsFIFO m (A.schedule I)) →
    ∃ jobs vertices I,
      (∀ (u v w : Fin vertices), I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
        I.optimum m ⋯ ≤ 6 ∧ m * I.optimum m ⋯ ≤ 4 * I.maxFlow (A.schedule I)
decl_829.source:
theorem fifo_competitive_lower {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (hfifo : ∀ {jobs vertices} (I : Instance jobs vertices), I.IsFIFO m (A.schedule I)) :
    ∃ (jobs vertices : ℕ) (I : Instance jobs vertices),
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 6 ∧
      m * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 4 * I.maxFlow (A.schedule I) := by
  obtain ⟨jobs, vertices, I, htree, hopt, hflow⟩ := fifo_constant_optimum_lower hm A hfifo
  refine ⟨jobs, vertices, I, htree, hopt, ?_⟩
  have hm1 : m - 1 + 1 = m := by omega
  nlinarith

end Scheduling

decl_210.name: Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.safeWords
decl_210.label: FiniteAmplification.safeWords
decl_210.statement: {α : Type u_1} → [Fintype α] → (List α → Prop) → (k : ℕ) → Finset (Fin k → α)
decl_210.source:
noncomputable def safeWords (bad : List α → Prop) (k : ℕ) : Finset (Fin k → α) :=
  univ.filter (fun w => ¬ bad (List.ofFn w))

decl_213.name: Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.safe_next_card
decl_213.label: FiniteAmplification.safe_next_card
decl_213.statement:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (bad : List α → Prop) (xs : List α),
  (∃ x, bad (xs ++ [x])) → {x | ¬bad (xs ++ [x])}.card ≤ Fintype.card α - 1
decl_213.source:
theorem safe_next_card (bad : List α → Prop) (xs : List α)
    (hnext : ∃ x, bad (xs ++ [x])) :
    (univ.filter (fun x => ¬ bad (xs ++ [x]))).card ≤ Fintype.card α - 1 := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hnext
  have hs : univ.filter (fun x => ¬ bad (xs ++ [x])) ⊂ univ := by
    apply ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr
    refine ⟨filter_subset _ _, ?_⟩
    intro he
    have hm : x ∈ univ.filter (fun x => ¬ bad (xs ++ [x])) := by rw [he]; exact mem_univ x
    exact (mem_filter.mp hm).2 hx
  have hh := card_lt_card hs
  rw [card_univ] at hh
  omega

decl_212.name: Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.safe_card_step
decl_212.label: FiniteAmplification.safe_card_step
decl_212.statement:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (bad : List α → Prop),
  (∀ (xs : List α) (x : α), bad xs → bad (xs ++ [x])) →
    (∀ (xs : List α), ∃ x, bad (xs ++ [x])) →
      ∀ (k : ℕ),
        (Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.safeWords bad (k + 1)).card ≤
          (Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.safeWords bad k).card * (Fintype.card α - 1)
decl_212.source:
theorem safe_card_step (bad : List α → Prop)
    (hpersist : ∀ xs x, bad xs → bad (xs ++ [x]))
    (hnext : ∀ xs, ∃ x, bad (xs ++ [x])) (k : ℕ) :
    (safeWords bad (k + 1)).card ≤ (safeWords bad k).card * (Fintype.card α - 1) := by
  have hprefix : ∀ w ∈ safeWords bad (k + 1), Fin.init w ∈ safeWords bad k := by
    intro w hw
    apply mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    intro hb
    have hh := hpersist (List.ofFn (Fin.init w)) (w (Fin.last k)) hb
    have he : List.ofFn w = List.ofFn (Fin.init w) ++ [w (Fin.last k)] := List.ofFn_succ_last
    rw [← he] at hh
    exact (mem_filter.mp hw).2 hh
  rw [card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := Fin.init) hprefix]
  have hf : ∀ w ∈ safeWords bad k,
      ((safeWords bad (k + 1)).filter (fun v => Fin.init v = w)).card ≤ Fintype.card α - 1 := by
    intro w _
    have hi := card_le_card_of_injOn (fun v : Fin (k + 1) → α => v (Fin.last k))
      (s := (safeWords bad (k + 1)).filter (fun v => Fin.init v = w))
      (t := univ.filter (fun x => ¬ bad (List.ofFn w ++ [x])))
      (by
        intro v hv
        obtain ⟨hv, he⟩ := mem_filter.mp hv
        apply mem_filter.mpr
        refine ⟨mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        have hh := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
        have hseq : List.ofFn v = List.ofFn (Fin.init v) ++ [v (Fin.last k)] := List.ofFn_succ_last
        rwa [hseq, he] at hh)
      (by
        intro u hu v hv he
        have hup := (mem_filter.mp hu).2
        have hvp := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
        change u (Fin.last k) = v (Fin.last k) at he
        calc
          u = Fin.snoc (Fin.init u) (u (Fin.last k)) := (Fin.snoc_init_self u).symm
          _ = Fin.snoc (Fin.init v) (v (Fin.last k)) := by rw [hup, hvp, he]
          _ = v := Fin.snoc_init_self v)
    exact hi.trans (safe_next_card bad (List.ofFn w) (hnext _))
  have hh := sum_le_sum hf
  simpa only [sum_const, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul] using hh

decl_211.name: Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.safe_card_le
decl_211.label: FiniteAmplification.safe_card_le
decl_211.statement:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (bad : List α → Prop),
  (∀ (xs : List α) (x : α), bad xs → bad (xs ++ [x])) →
    (∀ (xs : List α), ∃ x, bad (xs ++ [x])) →
      ∀ (k : ℕ), (Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.safeWords bad k).card ≤ (Fintype.card α - 1) ^ k
decl_211.source:
theorem safe_card_le (bad : List α → Prop)
    (hpersist : ∀ xs x, bad xs → bad (xs ++ [x]))
    (hnext : ∀ xs, ∃ x, bad (xs ++ [x])) (k : ℕ) :
    (safeWords bad k).card ≤ (Fintype.card α - 1) ^ k := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have hh := card_le_card (filter_subset (fun w : Fin 0 → α => ¬ bad (List.ofFn w)) univ)
    simpa only [safeWords, card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, pow_zero] using hh
  | succ k ih =>
    exact (safe_card_step bad hpersist hnext k).trans
      (by simpa only [pow_succ] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (Fintype.card α - 1) ih)

decl_209.name: Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.pow_succ_first_terms
decl_209.label: FiniteAmplification.pow_succ_first_terms
decl_209.source:
theorem pow_succ_first_terms (x k : ℕ) :
    x ^ (k + 1) + (k + 1) * x ^ k ≤ (x + 1) ^ (k + 1) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (x + 1) ih
    calc
      x ^ (k + 1 + 1) + (k + 1 + 1) * x ^ (k + 1) ≤
          x ^ (k + 1 + 1) + (k + 1 + 1) * x ^ (k + 1) + (k + 1) * x ^ k := Nat.le_add_right _ _
      _ = (x ^ (k + 1) + (k + 1) * x ^ k) * (x + 1) := by rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]; ring
      _ ≤ (x + 1) ^ (k + 1 + 1) := by simpa only [pow_succ] using hh

decl_214.name: Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.twice_pred_pow_le
decl_214.label: FiniteAmplification.twice_pred_pow_le
decl_214.source:
theorem twice_pred_pow_le {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) : 2 * (N - 1) ^ N ≤ N ^ N := by
  have hn : N - 1 + 1 = N := by omega
  have hh := pow_succ_first_terms (N - 1) (N - 1)
  rw [hn] at hh
  have hp : (N - 1) ^ N = (N - 1) ^ (N - 1) * (N - 1) := by
    calc
      (N - 1) ^ N = (N - 1) ^ (N - 1 + 1) := by rw [hn]
      _ = _ := pow_succ _ _
  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right ((N - 1) ^ (N - 1)) (Nat.sub_le N 1)
  nlinarith

/-- Uniformly sampling `N` symbols from an alphabet of size `N` reaches
a bad word with probability at least one half. This is the exact finite
counting statement, with no independence or conditioning premise. -/

decl_208.name: Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.half_words_bad
decl_208.label:
Finite amplification
At least half the words are bad
decl_208.statement:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [Nonempty α] (bad : List α → Prop),
  (∀ (xs : List α) (x : α), bad xs → bad (xs ++ [x])) →
    (∀ (xs : List α), ∃ x, bad (xs ++ [x])) → Fintype.card α ^ Fintype.card α ≤ 2 * {w | bad (List.ofFn w)}.card
decl_208.source:
theorem half_words_bad [Nonempty α] (bad : List α → Prop)
    (hpersist : ∀ xs x, bad xs → bad (xs ++ [x]))
    (hnext : ∀ xs, ∃ x, bad (xs ++ [x])) :
    Fintype.card α ^ Fintype.card α ≤
      2 * (univ.filter (fun w : Fin (Fintype.card α) → α => bad (List.ofFn w))).card := by
  have hs := safe_card_le bad hpersist hnext (Fintype.card α)
  have hp := twice_pred_pow_le (Fintype.card_pos (α := α))
  have hpartition := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (univ : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card α) → α)))
    (fun w => bad (List.ofFn w))
  simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin] at hpartition
  change (univ.filter (fun w : Fin (Fintype.card α) → α => ¬ bad (List.ofFn w))).card ≤ _ at hs
  omega

decl_206.name: Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.cost_sum_lower
decl_206.label: FiniteAmplification.cost_sum_lower
decl_206.statement:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [Nonempty α] (cost : List α → ℕ) (F : ℕ),
  (∀ (xs : List α) (x : α), F ≤ cost xs → F ≤ cost (xs ++ [x])) →
    (∀ (xs : List α), ∃ x, F ≤ cost (xs ++ [x])) →
      Fintype.card (Fin (Fintype.card α) → α) * F ≤ 2 * ∑ w, cost (List.ofFn w)
decl_206.source:
theorem cost_sum_lower [Nonempty α] (cost : List α → ℕ) (F : ℕ)
    (hpersist : ∀ xs x, F ≤ cost xs → F ≤ cost (xs ++ [x]))
    (hnext : ∀ xs, ∃ x, F ≤ cost (xs ++ [x])) :
    Fintype.card (Fin (Fintype.card α) → α) * F ≤
      2 * ∑ w : Fin (Fintype.card α) → α, cost (List.ofFn w) := by
  have hb := half_words_bad (fun xs => F ≤ cost xs) hpersist hnext
  let s := univ.filter (fun w : Fin (Fintype.card α) → α => F ≤ cost (List.ofFn w))
  have hs : s.card * F ≤ ∑ w ∈ s, cost (List.ofFn w) := by
    calc
      s.card * F = ∑ _w ∈ s, F := by simp
      _ ≤ _ := sum_le_sum (fun w hw => (mem_filter.mp hw).2)
  have ht : ∑ w ∈ s, cost (List.ofFn w) ≤ ∑ w : Fin (Fintype.card α) → α, cost (List.ofFn w) :=
    sum_le_sum_of_subset (filter_subset _ _)
  have hb' : Fintype.card α ^ Fintype.card α ≤ 2 * s.card := by
    convert hb using 1
    congr 2
    ext w
    simp [s]
  have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_right F hb'
  rw [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin]
  nlinarith

end Scheduling.FiniteAmplification

decl_317.name: Scheduling.Instance.ext_data
decl_317.label: Instance.ext_data
decl_317.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} {I J : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices},
  I.owner = J.owner → I.release = J.release → I.edge = J.edge → I.rank = J.rank → I = J
decl_317.source:
theorem Instance.ext_data {jobs vertices : ℕ} {I J : Instance jobs vertices}
    (ho : I.owner = J.owner) (hr : I.release = J.release)
    (he : I.edge = J.edge) (hk : I.rank = J.rank) : I = J := by
  cases I
  cases J
  cases ho
  cases hr
  cases he
  cases hk
  rfl

/-- A finite encoding of an out-forest on fixed job and vertex labels.
The local vertex order witnesses acyclicity. Releases are supplied
separately, so this code contains no unbounded numerical data. -/

decl_219.name: Scheduling.ForestCode
decl_219.label: ForestCode
decl_219.source:
structure ForestCode (jobs work : ℕ) where
  parent : Fin jobs → Fin work → Option (Fin work)
  parent_lt : ∀ j v u, parent j v = some u → u.val < v.val

namespace ForestCode
variable {jobs work : ℕ}

decl_224.name: Scheduling.ForestCode.parent_injective
decl_224.label: ForestCode.parent_injective
decl_224.source:
theorem parent_injective : Function.Injective (parent : ForestCode jobs work → _) := by
  intro P Q he
  cases P
  cases Q
  cases he
  rfl

noncomputable instance : Fintype (ForestCode jobs work) :=
  Fintype.ofInjective parent parent_injective

noncomputable instance : DecidableEq (ForestCode jobs work) := Classical.decEq _

decl_225.name: Scheduling.ForestCode.toInstance
decl_225.label: ForestCode.toInstance
decl_225.statement: {jobs work : ℕ} → Scheduling.ForestCode jobs work → ℕ → 0 < work → Scheduling.Instance jobs (jobs * work)
decl_225.source:
def toInstance (P : ForestCode jobs work) (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work) : Instance jobs (jobs * work) where
  owner := job
  release j := j.val * L
  edge u v := job u = job v ∧ P.parent (job v) (position v) = some (position u)
  same_job h := h.1
  rank v := (position v).val
  rank_increases := by intro u v h; exact P.parent_lt _ _ _ h.2
  nonempty_job j := ⟨finProdFinEquiv (j, ⟨0, hw⟩), LayeredForest.job_pair _ _⟩

decl_223.name: Scheduling.ForestCode.outForest
decl_223.label: ForestCode.outForest
decl_223.statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (P : Scheduling.ForestCode jobs work) (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work) {u v w : Fin (jobs * work)},
  (P.toInstance L hw).edge u w → (P.toInstance L hw).edge v w → u = v
decl_223.source:
theorem outForest (P : ForestCode jobs work) (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work)
    {u v w : Fin (jobs * work)}
    (hu : (P.toInstance L hw).edge u w) (hv : (P.toInstance L hw).edge v w) : u = v := by
  have hp := Option.some.inj (hu.2.symm.trans hv.2)
  exact LayeredForest.coordinates_injective
    (Prod.ext (hu.1.trans hv.1.symm) (congrArg Fin.val hp))

decl_221.name: Scheduling.ForestCode.ofPrefix
decl_221.label: ForestCode.ofPrefix
decl_221.statement: {jobs work : ℕ} → Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs work → Scheduling.ForestCode jobs work
decl_221.source:
def ofPrefix (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work) : ForestCode jobs work :=
  ⟨P.parent, P.parent_lt⟩

decl_222.name: Scheduling.ForestCode.ofPrefix_toInstance
decl_222.label: ForestCode.ofPrefix_toInstance
decl_222.statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (P : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs work) (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work),
  (∀ (j : Fin jobs), P.closed j = work) → (Scheduling.ForestCode.ofPrefix P).toInstance L hw = P.toInstance L hw
decl_222.source:
theorem ofPrefix_toInstance (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work) (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work)
    (hd : ∀ j, P.closed j = work) : (ofPrefix P).toInstance L hw = P.toInstance L hw := by
  apply Instance.ext_data (I := (ofPrefix P).toInstance L hw) (J := P.toInstance L hw) rfl rfl ?_ rfl
  funext u v
  apply propext
  have hv : (position v).val < P.boundary (job v) := by
    have hh := (position v).isLt
    dsimp only [LayeredPrefix.boundary]
    rw [hd]
    omega
  simp only [toInstance, ofPrefix, LayeredPrefix.toInstance, if_pos hv]

decl_220.name: Scheduling.ForestCode.jobVertices_card
decl_220.label: ForestCode.jobVertices_card
decl_220.statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (P : Scheduling.ForestCode jobs work) (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work) (j : Fin jobs),
  ((P.toInstance L hw).jobVertices j).card = work
decl_220.source:
theorem jobVertices_card (P : ForestCode jobs work) (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work) (j : Fin jobs) :
    ((P.toInstance L hw).jobVertices j).card = work := by
  let Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work := {
    closed := fun _ => work
    width := fun _ => 0
    fits := by simp
    frontier_pos := by intros; omega
    parent := P.parent
    parent_lt := P.parent_lt }
  have he : (ofPrefix Q).toInstance L hw = P.toInstance L hw := rfl
  rw [← he, ofPrefix_toInstance Q L hw (by intros; rfl)]
  exact Q.jobVertices_card L hw j

end ForestCode
end Scheduling

decl_578.name: Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.change_rule
decl_578.label: LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.change_rule
decl_578.statement:
∀ {jobs work m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m}
  {rule : Scheduling.LayerSizeRule jobs work} {P Q : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs work}
  {records : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)},
  Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun hw A rule P Q records →
    ∀ (rule' : Scheduling.LayerSizeRule jobs work),
      (∀ (j : Fin jobs) (p t : ℕ), P.closed j < p → p ≤ work → rule.size j p t = rule'.size j p t) →
        Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun hw A rule' P Q records
decl_578.source:
theorem RecordedRun.change_rule {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work}
    {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records)
    (rule' : LayerSizeRule jobs work)
    (hagree : ∀ j p t, P.closed j < p → p ≤ work → rule.size j p t = rule'.size j p t) :
    RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule' P Q records := by
  induction h with
  | done P hd => exact RecordedRun.done P hd
  | step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    let t := A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1
    have he : rule.size j (P.boundary j) t = rule'.size j (P.boundary j) t :=
      hagree j _ t (by omega) (P.fits j)
    have ht := ih (by
      intro i p u hp hwork
      apply hagree i p u ?_ hwork
      have hclosed : P.closed i ≤
          (P.advance j key hk (rule.size j (P.boundary j) t)
            (rule.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)) (rule.positive _ _ _)).closed i := by
        by_cases hi : i = j
        · subst i
          rw [advance_closed]
          dsimp [boundary]
          omega
        · simp only [advance, if_neg hi, le_refl]
      dsimp [t] at hclosed
      omega)
    have hstate : P.advance j key hk (rule.size j (P.boundary j) t)
        (rule.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)) (rule.positive _ _ _) =
      P.advance j key hk (rule'.size j (P.boundary j) t)
        (rule'.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)) (rule'.positive _ _ _) := by
      congr 1
    change RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule' _ Q records at ht
    rw [hstate] at ht
    exact RecordedRun.step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records ht

/-- A chronological hidden-key construction whose next width can depend
on the entire current state and execution history, rather than just the
job, prefix length, and reveal time. -/

decl_571.name: Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.FlexibleRun
decl_571.label: LayeredPrefix.FlexibleRun
decl_571.statement:
{jobs work m : ℕ} →
  0 < work →
    Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m →
      ℕ →
        Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs work →
          Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs work → List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work) → Prop
decl_571.source:
inductive FlexibleRun (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (L : ℕ) :
    LayeredPrefix jobs work → LayeredPrefix jobs work → List (LayerRecord jobs work) → Prop
  | done (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work) (h : ∀ j, P.closed j = work) :
      FlexibleRun hw A L P P []
  | step (P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work) (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
      (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
      (hmax : ∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v ≤
        A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)))
      (hearliest : ∀ i, P.closed i < work →
        A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) ≤ P.finishTime (L := L) hw A i)
      (q : ℕ) (hq : P.boundary j + q ≤ work) (hp : P.boundary j < work → 0 < q)
      (records : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
      (tail : FlexibleRun hw A L (P.advance j key hk q hq hp) Q records) :
      FlexibleRun hw A L P Q (P.record (L := L) hw A j key :: records)

/-- After a finite adaptive construction, its choices can be encoded in
a static rule. This transfers all previously proved chronological,
parent-edge, coverage, and key-last certificates to history-dependent
width choices. -/

decl_572.name: Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.FlexibleRun.recorded
decl_572.label: LayeredPrefix.FlexibleRun.recorded
decl_572.statement:
∀ {jobs work m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m}
  {P Q : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)},
  Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.FlexibleRun hw A L P Q records →
    ∃ rule, Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun hw A rule P Q records
decl_572.source:
theorem FlexibleRun.recorded {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work}
    {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)} (h : FlexibleRun hw A L P Q records) :
    ∃ rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work, RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records := by
  induction h with
  | done P hd =>
    let rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work := {
      size := fun _ p _ => min 1 (work - p)
      fits := by intro j p t hp; have := min_le_right 1 (work - p); omega
      positive := by intro j p t hp; exact lt_min (by omega) (by omega) }
    exact ⟨rule, RecordedRun.done P hd⟩
  | step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest q hq hp records tail ih =>
    obtain ⟨rule, hr⟩ := ih
    let rule' : LayerSizeRule jobs work := {
      size := fun i p t => if i = j ∧ p = P.boundary j then q else rule.size i p t
      fits := by
        intro i p t hwork
        split_ifs with he
        · simpa only [he.2] using hq
        · exact rule.fits i p t hwork
      positive := by
        intro i p t hwork
        split_ifs with he
        · exact hp (by omega)
        · exact rule.positive i p t hwork }
    have hr' := hr.change_rule rule' (by
      intro i p t hclosed hwork
      have hn : ¬ (i = j ∧ p = P.boundary j) := by
        rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        rw [advance_closed] at hclosed
        omega
      simp only [rule', if_neg hn])
    have hsize : rule'.size j (P.boundary j)
        (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1) = q := by
      simp only [rule', and_self, if_true]
    have hstate : P.advance j key hk q hq hp =
      P.advance j key hk
        (rule'.size j (P.boundary j) (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1))
        (rule'.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)) (rule'.positive _ _ _) := by
      congr 1
      exact hsize.symm
    rw [hstate] at hr'
    exact ⟨rule', RecordedRun.step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records hr'⟩

/-- The history supplied to the rule includes the layer just completed.
Its records contain the actual key timestamps, so a rule can reset its
counters at epoch boundaries and inspect earlier layer types. -/

decl_573.name: Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryLayerRule
decl_573.label: LayeredPrefix.HistoryLayerRule
decl_573.source:
structure HistoryLayerRule (jobs work : ℕ) where
  size : List (LayerRecord jobs work) → LayeredPrefix jobs work → Fin jobs → ℕ → ℕ
  fits : ∀ history P j t, P.boundary j + size history P j t ≤ work
  positive : ∀ history P j t, P.boundary j < work → 0 < size history P j t

decl_574.name: Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun
decl_574.label: LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun
decl_574.statement:
{jobs work m : ℕ} →
  0 < work →
    Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m →
      ℕ →
        Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryLayerRule jobs work →
          List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work) →
            Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs work →
              Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs work → List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work) → Prop
decl_574.source:
inductive HistoryRun (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (L : ℕ)
    (rule : HistoryLayerRule jobs work) : List (LayerRecord jobs work) →
    LayeredPrefix jobs work → LayeredPrefix jobs work → List (LayerRecord jobs work) → Prop
  | done (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work)
      (h : ∀ j, P.closed j = work) : HistoryRun hw A L rule history P P []
  | step (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work)
      (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
      (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
      (hmax : ∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v ≤
        A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)))
      (hearliest : ∀ i, P.closed i < work →
        A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) ≤ P.finishTime (L := L) hw A i)
      (records : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
      (tail : HistoryRun hw A L rule (history ++ [P.record (L := L) hw A j key])
        (P.advance j key hk
          (rule.size (history ++ [P.record (L := L) hw A j key]) P j
            (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1))
          (rule.fits _ _ _ _) (rule.positive _ _ _ _)) Q records) :
      HistoryRun hw A L rule history P Q (P.record (L := L) hw A j key :: records)

decl_575.name: Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun.flexible
decl_575.label: LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun.flexible
decl_575.source:
theorem HistoryRun.flexible {rule : HistoryLayerRule jobs work}
    {history records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work}
    (h : HistoryRun hw A L rule history P Q records) : FlexibleRun hw A L P Q records := by
  induction h with
  | done history P hd => exact FlexibleRun.done P hd
  | step history P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    exact FlexibleRun.step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest _ _ _ records ih

/-- Arbitrary history-dependent width rules terminate, provided every
unfinished job receives a nonempty frontier within its remaining budget. -/

decl_619.name: Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.exists_history_run
decl_619.label: LayeredPrefix.exists_history_run
decl_619.statement:
∀ {jobs work m : ℕ} (rule : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryLayerRule jobs work)
  (history : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (P : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs work) (hw : 0 < work)
  (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) (L : ℕ),
  ∃ Q records, Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun hw A L rule history P Q records
decl_619.source:
theorem exists_history_run (rule : HistoryLayerRule jobs work)
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work)
    (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (L : ℕ) :
    ∃ Q records, HistoryRun hw A L rule history P Q records := by
  have aux : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ history (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work), P.remainingMass = n →
      ∃ Q records, HistoryRun hw A L rule history P Q records := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro history P hn
      by_cases ha : ∃ j, P.closed j < work
      · obtain ⟨j, key, hk, hmax, hearliest⟩ := P.exists_earliest (L := L) hw A ha
        let next := history ++ [P.record (L := L) hw A j key]
        let t := A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1
        let q := rule.size next P j t
        let R := P.advance j key hk q (rule.fits _ _ _ _) (rule.positive _ _ _ _)
        have hlt : R.remainingMass < n := by
          rw [← hn]
          exact P.advance_mass_lt j key hk q _ _
        obtain ⟨Q, records, hQ⟩ := ih R.remainingMass hlt next R rfl
        exact ⟨Q, _, HistoryRun.step history P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records hQ⟩
      · have hd : ∀ j, P.closed j = work := by
          intro j
          have hf := P.fits j
          have hh : ¬ P.closed j < work := fun h => ha ⟨j, h⟩
          omega
        exact ⟨P, [], HistoryRun.done history P hd⟩
  exact aux P.remainingMass history P rfl

decl_618.name: Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.exists_history_certificates
decl_618.label: LayeredPrefix.exists_history_certificates
decl_618.statement:
∀ {jobs work m : ℕ} (rule : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryLayerRule jobs work)
  (P : Scheduling.LayeredPrefix jobs work) (hw : 0 < work) (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) (L : ℕ),
  ∃ Q records,
    Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun hw A L rule [] P Q records ∧
      ∃ staticRule, Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun hw A staticRule P Q records
decl_618.source:
theorem exists_history_certificates (rule : HistoryLayerRule jobs work)
    (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work) (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (L : ℕ) :
    ∃ Q records, HistoryRun hw A L rule [] P Q records ∧
      ∃ staticRule, RecordedRun (L := L) hw A staticRule P Q records := by
  obtain ⟨Q, records, h⟩ := exists_history_run rule [] P hw A L
  exact ⟨Q, records, h, h.flexible.recorded⟩

end Scheduling.LayeredPrefix

decl_215.name: Scheduling.ForcingTrace
decl_215.label: ForcingTrace
decl_215.statement: {work : ℕ} → (Fin work → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop
decl_215.source:
inductive ForcingTrace {work : ℕ} (S : Fin work → ℕ) (a b W : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop
  | done (e : ℕ) : ForcingTrace S a b W work e
  | layer (s d e t : ℕ) (hsd : s < d) (hd : d ≤ work) (het : e ≤ t)
      (hwidth : d - s ≤ W) (hnarrow : a < e → e < b → d - s ≤ 1)
      (htimes : ∀ v : Fin work, s ≤ v.val → v.val < d → e ≤ S v ∧ S v ≤ t)
      (tail : ForcingTrace S a b W d (t + 1)) : ForcingTrace S a b W s e

decl_896.name: Scheduling.suffixService
decl_896.label: suffixService
decl_896.statement: {work : ℕ} → (Fin work → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ
decl_896.source:
noncomputable def suffixService {work : ℕ} (S : Fin work → ℕ) (a b s : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter (fun v => s ≤ v.val ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)).card

decl_847.name: Scheduling.layerService
decl_847.label: layerService
decl_847.statement: {work : ℕ} → (Fin work → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ
decl_847.source:
noncomputable def layerService {work : ℕ} (S : Fin work → ℕ) (a b s d : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter (fun v => s ≤ v.val ∧ v.val < d ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)).card

decl_897.name: Scheduling.suffixService_split
decl_897.label: suffixService_split
decl_897.statement:
∀ {work : ℕ} (S : Fin work → ℕ) (a b s d : ℕ),
  s ≤ d → Scheduling.suffixService S a b s = Scheduling.layerService S a b s d + Scheduling.suffixService S a b d
decl_897.source:
theorem suffixService_split {work : ℕ} (S : Fin work → ℕ) (a b s d : ℕ) (hsd : s ≤ d) :
    suffixService S a b s = layerService S a b s d + suffixService S a b d := by
  classical
  let R := univ.filter (fun v : Fin work => s ≤ v.val ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)
  have h := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := R) (fun v => v.val < d)
  have h₁ : R.filter (fun v => v.val < d) =
      univ.filter (fun v => s ≤ v.val ∧ v.val < d ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b) := by
    ext v; simp only [R, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]; tauto
  have h₂ : R.filter (fun v => ¬ v.val < d) =
      univ.filter (fun v => d ≤ v.val ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b) := by
    ext v
    simp only [R, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, not_lt]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨_, ha, hb⟩, hd⟩; exact ⟨hd, ha, hb⟩
    · rintro ⟨hd, ha, hb⟩; exact ⟨⟨hsd.trans hd, ha, hb⟩, hd⟩
  rw [h₁, h₂] at h
  exact h.symm

decl_848.name: Scheduling.layerService_le_width
decl_848.label: layerService_le_width
decl_848.statement: ∀ {work : ℕ} (S : Fin work → ℕ) (a b s d : ℕ), Scheduling.layerService S a b s d ≤ d - s
decl_848.source:
theorem layerService_le_width {work : ℕ} (S : Fin work → ℕ) (a b s d : ℕ) :
    layerService S a b s d ≤ d - s := by
  classical
  have h := card_le_card_of_injOn Fin.val
    (s := univ.filter (fun v : Fin work => s ≤ v.val ∧ v.val < d ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b))
    (t := Ico s d) (by intro v hv; exact mem_Ico.mpr ⟨(mem_filter.mp hv).2.1, (mem_filter.mp hv).2.2.1⟩)
    (by intro u _ v _ he; exact Fin.ext he)
  simpa [layerService] using h

namespace ForcingTrace
variable {work a b W s e : ℕ} {S : Fin work → ℕ}

decl_216.name: Scheduling.ForcingTrace.execution_lower
decl_216.label: ForcingTrace.execution_lower
decl_216.statement: ∀ {work a b W s e : ℕ} {S : Fin work → ℕ}, Scheduling.ForcingTrace S a b W s e → ∀ (v : Fin work), s ≤ ↑v → e ≤ S v
decl_216.source:
theorem execution_lower (h : ForcingTrace S a b W s e) :
    ∀ v : Fin work, s ≤ v.val → e ≤ S v := by
  induction h with
  | done e => intro v hv; have := v.isLt; omega
  | layer s d e t hsd hd het hwidth hnarrow htimes tail ih =>
    intro v hv
    by_cases hvd : v.val < d
    · exact (htimes v hv hvd).1
    · have ht := ih v (by omega)
      omega

decl_218.name: Scheduling.ForcingTrace.service_zero
decl_218.label: ForcingTrace.service_zero
decl_218.statement:
∀ {work a b W s e : ℕ} {S : Fin work → ℕ},
  Scheduling.ForcingTrace S a b W s e → b ≤ e → Scheduling.suffixService S a b s = 0
decl_218.source:
theorem service_zero (h : ForcingTrace S a b W s e) (hb : b ≤ e) : suffixService S a b s = 0 := by
  unfold suffixService
  apply card_eq_zero.mpr
  apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro v hv
  have hh := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  have ht := h.execution_lower v hh.1
  omega

/-- Initial service is charged to at most one frontier of width `W`;
all later service is charged to distinct sequential slots. -/

decl_217.name: Scheduling.ForcingTrace.service_bounds
decl_217.label: ForcingTrace.service_bounds
decl_217.statement:
∀ {work a b W s e : ℕ} {S : Fin work → ℕ},
  Scheduling.ForcingTrace S a b W s e →
    Scheduling.suffixService S a b s ≤ W + (b - a) ∧ (a < e → Scheduling.suffixService S a b s ≤ b - e)
decl_217.source:
theorem service_bounds (h : ForcingTrace S a b W s e) :
    suffixService S a b s ≤ W + (b - a) ∧
      (a < e → suffixService S a b s ≤ b - e) := by
  induction h with
  | done e =>
    have hz : suffixService S a b work = 0 := by
      unfold suffixService
      apply card_eq_zero.mpr
      apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro v hv
      have := (mem_filter.mp hv).2.1
      have := v.isLt
      omega
    rw [hz]
    omega
  | layer s d e t hsd hd het hwidth hnarrow htimes tail ih =>
    have hsplit := suffixService_split S a b s d hsd.le
    have hhead := layerService_le_width S a b s d
    constructor
    · by_cases ht : t < a
      · have hz : layerService S a b s d = 0 := by
          unfold layerService
          apply card_eq_zero.mpr
          apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
          intro v hv
          have hh := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
          have htime := (htimes v hh.1 hh.2.1).2
          omega
        omega
      · have htail := ih.2 (by omega)
        omega
    · intro hae
      by_cases hbe : b ≤ e
      · have hz := (ForcingTrace.layer s d e t hsd hd het hwidth hnarrow htimes tail).service_zero hbe
        rw [hz]
        omega
      · have hn := hnarrow hae (by omega)
        have htail := ih.2 (by omega)
        omega

end ForcingTrace
end Scheduling

decl_246.name: Scheduling.Instance.PredecessorClosed
decl_246.label: Instance.PredecessorClosed
decl_246.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Finset (Fin vertices) → Prop
decl_246.source:
def PredecessorClosed (B : Finset (Fin vertices)) : Prop :=
  ∀ {u v}, v ∈ B → I.edge u v → u ∈ B

decl_389.name: Scheduling.Instance.markedRounds
decl_389.label: Instance.markedRounds
decl_389.source:
noncomputable def markedRounds (mark : ℕ → Prop) (K : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (range K).filter mark

decl_390.name: Scheduling.Instance.markedRounds_succ
decl_390.label: Instance.markedRounds_succ
decl_390.statement:
∀ (mark : ℕ → Prop) (K : ℕ),
  (Scheduling.Instance.markedRounds mark (K + 1)).card =
    (Scheduling.Instance.markedRounds mark K).card + if mark K then 1 else 0
decl_390.source:
theorem markedRounds_succ (mark : ℕ → Prop) (K : ℕ) :
    (markedRounds mark (K + 1)).card = (markedRounds mark K).card +
      (if mark K then 1 else 0) := by
  classical
  by_cases h : mark K <;> simp [markedRounds, range_add_one, filter_insert, h]

/-- Frontier processing in rounds. On every marked round, all vertices ready
at its start are processed before its end. Any other work is unrestricted.
This is the structural progress lemma used by SFF, for the concrete DAG model. -/

decl_375.name: Scheduling.Instance.frontier_round_progress
decl_375.label: Instance.frontier_round_progress
decl_375.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O →
    ∀ (B : Finset (Fin vertices)),
      I.PredecessorClosed B →
        ∀ (boundary : ℕ → ℕ),
          Monotone boundary →
            ∀ (mark : ℕ → Prop),
              (∀ (k : ℕ), mark k → ∀ v ∈ B, I.release (I.owner v) ≤ boundary k) →
                (∀ (k : ℕ), mark k → ∀ v ∈ B, I.Ready S (boundary k) v → S v < boundary (k + 1)) →
                  ∀ (K : ℕ),
                    ∀ v ∈ B,
                      boundary K ≤ S v → I.release (I.owner v) + (Scheduling.Instance.markedRounds mark K).card ≤ O v
decl_375.source:
theorem frontier_round_progress {m : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (B : Finset (Fin vertices)) (hB : I.PredecessorClosed B)
    (boundary : ℕ → ℕ) (mono : Monotone boundary) (mark : ℕ → Prop)
    (released : ∀ k, mark k → ∀ v ∈ B, I.release (I.owner v) ≤ boundary k)
    (advance : ∀ k, mark k → ∀ v ∈ B, I.Ready S (boundary k) v → S v < boundary (k + 1))
    (K : ℕ) (v : Fin vertices) (hv : v ∈ B) (hu : boundary K ≤ S v) :
    I.release (I.owner v) + (markedRounds mark K).card ≤ O v := by
  classical
  induction K generalizing v with
  | zero => simpa [markedRounds] using hO.release v
  | succ K ih =>
    have hb : boundary K ≤ boundary (K + 1) := mono (by omega)
    have hprev := ih v hv (by omega)
    have hc := markedRounds_succ mark K
    by_cases hm : mark K
    · rw [if_pos hm] at hc
      have hn : ¬ I.Ready S (boundary K) v := by
        intro hr
        have := advance K hm v hv hr
        omega
      have he : ∃ u, I.edge u v ∧ boundary K ≤ S u := by
        by_contra hn'
        push Not at hn'
        apply hn
        refine ⟨released K hm v hv, by omega, ?_⟩
        intro u he
        have := hn' u he
        omega
      obtain ⟨u, he, hu⟩ := he
      have hp := ih u (hB hv he) hu
      have ho := I.same_job he
      rw [ho] at hp
      have := hO.precedence he
      omega
    · rw [if_neg hm] at hc
      omega

/-- SFF's first progress observation: a batch can be small at the start of
at most L rounds. The premises describe frontier processing, not a depth or
round-count bound. Instantiating the complete SFF trace is separate work. -/

decl_374.name: Scheduling.Instance.frontier_round_count_bound
decl_374.label: Frontier progress
decl_374.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L : ℕ} {S O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O →
    I.FlowBound O L →
      ∀ (B : Finset (Fin vertices)),
        I.PredecessorClosed B →
          ∀ (boundary : ℕ → ℕ),
            Monotone boundary →
              ∀ (mark : ℕ → Prop),
                (∀ (k : ℕ), mark k → ∀ v ∈ B, I.release (I.owner v) ≤ boundary k) →
                  (∀ (k : ℕ), mark k → ∀ v ∈ B, I.Ready S (boundary k) v → S v < boundary (k + 1)) →
                    (∀ (k : ℕ), mark k → ∃ v ∈ B, boundary k ≤ S v) →
                      ∀ (K : ℕ), (Scheduling.Instance.markedRounds mark K).card ≤ L
decl_374.source:
theorem frontier_round_count_bound {m L : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    (B : Finset (Fin vertices)) (hB : I.PredecessorClosed B)
    (boundary : ℕ → ℕ) (mono : Monotone boundary) (mark : ℕ → Prop)
    (released : ∀ k, mark k → ∀ v ∈ B, I.release (I.owner v) ≤ boundary k)
    (advance : ∀ k, mark k → ∀ v ∈ B, I.Ready S (boundary k) v → S v < boundary (k + 1))
    (active : ∀ k, mark k → ∃ v ∈ B, boundary k ≤ S v)
    (K : ℕ) : (markedRounds mark K).card ≤ L := by
  classical
  induction K with
  | zero => simp [markedRounds]
  | succ K ih =>
    rw [markedRounds_succ]
    by_cases hm : mark K
    · rw [if_pos hm]
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hu⟩ := active K hm
      have hp := I.frontier_round_progress hO B hB boundary mono mark released advance K v hv hu
      have hl := hL v
      omega
    · rw [if_neg hm]
      omega

end Scheduling.Instance

decl_237.name: Scheduling.HardFamily.general_hard_after
decl_237.label: HardFamily.general_hard_after
decl_237.statement:
∀ {m c L jobs vertices : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m),
  0 < c →
    ∀ (hL : 0 < L),
      2 * (L / 2) = L →
        16 * c ≤ L →
          2 * c ≤ m →
            ∀ (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (d : ℕ),
              ∃ P ∈ Scheduling.HardFamily.general (c * (c * (m * L))) m L ⋯ hL,
                c * L ≤ (I.append (P.toInstance L ⋯) d).maxFlow (A.schedule (I.append (P.toInstance L ⋯) d))
decl_237.source:
theorem general_hard_after (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hc : 0 < c) (hL : 0 < L)
    (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L) (hcL : 16 * c ≤ L) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (I : Instance jobs vertices) (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ P ∈ general (c * (c * (m * L))) m L (by omega) hL,
      c * L ≤ (I.append (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) d).maxFlow
        (A.schedule (I.append (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) d)) := by
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hbad⟩ := general_hard hm hc hL heven hcL hcm (A.continuation I d)
  exact ⟨P, hP, hbad.trans (A.continuation_flow_le I d _)⟩

decl_232.name: Scheduling.HardFamily.batched_hard_after
decl_232.label: HardFamily.batched_hard_after
decl_232.statement:
∀ {m c L jobs vertices : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m),
  0 < c →
    ∀ (hL : 0 < L),
      2 * (L / 2) = L →
        2 * c ≤ m →
          L = 8 * c * 5 ^ c →
            ∀ (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (d : ℕ),
              ∃ P ∈ Scheduling.HardFamily.batched (c * (m * L)) m L ⋯ hL,
                c * L ≤ (I.append (P.toInstance L ⋯) d).maxFlow (A.schedule (I.append (P.toInstance L ⋯) d))
decl_232.source:
theorem batched_hard_after (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hc : 0 < c) (hL : 0 < L)
    (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m) (hscale : L = 8 * c * 5 ^ c)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (I : Instance jobs vertices) (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ P ∈ batched (c * (m * L)) m L (by omega) hL,
