  have he : (indices n a b).image Fin.val = Ico a (min b n) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
      have h := (mem_filter.mp hi).2
      exact mem_Ico.mpr ⟨h.1, lt_min h.2 i.isLt⟩
    · intro hx
      have h := mem_Ico.mp hx
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨x, (lt_min_iff.mp h.2).2⟩,
        mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, h.1, (lt_min_iff.mp h.2).1⟩, rfl⟩
  have hc := card_image_of_injective (indices n a b) Fin.val_injective
  rw [he, Nat.card_Ico] at hc
  exact hc.symm

decl_654.name: Scheduling.Packing.slice
decl_654.label: Packing.slice
decl_654.statement: {V : Type u_1} → [LinearOrder V] → Finset V → ℕ → ℕ → Finset V
decl_654.source:
def slice (s : Finset V) (a b : ℕ) : Finset V :=
  (indices s.card a b).image (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl)

decl_655.name: Scheduling.Packing.slice_card
decl_655.label: Packing.slice_card
decl_655.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder V] (s : Finset V) (a b : ℕ),
  (Scheduling.Packing.slice s a b).card = min b s.card - a
decl_655.source:
theorem slice_card (s : Finset V) (a b : ℕ) : (slice s a b).card = min b s.card - a := by
  rw [slice, card_image_of_injective _ (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl).injective, indices_card]

decl_657.name: Scheduling.Packing.slice_subset
decl_657.label: Packing.slice_subset
decl_657.statement: ∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder V] (s : Finset V) (a b : ℕ), Scheduling.Packing.slice s a b ⊆ s
decl_657.source:
theorem slice_subset (s : Finset V) (a b : ℕ) : slice s a b ⊆ s := by
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hv
  exact orderEmbOfFin_mem _ _ _

decl_653.name: Scheduling.Packing.mem_slice_iff
decl_653.label: Packing.mem_slice_iff
decl_653.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder V] (s : Finset V) (a b : ℕ) (v : V),
  v ∈ Scheduling.Packing.slice s a b ↔ ∃ i, a ≤ ↑i ∧ ↑i < b ∧ (s.orderEmbOfFin ⋯) i = v
decl_653.source:
theorem mem_slice_iff (s : Finset V) (a b : ℕ) (v : V) :
    v ∈ slice s a b ↔ ∃ i : Fin s.card, a ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < b ∧ s.orderEmbOfFin rfl i = v := by
  simp only [slice, indices, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, he⟩; exact ⟨i, hi.1, hi.2, he⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, h₁, h₂, he⟩; exact ⟨i, ⟨h₁, h₂⟩, he⟩

decl_658.name: Scheduling.Packing.slices_disjoint
decl_658.label: Packing.slices_disjoint
decl_658.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder V] (s : Finset V) {a b c d : ℕ},
  b ≤ c → Disjoint (Scheduling.Packing.slice s a b) (Scheduling.Packing.slice s c d)
decl_658.source:
theorem slices_disjoint (s : Finset V) {a b c d : ℕ} (hbc : b ≤ c) :
    Disjoint (slice s a b) (slice s c d) := by
  apply disjoint_left.mpr
  intro v hv hw
  obtain ⟨i, hi₁, hi₂, hi⟩ := (mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mp hv
  obtain ⟨j, hj₁, hj₂, hj⟩ := (mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mp hw
  have he := (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl).injective (hi.trans hj.symm)
  have he' := congrArg Fin.val he
  omega

/-- An omitted element of the initial slice implies the slice is full. -/

decl_649.name: Scheduling.Packing.first_slice_full
decl_649.label: Packing.first_slice_full
decl_649.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder V] {s : Finset V} {m : ℕ} {v : V},
  v ∈ s → v ∉ Scheduling.Packing.slice s 0 m → (Scheduling.Packing.slice s 0 m).card = m
decl_649.source:
theorem first_slice_full {s : Finset V} {m : ℕ} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ s) (hn : v ∉ slice s 0 m) : (slice s 0 m).card = m := by
  let i := (s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hi : s.orderEmbOfFin rfl i = v :=
    congrArg Subtype.val ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).apply_symm_apply ⟨v, hv⟩)
  have him : m ≤ i.val := by
    by_contra h
    exact hn ((mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨i, Nat.zero_le _, by omega, hi⟩)
  rw [slice_card, Nat.sub_zero, min_eq_left (by omega)]

/-- Every selected element precedes every omitted element. -/

decl_650.name: Scheduling.Packing.first_slice_lt
decl_650.label: Packing.first_slice_lt
decl_650.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder V] {s : Finset V} {m : ℕ} {u v : V},
  u ∈ Scheduling.Packing.slice s 0 m → v ∈ s → v ∉ Scheduling.Packing.slice s 0 m → u < v
decl_650.source:
theorem first_slice_lt {s : Finset V} {m : ℕ} {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ slice s 0 m) (hv : v ∈ s) (hn : v ∉ slice s 0 m) : u < v := by
  obtain ⟨i, _, him, hi⟩ := (mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mp hu
  let j := (s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hj : s.orderEmbOfFin rfl j = v :=
    congrArg Subtype.val ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).apply_symm_apply ⟨v, hv⟩)
  have hjm : m ≤ j.val := by
    by_contra h
    exact hn ((mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨j, Nat.zero_le _, by omega, hj⟩)
  rw [← hi, ← hj]
  exact (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl).strictMono (by show i.val < j.val; omega)

decl_647.name: Scheduling.Packing.duration
decl_647.label: Packing.duration
decl_647.source: def duration (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := max 1 ((n + m - 1) / m)

decl_659.name: Scheduling.Packing.slot
decl_659.label: Packing.slot
decl_659.statement: {V : Type u_1} → [LinearOrder V] → Finset V → ℕ → ℕ → Finset V
decl_659.source: def slot (s : Finset V) (m k : ℕ) : Finset V := slice s (k * m) ((k + 1) * m)

decl_648.name: Scheduling.Packing.duration_pos
decl_648.label: Packing.duration_pos
decl_648.source:
theorem duration_pos (n m : ℕ) : 0 < duration n m := by
  unfold duration
  omega

decl_660.name: Scheduling.Packing.slot_card_le
decl_660.label: Packing.slot_card_le
decl_660.statement: ∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder V] (s : Finset V) (m k : ℕ), (Scheduling.Packing.slot s m k).card ≤ m
decl_660.source:
theorem slot_card_le (s : Finset V) (m k : ℕ) : (slot s m k).card ≤ m := by
  rw [slot, slice_card]
  have he : (k + 1) * m = k * m + m := by ring
  omega

decl_645.name: Scheduling.Packing.before_last_full
decl_645.label: Packing.before_last_full
decl_645.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder V] (s : Finset V) {m k : ℕ},
  0 < m → k + 1 < Scheduling.Packing.duration s.card m → (Scheduling.Packing.slot s m k).card = m
decl_645.source:
theorem before_last_full (s : Finset V) {m k : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hk : k + 1 < duration s.card m) : (slot s m k).card = m := by
  have hq : k + 1 < (s.card + m - 1) / m := by unfold duration at hk; omega
  have hp := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hm).mp (show k + 2 ≤ (s.card + m - 1) / m by omega)
  rw [slot, slice_card]
  have hmul : (k + 2) * m = (k + 1) * m + m := by ring
  have hsub : s.card + m - 1 + 1 = s.card + m := by omega
  have hle : (k + 1) * m ≤ s.card := by omega
  rw [min_eq_left hle]
  have he : (k + 1) * m = k * m + m := by ring
  omega

decl_661.name: Scheduling.Packing.slot_disjoint
decl_661.label: Packing.slot_disjoint
decl_661.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder V] (s : Finset V) {m i j : ℕ},
  i ≠ j → Disjoint (Scheduling.Packing.slot s m i) (Scheduling.Packing.slot s m j)
decl_661.source:
theorem slot_disjoint (s : Finset V) {m i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Disjoint (slot s m i) (slot s m j) := by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with h | h
  · exact slices_disjoint s (Nat.mul_le_mul_right m (show i + 1 ≤ j by omega))
  · exact (slices_disjoint s (Nat.mul_le_mul_right m (show j + 1 ≤ i by omega))).symm

decl_646.name: Scheduling.Packing.covers
decl_646.label: Packing.covers
decl_646.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder V] (s : Finset V) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → ∀ {v : V}, v ∈ s → ∃ k < Scheduling.Packing.duration s.card m, v ∈ Scheduling.Packing.slot s m k
decl_646.source:
theorem covers (s : Finset V) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ s) :
    ∃ k < duration s.card m, v ∈ slot s m k := by
  let i := (s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hi : s.orderEmbOfFin rfl i = v := by
    exact congrArg Subtype.val ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).apply_symm_apply ⟨v, hv⟩)
  have hmod := Nat.mod_lt i.val hm
  have hdiv := Nat.mod_add_div i.val m
  rw [Nat.mul_comm m] at hdiv
  have hcover : s.card ≤ duration s.card m * m := by
    have hquot := Nat.mod_lt (s.card + m - 1) hm
    have hdecomp := Nat.mod_add_div (s.card + m - 1) m
    rw [Nat.mul_comm m] at hdecomp
    have hceil : s.card ≤ ((s.card + m - 1) / m) * m := by omega
    have hmax : (s.card + m - 1) / m ≤ duration s.card m := le_max_right _ _
    exact hceil.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right m hmax)
  have hk : i.val / m < duration s.card m := by
    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hm).mpr
    exact i.isLt.trans_le hcover
  refine ⟨i.val / m, hk, (mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨i, ?_, ?_, hi⟩⟩
  · omega
  · have he : (i.val / m + 1) * m = i.val / m * m + m := by ring
    omega

end Scheduling.Packing

decl_656.name: Scheduling.Packing.slice_image
decl_656.label: Packing.slice_image
decl_656.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder V] [inst_1 : LinearOrder W] (s : Finset V) (f : V → W),
  StrictMono f →
    ∀ (a b : ℕ), Finset.image f (Scheduling.Packing.slice s a b) = Scheduling.Packing.slice (Finset.image f s) a b
decl_656.source:
theorem slice_image (s : Finset V) (f : V → W) (hf : StrictMono f) (a b : ℕ) :
    (slice s a b).image f = slice (s.image f) a b := by
  classical
  have hc : (s.image f).card = s.card := card_image_of_injective _ hf.injective
  have henum : (fun i : Fin s.card => f (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl i)) =
      (s.image f).orderEmbOfFin hc := by
    apply orderEmbOfFin_unique hc
    · intro i
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨_, orderEmbOfFin_mem _ _ _, rfl⟩
    · exact hf.comp (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl).strictMono
  have hcast (i : Fin s.card) :
      (s.image f).orderEmbOfFin rfl (i.cast hc.symm) = f (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl i) := by
    rw [congrFun henum i]
    exact orderEmbOfFin_eq_orderEmbOfFin_iff.mpr rfl
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hy
    obtain ⟨i, hi₁, hi₂, hi⟩ := (mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mp hv
    refine (mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨i.cast hc.symm, hi₁, hi₂, ?_⟩
    rw [hcast, hi]
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨i, hi₁, hi₂, hi⟩ := (mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mp hy
    let j : Fin s.card := i.cast hc
    have he : f (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl j) = y := by
      rw [← hcast]
      exact hi
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨_, (mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨j, hi₁, hi₂, rfl⟩, he⟩

decl_662.name: Scheduling.Packing.slot_image
decl_662.label: Packing.slot_image
decl_662.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder V] [inst_1 : LinearOrder W] (s : Finset V) (f : V → W),
  StrictMono f →
    ∀ (m k : ℕ), Finset.image f (Scheduling.Packing.slot s m k) = Scheduling.Packing.slot (Finset.image f s) m k
decl_662.source:
theorem slot_image (s : Finset V) (f : V → W) (hf : StrictMono f) (m k : ℕ) :
    (slot s m k).image f = slot (s.image f) m k :=
  slice_image s f hf _ _

end Scheduling.Packing

decl_245.name: Scheduling.Instance.PhaseFails
decl_245.label: Instance.PhaseFails
decl_245.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → ℕ → Prop
decl_245.source:
def PhaseFails (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s B : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ t, s ≤ t ∧ ∃ v, t = I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 ∧ t ≤ S v

decl_319.name: Scheduling.Instance.failureTime
decl_319.label: Instance.failureTime
decl_319.statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) → {S : Scheduling.Assignment} → {s B : ℕ} → I.PhaseFails S s B → ℕ
decl_319.source:
noncomputable def failureTime {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B : ℕ}
    (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B) : ℕ := Nat.find hf

decl_321.name: Scheduling.Instance.failureTime_spec
decl_321.label: Instance.failureTime_spec
decl_321.source:
theorem failureTime_spec {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B : ℕ}
    (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B) :
    s ≤ I.failureTime hf ∧ ∃ v,
      I.failureTime hf = I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 ∧ I.failureTime hf ≤ S v :=
  Nat.find_spec hf

decl_320.name: Scheduling.Instance.failureTime_le
decl_320.label: Instance.failureTime_le
decl_320.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {s B : ℕ}
  (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B) (v : Fin vertices),
  s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 →
    I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 ≤ S v → I.failureTime hf ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2
decl_320.source:
theorem failureTime_le {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B : ℕ}
    (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B) (v : Fin vertices)
    (hs : s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2)
    (hv : I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 ≤ S v) :
    I.failureTime hf ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 :=
  Nat.find_min' hf ⟨hs, v, rfl, hv⟩

decl_324.name: Scheduling.Instance.failure_remaining_age
decl_324.label: Instance.failure_remaining_age
decl_324.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {s B : ℕ}
  (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B),
  (∀ (v : Fin vertices), s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2) →
    ∀ (v : Fin vertices), I.failureTime hf ≤ S v → I.failureTime hf ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2
decl_324.source:
theorem failure_remaining_age {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B : ℕ}
    (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B)
    (hs : ∀ v, s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2)
    (v : Fin vertices) (hv : I.failureTime hf ≤ S v) :
    I.failureTime hf ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 := by
  by_contra hn
  have hstart := hs v ((I.failureTime_spec hf).1.trans hv)
  have hle := I.failureTime_le hf v hstart (by omega)
  omega

decl_323.name: Scheduling.Instance.failure_completed_age
decl_323.label: Instance.failure_completed_age
decl_323.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {s B : ℕ}
  (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B),
  (∀ (v : Fin vertices), s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2) →
    ∀ (v : Fin vertices), s ≤ S v → S v < I.failureTime hf → S v < I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2
decl_323.source:
theorem failure_completed_age {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B : ℕ}
    (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B)
    (hs : ∀ v, s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2)
    (v : Fin vertices) (hsv : s ≤ S v) (hv : S v < I.failureTime hf) :
    S v < I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 := by
  by_contra hn
  have hle := I.failureTime_le hf v (hs v hsv) (by omega)
  omega

decl_397.name: Scheduling.Instance.no_failure_flow
decl_397.label: Instance.no_failure_flow
decl_397.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {s B : ℕ},
  ¬I.PhaseFails S s B →
    (∀ (v : Fin vertices), s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2) →
      ∀ (v : Fin vertices), s ≤ S v → S v < I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2
decl_397.source:
theorem no_failure_flow {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B : ℕ}
    (hf : ¬ I.PhaseFails S s B)
    (hs : ∀ v, s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2)
    (v : Fin vertices) (hsv : s ≤ S v) :
    S v < I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 := by
  by_contra hn
  exact hf ⟨I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2, hs v hsv, v, rfl, by omega⟩

decl_475.name: Scheduling.Instance.sffPhase_start_bound
decl_475.label: Instance.sffPhase_start_bound
decl_475.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m B s : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) →
    ∀ (v : Fin vertices), s ≤ I.sffPhase m B hB S s v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2
decl_475.source:
theorem sffPhase_start_bound {m B s : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) :
    ∀ v, s ≤ I.sffPhase m B hB S s v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 := by
  classical
  intro v hv
  have hsur := (I.splice_survives _ v).mp hv
  have h := hs v (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hsur⟩)
  nlinarith

/-- A failed SFF phase certifies that its guess was too small. -/

decl_318.name: Scheduling.Instance.failed_guess_lt
decl_318.label: Instance.failed_guess_lt
decl_318.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hB : 0 < B)
  {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) →
    I.PhaseFails (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) s B → B < I.optimum m hm
decl_318.source:
theorem failed_guess_lt {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hB : 0 < B)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2)
    (hf : I.PhaseFails (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) s B) : B < I.optimum m hm := by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  obtain ⟨ht, v, he, hv⟩ := I.failureTime_spec hf
  have hsur : v ∈ I.survivors S s :=
    mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, (I.splice_survives _ v).mp (ht.trans hv)⟩
  have hbound := I.sffPhase_survivor_bound hm hB hs (by omega) v hsur
  omega

/-- At a restart every survivor's new artificial release is after the new
phase start. This is the invariant needed for local-clock transport. -/

decl_305.name: Scheduling.Instance.doubled_phase_start
decl_305.label: Instance.doubled_phase_start
decl_305.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m B s : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) →
    ∀ (hf : I.PhaseFails (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) s B),
      ∀ v ∈ I.survivors (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) (I.failureTime hf),
        I.failureTime hf ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * (2 * B) ^ 2
decl_305.source:
theorem doubled_phase_start {m B s : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2)
    (hf : I.PhaseFails (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) s B) :
    ∀ v ∈ I.survivors (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) (I.failureTime hf),
      I.failureTime hf ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * (2 * B) ^ 2 := by
  intro v hv
  have h := I.failure_remaining_age hf (I.sffPhase_start_bound hB hs) v (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  nlinarith

end Scheduling.Instance

namespace Scheduling.Accounting

decl_1.name: Scheduling.Accounting.combined_sff_budget
decl_1.label: Accounting.combined_sff_budget
decl_1.source:
theorem combined_sff_budget {B m O : ℕ} (hO : B ≤ 2 * O) (hm : B < 2 * m) :
    88 * B ^ 2 ≤ 352 * O * min m O := by
  rcases le_total m O with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h]
    have hp := Nat.mul_le_mul hO (le_of_lt hm)
    nlinarith
  · rw [min_eq_right h]
    have hp := Nat.mul_le_mul hO hO
    nlinarith

decl_0.name: Scheduling.Accounting.combined_fifo_budget
decl_0.label: Accounting.combined_fifo_budget
decl_0.source:
theorem combined_fifo_budget {B m O : ℕ} (hO : B ≤ 2 * O) (hm : B < 2 * m)
    (hswitch : m ≤ B) : 44 * B ^ 2 + 44 * m * O ≤ 352 * O * min m O := by
  rcases le_total m O with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h]
    have hp := Nat.mul_le_mul hO (le_of_lt hm)
    nlinarith
  · rw [min_eq_right h]
    have hp := Nat.mul_le_mul hO hO
    have hmo := Nat.mul_le_mul_right O (hswitch.trans hO)
    nlinarith

end Scheduling.Accounting

decl_814.name: Scheduling.deadlineVisible
decl_814.label: deadlineVisible
decl_814.source:
def deadlineVisible (B t : ℕ) (Q : FIFOObservation) : Bool :=
  decide (∃ x ∈ Q, (ofLex x).1 + 88 * B ^ 2 ≤ t)

decl_815.name: Scheduling.deadlineVisible_iff
decl_815.label: deadlineVisible_iff
decl_815.statement:
∀ (B t : ℕ) (Q : Scheduling.FIFOObservation),
  Scheduling.deadlineVisible B t Q = true ↔ ∃ x ∈ Q, (ofLex x).1 + 88 * B ^ 2 ≤ t
decl_815.source:
theorem deadlineVisible_iff (B t : ℕ) (Q : FIFOObservation) :
    deadlineVisible B t Q = true ↔ ∃ x ∈ Q, (ofLex x).1 + 88 * B ^ 2 ≤ t := by
  simp [deadlineVisible]

namespace Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

/-- Splicing a future continuation preserves all completed work at every
earlier time, including the restart boundary before that slot executes. -/

decl_489.name: Scheduling.Instance.splice_prefix_time
decl_489.label: Instance.splice_prefix_time
decl_489.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {s t : ℕ}
  (T : Scheduling.Assignment), t ≤ s → ∀ (v : Fin vertices), I.splice S s T v < t ↔ S v < t
decl_489.source:
theorem splice_prefix_time {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s t : ℕ}
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card)) (ht : t ≤ s) (v : Fin vertices) :
    I.splice S s T v < t ↔ S v < t := by
  classical
  by_cases hv : S v < s
  · rw [I.splice_preserves_prefix T hv]
  · have hs : v ∈ I.survivors S s := mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega⟩
    simp only [splice, dif_pos hs]
    omega

/-- The recursive controller never revises the executed prefix, without
requiring any offline bound or performance invariant. -/

decl_296.name: Scheduling.Instance.combinedAux_prefix_time
decl_296.label: Instance.combinedAux_prefix_time
decl_296.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B)
  (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (s t : ℕ), t ≤ s → ∀ (v : Fin vertices), I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s v < t ↔ S v < t
decl_296.source:
theorem combinedAux_prefix_time {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s t : ℕ)
    (ht : t ≤ s) (v : Fin vertices) :
    I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s v < t ↔ S v < t := by
  classical
  induction fuel generalizing B S s with
  | zero => exact I.splice_prefix_time _ ht v
  | succ fuel ih =>
    by_cases hswitch : B < m
    · simp only [combinedAux, if_pos hswitch]
      by_cases hf : I.PhaseFails (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) s B
      · rw [dif_pos hf]
        have hs := (I.failureTime_spec hf).1
        exact (ih (2 * B) (by omega) (I.sffPhase m B hB S s)
          (I.failureTime hf) (ht.trans hs)).trans (I.splice_prefix_time _ ht v)
      · rw [dif_neg hf]
        exact I.splice_prefix_time _ ht v
    · simp only [combinedAux, if_neg hswitch]
      exact I.splice_prefix_time _ ht v

variable [DecidableRel I.edge]

decl_428.name: Scheduling.Instance.readyObservation_prefix
decl_428.label: Instance.readyObservation_prefix
decl_428.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {S T : Scheduling.Assignment}
  {t : ℕ}, (∀ (v : Fin vertices), S v < t ↔ T v < t) → I.readyObservation S t = I.readyObservation T t
decl_428.source:
theorem readyObservation_prefix {S T : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {t : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ v, S v < t ↔ T v < t) : I.readyObservation S t = I.readyObservation T t := by
  unfold readyObservation
  congr 1
  ext v
  have hv : t ≤ S v ↔ t ≤ T v := by have := h v; omega
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, hv, h]

decl_491.name: Scheduling.Instance.splice_readyObservation
decl_491.label: Instance.splice_readyObservation
decl_491.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {S : Scheduling.Assignment}
  {s t : ℕ} (T : Scheduling.Assignment), t ≤ s → I.readyObservation (I.splice S s T) t = I.readyObservation S t
decl_491.source:
theorem splice_readyObservation {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s t : ℕ}
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card)) (ht : t ≤ s) :
    I.readyObservation (I.splice S s T) t = I.readyObservation S t :=
  I.readyObservation_prefix (I.splice_prefix_time T ht)

decl_298.name: Scheduling.Instance.combinedAux_readyObservation
decl_298.label: Instance.combinedAux_readyObservation
decl_298.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (s t : ℕ),
  t ≤ s → I.readyObservation (I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s) t = I.readyObservation S t
decl_298.source:
theorem combinedAux_readyObservation {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s t : ℕ)
    (ht : t ≤ s) :
    I.readyObservation (I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s) t = I.readyObservation S t :=
  I.readyObservation_prefix (I.combinedAux_prefix_time hm fuel B hB S s t ht)

/-- The first failed deadline is visible from the exposed ready frontier. -/

decl_322.name: Scheduling.Instance.failureTime_visible
decl_322.label: Instance.failureTime_visible
decl_322.source:
theorem failureTime_visible {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B : ℕ}
    (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B) :
    deadlineVisible B (I.failureTime hf) (I.readyObservation S (I.failureTime hf)) = true := by
  obtain ⟨_, v, he, hv⟩ := I.failureTime_spec hf
  have hr : I.release (I.owner v) ≤ I.failureTime hf := by omega
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hready⟩ := I.exists_ready (S := S) hr ⟨v, rfl, hv⟩
  apply (deadlineVisible_iff _ _ _).mpr
  refine ⟨I.fifoPriority w, (I.mem_readyObservation _ _ _).mpr ⟨w, hready, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  change I.release (I.owner w) + 88 * B ^ 2 ≤ I.failureTime hf
  rw [hw]
  omega

/-- No earlier time in a phase can trigger the public failure detector. -/

decl_292.name: Scheduling.Instance.before_failure_not_visible
decl_292.label: Instance.before_failure_not_visible
decl_292.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {S : Scheduling.Assignment}
  {s B t : ℕ} (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B),
  (∀ (v : Fin vertices), s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2) →
    s ≤ t → t < I.failureTime hf → Scheduling.deadlineVisible B t (I.readyObservation S t) = false
decl_292.source:
theorem before_failure_not_visible {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B t : ℕ}
    (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B)
    (hs : ∀ v, s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2)
    (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : t < I.failureTime hf) :
    deadlineVisible B t (I.readyObservation S t) = false := by
  apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
  intro h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hd⟩ := (deadlineVisible_iff _ _ _).mp h
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := (I.mem_readyObservation _ _ _).mp hx
  change I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 ≤ t at hd
  have hstart := hs v (hst.trans hv.2.1)
  have hmin := I.failureTime_le hf v hstart (hd.trans hv.2.1)
  omega

decl_398.name: Scheduling.Instance.no_failure_not_visible
decl_398.label: Instance.no_failure_not_visible
decl_398.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {S : Scheduling.Assignment}
  {s B t : ℕ},
  ¬I.PhaseFails S s B →
    (∀ (v : Fin vertices), s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2) →
      s ≤ t → Scheduling.deadlineVisible B t (I.readyObservation S t) = false
decl_398.source:
theorem no_failure_not_visible {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B t : ℕ}
    (hf : ¬ I.PhaseFails S s B)
    (hs : ∀ v, s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2)
    (hst : s ≤ t) : deadlineVisible B t (I.readyObservation S t) = false := by
  apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
  intro h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hd⟩ := (deadlineVisible_iff _ _ _).mp h
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := (I.mem_readyObservation _ _ _).mp hx
  change I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 ≤ t at hd
  exact hf ⟨_, hs v (hst.trans hv.2.1), v, rfl, hd.trans hv.2.1⟩

end Instance
end Scheduling

decl_816.name: Scheduling.delayObservation
decl_816.label: delayObservation
decl_816.source:
def delayObservation (D s t : ℕ) (Q : FIFOObservation) : FIFOObservation :=
  (Q.filter (fun x => (ofLex x).1 + D ≤ t)).image
    (fun x => toLex ((ofLex x).1 + D - s, (ofLex x).2))

namespace Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

/-- Extend the increasing residual reindexing to a total increasing map on
public labels. Values outside the residual domain are never observed. -/

decl_451.name: Scheduling.Instance.residualLabel
decl_451.label: Instance.residualLabel
decl_451.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Finset (Fin vertices) → ℕ → ℕ
decl_451.source:
noncomputable def residualLabel (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if hn : n < R.card then (I.residualVertex R ⟨n, hn⟩).val else vertices + n

decl_453.name: Scheduling.Instance.residualLabel_strictMono
decl_453.label: Instance.residualLabel_strictMono
decl_453.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)),
  StrictMono (I.residualLabel R)
decl_453.source:
theorem residualLabel_strictMono (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) : StrictMono (I.residualLabel R) := by
  intro a b hab
  unfold residualLabel
  split_ifs with ha hb hb
  · exact I.residualVertex_strictMono R hab
  · have hh := (I.residualVertex R ⟨a, ha⟩).isLt
    omega
  · omega
  · omega

decl_452.name: Scheduling.Instance.residualLabel_apply
decl_452.label: Instance.residualLabel_apply
decl_452.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (v : Fin R.card),
  I.residualLabel R ↑v = ↑(I.residualVertex R v)
decl_452.source:
@[simp] theorem residualLabel_apply (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (v : Fin R.card) :
    I.residualLabel R v.val = (I.residualVertex R v).val := by
  simp [residualLabel]

decl_460.name: Scheduling.Instance.residualVertex_mem
decl_460.label: Instance.residualVertex_mem
decl_460.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (v : Fin R.card),
  I.residualVertex R v ∈ R
decl_460.source:
theorem residualVertex_mem (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (v : Fin R.card) :
    I.residualVertex R v ∈ R := (R.orderIsoOfFin rfl v).property

decl_497.name: Scheduling.Instance.survivorIndex_residualVertex
decl_497.label: Instance.survivorIndex_residualVertex
decl_497.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {s : ℕ}
  (v : Fin (I.survivors S s).card), I.survivorIndex (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) v) ⋯ = v
decl_497.source:
@[simp] theorem survivorIndex_residualVertex {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s : ℕ}
    (v : Fin (I.survivors S s).card) :
    I.survivorIndex (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) v)
      (I.residualVertex_mem _ v) = v := by
  exact ((I.survivors S s).orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm_apply_apply v

decl_492.name: Scheduling.Instance.splice_residualVertex
decl_492.label: Instance.splice_residualVertex
decl_492.source:
@[simp] theorem splice_residualVertex {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s : ℕ}
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card)) (v : Fin (I.survivors S s).card) :
    I.splice S s T (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) v) = s + T v := by
  simp only [splice, dif_pos (I.residualVertex_mem _ v), I.survivorIndex_residualVertex]

decl_415.name: Scheduling.Instance.phase_release_owner
decl_415.label: Instance.phase_release_owner
decl_415.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D s : ℕ) (v : Fin R.card),
  (I.phaseInstance R D s).release ((I.phaseInstance R D s).owner v) = I.release (I.owner (I.residualVertex R v)) + D - s
decl_415.source:
@[simp] theorem phase_release_owner (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D s : ℕ) (v : Fin R.card) :
    (I.phaseInstance R D s).release ((I.phaseInstance R D s).owner v) =
      I.release (I.owner (I.residualVertex R v)) + D - s := by
  simp [phaseInstance, rebase, residualInstance]

/-- Local readiness is precisely global readiness of a survivor, together
with its artificial-release eligibility. Removed predecessors have already
finished before the restart. -/

decl_414.name: Scheduling.Instance.phase_ready_iff
decl_414.label: Instance.phase_ready_iff
decl_414.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {D s : ℕ}
  (T : Scheduling.Assignment),
  (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) →
    ∀ (u : ℕ) (v : Fin (I.survivors S s).card),
      (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).Ready T u v ↔
        I.Ready (I.splice S s T) (s + u) (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) v) ∧
          I.release (I.owner (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) v)) + D ≤ s + u
decl_414.source:
theorem phase_ready_iff {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {D s : ℕ}
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card))
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D)
    (u : ℕ) (v : Fin (I.survivors S s).card) :
    (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).Ready T u v ↔
      I.Ready (I.splice S s T) (s + u) (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) v) ∧
        I.release (I.owner (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) v)) + D ≤ s + u := by
  classical
  have hstart := hs _ (I.residualVertex_mem _ v)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hr, hv, hp⟩
    rw [I.phase_release_owner] at hr
    refine ⟨⟨by omega, ?_, ?_⟩, by omega⟩
    · rw [I.splice_residualVertex]
      omega
    · intro w hw
      by_cases hsur : w ∈ I.survivors S s
      · have hedge : (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).edge (I.survivorIndex w hsur) v := by
          simpa only [phaseInstance, rebase, residualInstance, I.residualVertex_survivorIndex] using hw
        have ht := hp _ hedge
        simp only [splice, dif_pos hsur]
        omega
      · have ht : S w < s := by simpa [survivors] using hsur
        rw [I.splice_preserves_prefix T ht]
        omega
  · rintro ⟨⟨_, hv, hp⟩, hr⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [I.phase_release_owner]
      omega
    · rw [I.splice_residualVertex] at hv
      omega
    · intro w hw
      have ht := hp (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) w) hw
      rw [I.splice_residualVertex] at ht
      omega

decl_413.name: Scheduling.Instance.phase_readyObservation
decl_413.label: Instance.phase_readyObservation
decl_413.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {D s : ℕ}
  (T : Scheduling.Assignment),
  (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) →
    ∀ [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] [inst_1 : DecidableRel (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).edge] (u : ℕ),
      Scheduling.renameObservation (I.residualLabel (I.survivors S s))
          ((I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).readyObservation T u) =
        Scheduling.delayObservation D s (s + u) (I.readyObservation (I.splice S s T) (s + u))
decl_413.source:
theorem phase_readyObservation {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {D s : ℕ}
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card))
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D)
    [DecidableRel I.edge] [DecidableRel (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).edge]
    (u : ℕ) :
    renameObservation (I.residualLabel (I.survivors S s))
      ((I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).readyObservation T u) =
      delayObservation D s (s + u) (I.readyObservation (I.splice S s T) (s + u)) := by
  classical
  let R := I.survivors S s
  let J := I.phaseInstance R D s
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := (J.mem_readyObservation _ _ _).mp hy
    have hg := (I.phase_ready_iff T hs u v).mp hv
    refine mem_image.mpr ⟨I.fifoPriority (I.residualVertex R v), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨(I.mem_readyObservation _ _ _).mpr ⟨_, hg.1, rfl⟩, hg.2⟩
    · simp [renameKey, fifoPriority, J, R]
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := (I.mem_readyObservation _ _ _).mp (mem_filter.mp hy).1
    have hvtime := hv.2.1
    have hdelay : I.release (I.owner v) + D ≤ s + u := (mem_filter.mp hy).2
    have hsur : v ∈ R := by
      have hh := (I.splice_survives T v).mp (show s ≤ I.splice S s T v by omega)
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hh⟩
    let w := I.survivorIndex v hsur
    have hw : I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) w = v := I.residualVertex_survivorIndex v hsur
    have hlocal : J.Ready T u w := (I.phase_ready_iff T hs u w).mpr
      ⟨by simpa only [hw] using hv, by simpa only [hw] using hdelay⟩
    refine mem_image.mpr ⟨J.fifoPriority w, (J.mem_readyObservation _ _ _).mpr ⟨w, hlocal, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [renameKey, fifoPriority, J, R, hw]

decl_488.name: Scheduling.Instance.splice_execution_set
decl_488.label: Instance.splice_execution_set
decl_488.source:
theorem splice_execution_set {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s : ℕ}
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card)) (u : ℕ) :
    univ.filter (fun v => I.splice S s T v = s + u) =
      (univ.filter (fun v => T v = u)).image (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s)) := by
  classical
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have he := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hsur : v ∈ I.survivors S s :=
      mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, (I.splice_survives T v).mp (by omega)⟩
    refine mem_image.mpr ⟨I.survivorIndex v hsur, ?_, I.residualVertex_survivorIndex v hsur⟩
    simp only [splice, dif_pos hsur] at he
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega⟩
  · intro hv
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hv
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by rw [I.splice_residualVertex, (mem_filter.mp hw).2]⟩

decl_487.name: Scheduling.Instance.splice_execution_public
decl_487.label: Instance.splice_execution_public
decl_487.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {s : ℕ}
  (T : Scheduling.Assignment) (u : ℕ),
  Finset.image Fin.val {v | I.splice S s T v = s + u} =
    Finset.image (I.residualLabel (I.survivors S s)) (Finset.image Fin.val {v | T v = u})
decl_487.source:
theorem splice_execution_public {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s : ℕ}
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card)) (u : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.splice S s T v = s + u)).image Fin.val =
      ((univ.filter (fun v => T v = u)).image Fin.val).image (I.residualLabel (I.survivors S s)) := by
  classical
  rw [I.splice_execution_set, image_image, image_image]
  apply image_congr
  intro v _
  exact (I.residualLabel_apply _ v).symm

variable [DecidableRel I.edge]

/-- An SFF phase, after restoring the original identifiers, realizes the
public SFF policy on delayed observations. This includes residual graphs
with fewer vertices and jobs than the original instance. -/

decl_473.name: Scheduling.Instance.sffPhase_publicPolicy
decl_473.label: Instance.sffPhase_publicPolicy
decl_473.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m B s : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (hB : 0 < B) {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
      (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) →
        ∀ (u : ℕ),
          Finset.image Fin.val {v | I.sffPhase m B hB S s v = s + u} =
            (Scheduling.sffRawPolicy m B).decision
              (fun a =>
                Scheduling.delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s (s + a) (I.readyObservation (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) (s + a)))
              u
decl_473.source:
theorem sffPhase_publicPolicy {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hB : 0 < B)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2)
    (u : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.sffPhase m B hB S s v = s + u)).image Fin.val =
      (sffRawPolicy m B).decision
        (fun a => delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s (s + a)
          (I.readyObservation (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) (s + a))) u := by
  classical
  let R := I.survivors S s
  let J := I.phaseInstance R (44 * B ^ 2) s
  let T := J.sffSchedule m B hB
  have hobs : (fun a => renameObservation (I.residualLabel R) (J.readyObservation T a)) =
      fun a => delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s (s + a)
        (I.readyObservation (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) (s + a)) := by
    funext a
    exact I.phase_readyObservation T hs a
  change (univ.filter (fun v => I.splice S s T v = s + u)).image Fin.val = _
  rw [I.splice_execution_public]
  have he := J.sffSchedule_publicPolicy hm hB u
  change (univ.filter (fun v => T v = u)).image Fin.val = _ at he
  rw [he, ← sffRawPolicy_decision_rename (I.residualLabel_strictMono R), hobs]

/-- The permanent FIFO phase likewise uses only delayed ready observations
and the original public identifiers. -/

decl_332.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoPhase_publicPolicy
decl_332.label: Instance.fifoPhase_publicPolicy
decl_332.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) →
    ∀ (u : ℕ),
      Finset.image Fin.val {v | I.fifoPhase m hm B S s v = s + u} =
        Scheduling.fifoPolicy m
          (Scheduling.delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s (s + u) (I.readyObservation (I.fifoPhase m hm B S s) (s + u)))
decl_332.source:
theorem fifoPhase_publicPolicy {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2)
    (u : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.fifoPhase m hm B S s v = s + u)).image Fin.val =
      fifoPolicy m (delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s (s + u)
        (I.readyObservation (I.fifoPhase m hm B S s) (s + u))) := by
  classical
  let R := I.survivors S s
  let J := I.phaseInstance R (44 * B ^ 2) s
  let T := J.fifoSchedule m hm
  change (univ.filter (fun v => I.splice S s T v = s + u)).image Fin.val = _
  rw [I.splice_execution_public]
  have he := J.fifoSchedule_publicPolicy hm u
  change (univ.filter (fun v => T v = u)).image Fin.val = _ at he
  rw [he, ← fifoPolicy_rename (I.residualLabel_strictMono R)]
  congr 1
  exact I.phase_readyObservation T hs u

end Instance
end Scheduling

decl_431.name: Scheduling.Instance.rebase
decl_431.label: Instance.rebase
decl_431.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → ℕ → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices
decl_431.source:
def rebase (s : ℕ) : Instance jobs vertices :=
  { I with release := fun j => I.release j - s }

decl_432.name: Scheduling.Instance.rebaseSchedule
decl_432.label: Instance.rebaseSchedule
decl_432.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → Scheduling.Assignment
decl_432.source:
def rebaseSchedule (_I : Instance jobs vertices) (O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s : ℕ) :
    Assignment (vertices := vertices) := fun v => O v - s

decl_434.name: Scheduling.Instance.rebaseSchedule_valid
decl_434.label: Instance.rebaseSchedule_valid
decl_434.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m s : ℕ} {O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O → (∀ (j : Fin jobs), s ≤ I.release j) → (I.rebase s).Valid m (I.rebaseSchedule O s)
decl_434.source:
theorem rebaseSchedule_valid {m s : ℕ} {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hs : ∀ j, s ≤ I.release j) :
    (I.rebase s).Valid m (I.rebaseSchedule O s) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro v
    exact Nat.sub_le_sub_right (hO.release v) s
  · intro u v he
    have hp := hO.precedence he
    have hu := (hs (I.owner u)).trans (hO.release u)
    change O u - s < O v - s
    omega
  · intro t
    have hsub : univ.filter (fun v => I.rebaseSchedule O s v = t) ⊆
        univ.filter (fun v => O v = t + s) := by
      intro v hv
      have he := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      have hl := (hs (I.owner v)).trans (hO.release v)
      dsimp [rebaseSchedule] at he
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega⟩
    exact (card_le_card hsub).trans (hO.capacity _)

decl_433.name: Scheduling.Instance.rebaseSchedule_flowBound
decl_433.label: Instance.rebaseSchedule_flowBound
decl_433.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L s : ℕ} {O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O → I.FlowBound O L → (∀ (j : Fin jobs), s ≤ I.release j) → (I.rebase s).FlowBound (I.rebaseSchedule O s) L
decl_433.source:
theorem rebaseSchedule_flowBound {m L s : ℕ} {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (hs : ∀ j, s ≤ I.release j) :
    (I.rebase s).FlowBound (I.rebaseSchedule O s) L := by
  intro v
  have h := hL v
  have ho := hO.release v
  have hr := hs (I.owner v)
  change O v - s < I.release (I.owner v) - s + L
  omega

/-- The phase instance retains exactly `R`, delays releases by `D`, then
sets its clock to zero at global time `s`. -/

decl_410.name: Scheduling.Instance.phaseInstance
decl_410.label: Instance.phaseInstance
decl_410.statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) →
    (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) → ℕ → ℕ → Scheduling.Instance (Finset.image I.owner R).card R.card
decl_410.source:
noncomputable def phaseInstance (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D s : ℕ) :
    Instance (R.image I.owner).card R.card := (I.residualInstance R D).rebase s

decl_416.name: Scheduling.Instance.phase_releases_after_start
decl_416.label: Instance.phase_releases_after_start
decl_416.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {R : Finset (Fin vertices)} {D s : ℕ},
  (∀ v ∈ R, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) →
    ∀ (j : Fin (Finset.image I.owner R).card), s ≤ (I.residualInstance R D).release j
decl_416.source:
theorem phase_releases_after_start {R : Finset (Fin vertices)} {D s : ℕ}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ R, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) :
    ∀ j, s ≤ (I.residualInstance R D).release j := by
  intro j
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (I.residualInstance R D).nonempty_job j
  have h := hs (I.residualVertex R v) ((R.orderIsoOfFin rfl) v).property
  have he : I.residualJob R j = I.owner (I.residualVertex R v) := by
    rw [← hv]
    exact I.residualJob_owner R v
  simpa [residualInstance, he] using h

decl_411.name: Scheduling.Instance.phase_offline_bound
decl_411.label: Instance.phase_offline_bound
decl_411.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L : ℕ} {O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O →
    I.FlowBound O L →
      ∀ (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D s : ℕ),
        (∀ v ∈ R, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) →
          ∃ T, (I.phaseInstance R D s).Valid m T ∧ (I.phaseInstance R D s).FlowBound T L
decl_411.source:
theorem phase_offline_bound {m L : ℕ} {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D s : ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ R, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) :
    ∃ T, (I.phaseInstance R D s).Valid m T ∧ (I.phaseInstance R D s).FlowBound T L := by
  let J := I.residualInstance R D
  refine ⟨J.rebaseSchedule (I.residualSchedule R D O) s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact J.rebaseSchedule_valid (I.residualSchedule_valid hO R D)
      (I.phase_releases_after_start hs)
  · exact J.rebaseSchedule_flowBound (I.residualSchedule_valid hO R D)
      (I.residualSchedule_flowBound hL R D)
      (I.phase_releases_after_start hs)

decl_412.name: Scheduling.Instance.phase_optimum_le
decl_412.label: Instance.phase_optimum_le
decl_412.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (R : Finset (Fin vertices))
  (D s : ℕ), (∀ v ∈ R, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) → (I.phaseInstance R D s).optimum m hm ≤ I.optimum m hm
decl_412.source:
theorem phase_optimum_le {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D s : ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ R, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) :
    (I.phaseInstance R D s).optimum m hm ≤ I.optimum m hm := by
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hL⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hTL⟩ := I.phase_offline_bound hO hL R D s hs
  exact (I.phaseInstance R D s).optimum_le hm hT hTL

/-- Vertices not yet executed at the start, including future arrivals. -/

decl_498.name: Scheduling.Instance.survivors
decl_498.label: Instance.survivors
decl_498.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → Finset (Fin vertices)
decl_498.source:
noncomputable def survivors (_I : Instance jobs vertices) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s : ℕ) :
    Finset (Fin vertices) := univ.filter (fun v => s ≤ S v)

decl_496.name: Scheduling.Instance.survivorIndex
decl_496.label: Instance.survivorIndex
decl_496.statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) →
    {S : Scheduling.Assignment} → {s : ℕ} → (v : Fin vertices) → v ∈ I.survivors S s → Fin (I.survivors S s).card

decl_462.name: Scheduling.Instance.residualVertex_survivorIndex
decl_462.label: Instance.residualVertex_survivorIndex
decl_462.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {s : ℕ} (v : Fin vertices)
  (hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s), I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) (I.survivorIndex v hv) = v
decl_462.source:
@[simp] theorem residualVertex_survivorIndex {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s : ℕ}
    (v : Fin vertices) (hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s) :
    I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) (I.survivorIndex v hv) = v := by
  simp [residualVertex, survivorIndex]

/-- Keep the executed prefix and use a phase-local schedule for every
survivor. This operation does not reschedule any completed vertex. -/

decl_486.name: Scheduling.Instance.splice
decl_486.label: Instance.splice
decl_486.statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) →
    (S : Scheduling.Assignment) → (s : ℕ) → Scheduling.Assignment → Scheduling.Assignment
decl_486.source:
noncomputable def splice (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s : ℕ)
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card)) : Assignment (vertices := vertices) :=
  fun v => if hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s then s + T (I.survivorIndex v hv) else S v

decl_495.name: Scheduling.Instance.splice_valid
decl_495.label: Instance.splice_valid
decl_495.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m D s : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    ∀ (T : Scheduling.Assignment), (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).Valid m T → I.Valid m (I.splice S s T)
decl_495.source:
theorem splice_valid {m D s : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card))
    (hT : (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).Valid m T) :
    I.Valid m (I.splice S s T) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro v
    by_cases hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s
    · have hr := hT.release (I.survivorIndex v hv)
      simp only [phaseInstance, rebase, residualInstance, residualJob_owner,
        I.residualVertex_survivorIndex] at hr
      simp only [splice, dif_pos hv]
      omega
    · simpa only [splice, dif_neg hv] using hS.release v
  · intro u v he
    by_cases hu : u ∈ I.survivors S s
    · have hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s := by
        have hh := (mem_filter.mp hu).2
        have hp := hS.precedence he
        exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega⟩
      have hedge : (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).edge
          (I.survivorIndex u hu) (I.survivorIndex v hv) := by
        simpa [phaseInstance, rebase, residualInstance] using he
      have hp := hT.precedence hedge
      simpa only [splice, dif_pos hu, dif_pos hv, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_left] using hp
    · have hus : S u < s := by
        simpa [survivors] using hu
      by_cases hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s
      · simp only [splice, dif_neg hu, dif_pos hv]
        omega
      · simpa only [splice, dif_neg hu, dif_neg hv] using hS.precedence he
  · intro t
    by_cases ht : t < s
    · apply (card_le_card (t := univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)) ?_).trans (hS.capacity t)
      intro v hv
      have he := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      by_cases hsur : v ∈ I.survivors S s
      · simp only [splice, dif_pos hsur] at he
        omega
      · exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by simpa only [splice, dif_neg hsur] using he⟩
    · let A := univ.filter (fun v => T v = t - s)
      have hsub : univ.filter (fun v => I.splice S s T v = t) ⊆
          A.image (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s)) := by
        intro v hv
        have he := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
        have hsur : v ∈ I.survivors S s := by
          by_contra hn
          simp only [splice, dif_neg hn] at he
          have hlt : S v < s := by simpa [survivors] using hn
          omega
        refine mem_image.mpr ⟨I.survivorIndex v hsur, ?_, I.residualVertex_survivorIndex v hsur⟩
        simp only [splice, dif_pos hsur] at he
        exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega⟩
      exact (card_le_card hsub).trans (card_image_le.trans (hT.capacity (t - s)))


/-- A phase's local flow bound gives a global bound for its survivors. -/

decl_494.name: Scheduling.Instance.splice_survivor_bound
decl_494.label: Instance.splice_survivor_bound
decl_494.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {D s K : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment}
  {T : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) →
    (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).FlowBound T K →
      ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, I.splice S s T v < I.release (I.owner v) + D + K
decl_494.source:
theorem splice_survivor_bound {D s K : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    {T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card)}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D)
    (hT : (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).FlowBound T K)
    (v : Fin vertices) (hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s) :
    I.splice S s T v < I.release (I.owner v) + D + K := by
  have ht := hT (I.survivorIndex v hv)
  simp only [phaseInstance, rebase, residualInstance, residualJob_owner,
    I.residualVertex_survivorIndex] at ht
  have hr := hs v hv
  simp only [splice, dif_pos hv]
  omega

decl_490.name: Scheduling.Instance.splice_preserves_prefix
decl_490.label: Instance.splice_preserves_prefix
decl_490.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {s : ℕ}
  (T : Scheduling.Assignment) {v : Fin vertices}, S v < s → I.splice S s T v = S v

decl_493.name: Scheduling.Instance.splice_survives
decl_493.label: Instance.splice_survives
decl_493.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {s : ℕ}
  (T : Scheduling.Assignment) (v : Fin vertices), s ≤ I.splice S s T v ↔ s ≤ S v
decl_493.source:
theorem splice_survives {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s : ℕ}
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card)) (v : Fin vertices) :
    s ≤ I.splice S s T v ↔ s ≤ S v := by
  classical
  by_cases hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s
  · have hs := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    simp only [splice, dif_pos hv]
    omega
  · simp only [splice, dif_neg hv]

/-- A fresh SFF phase with artificial delay `44 B²`, expressed as a global
assignment by splicing its local run into the completed prefix. -/

decl_472.name: Scheduling.Instance.sffPhase
decl_472.label: Instance.sffPhase
decl_472.statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → ℕ → (B : ℕ) → 0 < B → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → Scheduling.Assignment
decl_472.source:
noncomputable def sffPhase (m B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s : ℕ) : Assignment (vertices := vertices) := by
  classical
  exact I.splice S s ((I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) (44 * B ^ 2) s).sffSchedule m B hB)

decl_331.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoPhase
decl_331.label: Instance.fifoPhase
decl_331.statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → (m : ℕ) → 0 < m → ℕ → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → Scheduling.Assignment
decl_331.source:
noncomputable def fifoPhase (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (B : ℕ)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s : ℕ) : Assignment (vertices := vertices) := by
  classical
  exact I.splice S s ((I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) (44 * B ^ 2) s).fifoSchedule m hm)

decl_477.name: Scheduling.Instance.sffPhase_valid
decl_477.label: Instance.sffPhase_valid
decl_477.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m B s : ℕ},
  0 < m → ∀ (hB : 0 < B) {S : Scheduling.Assignment}, I.Valid m S → I.Valid m (I.sffPhase m B hB S s)
decl_477.source:
theorem sffPhase_valid {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hB : 0 < B)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (hS : I.Valid m S) :
    I.Valid m (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) := by
  classical
  exact I.splice_valid hS _ ((I.phaseInstance _ _ _).sffSchedule_valid hm hB)

decl_335.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoPhase_valid
decl_335.label: Instance.fifoPhase_valid
decl_335.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S → I.Valid m (I.fifoPhase m hm B S s)
decl_335.source:
theorem fifoPhase_valid {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (hS : I.Valid m S) :
    I.Valid m (I.fifoPhase m hm B S s) := by
  classical
  exact I.splice_valid hS _ ((I.phaseInstance _ _ _).fifoSchedule_valid hm)

decl_476.name: Scheduling.Instance.sffPhase_survivor_bound
decl_476.label: Instance.sffPhase_survivor_bound
decl_476.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hB : 0 < B)
  {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) →
    I.optimum m hm ≤ B → ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, I.sffPhase m B hB S s v < I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2
decl_476.source:
theorem sffPhase_survivor_bound {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hB : 0 < B)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2)
    (hguess : I.optimum m hm ≤ B) (v : Fin vertices) (hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s) :
    I.sffPhase m B hB S s v < I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hL⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hTL⟩ := I.phase_offline_bound hO hL (I.survivors S s) (44 * B ^ 2) s hs
  have hTB : (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) (44 * B ^ 2) s).FlowBound T B := by
    intro w; exact (hTL w).trans_le (Nat.add_le_add_left hguess _)
  have hb := (I.phaseInstance _ _ _).sffSchedule_bound hm hB hT hTB
  have hf := ((I.phaseInstance _ _ _).flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le _ _).mpr hb
  have hg := I.splice_survivor_bound hs hf v hv
  change I.sffPhase m B hB S s v < _ at hg
  nlinarith

decl_334.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoPhase_survivor_bound
decl_334.label: Instance.fifoPhase_survivor_bound
decl_334.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) →
    ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, I.fifoPhase m hm B S s v < I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2 + 44 * m * I.optimum m hm
decl_334.source:
theorem fifoPhase_survivor_bound {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2)
    (v : Fin vertices) (hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s) :
    I.fifoPhase m hm B S s v <
      I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2 + 44 * m * I.optimum m hm := by
  classical
  let J := I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) (44 * B ^ 2) s
  have ho := I.phase_optimum_le hm (I.survivors S s) (44 * B ^ 2) s hs
  change J.optimum m hm ≤ I.optimum m hm at ho
  have hb := J.fifoSchedule_competitive hm
  have hflow : J.maxFlow (J.fifoSchedule m hm) ≤ 44 * m * I.optimum m hm := by
    have hc : m * m + m - 1 ≤ 44 * m * m := by
      have hsq := Nat.mul_le_mul_left m (show 1 ≤ m by omega)
      have hsub := Nat.sub_le (m * m + m) 1
      nlinarith
    have hcomp := Nat.mul_le_mul hc ho
    nlinarith
  exact I.splice_survivor_bound hs ((J.flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le _ _).mpr hflow) v hv

end Scheduling.Instance

decl_856.name: Scheduling.phaseHistory
decl_856.label: phaseHistory
decl_856.source:
def phaseHistory (B s : ℕ) (history : ℕ → FIFOObservation) (u : ℕ) : FIFOObservation :=
  delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s (s + u) (history (s + u))

/-- Only failures observed by the queried time are searched. In particular,
the public controller never tests whether a phase will fail in the future. -/

decl_864.name: Scheduling.publicFailures
decl_864.label: publicFailures
decl_864.statement: ℕ → ℕ → (ℕ → Scheduling.FIFOObservation) → ℕ → Finset ℕ
decl_864.source:
def publicFailures (B s : ℕ) (history : ℕ → FIFOObservation) (t : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Icc s t).filter (fun u => deadlineVisible B u (history u) = true)

decl_862.name: Scheduling.publicCombined
decl_862.label: publicCombined
decl_862.statement: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → (ℕ → Scheduling.FIFOObservation) → ℕ → Finset ℕ
decl_862.source:
def publicCombined (m : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → (ℕ → FIFOObservation) → ℕ → Finset ℕ
  | 0, B, s, history, t => fifoPolicy m (delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s t (history t))
  | fuel + 1, B, s, history, t =>
    if B < m then
      if hf : (publicFailures B s history t).Nonempty then
        publicCombined m fuel (2 * B) ((publicFailures B s history t).min' hf) history t
      else (sffRawPolicy m B).decision (phaseHistory B s history) (t - s)
    else fifoPolicy m (delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s t (history t))

decl_865.name: Scheduling.publicFailures_congr
decl_865.label: publicFailures_congr
decl_865.statement:
∀ (B s t : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → Scheduling.FIFOObservation),
  (∀ u ≤ t, a u = b u) → Scheduling.publicFailures B s a t = Scheduling.publicFailures B s b t
decl_865.source:
theorem publicFailures_congr (B s t : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → FIFOObservation)
    (h : ∀ u ≤ t, a u = b u) : publicFailures B s a t = publicFailures B s b t := by
  apply filter_congr
  intro u hu
  rw [h u (mem_Icc.mp hu).2]

/-- Causality of the public controller, independently of any scheduling
instance: equal observation prefixes give equal decisions. -/

decl_863.name: Scheduling.publicCombined_causal
decl_863.label: publicCombined_causal
decl_863.statement:
∀ (m fuel B s t : ℕ),
  s ≤ t →
    ∀ (a b : ℕ → Scheduling.FIFOObservation),
      (∀ u ≤ t, a u = b u) → Scheduling.publicCombined m fuel B s a t = Scheduling.publicCombined m fuel B s b t
decl_863.source:
theorem publicCombined_causal (m fuel B s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (a b : ℕ → FIFOObservation) (h : ∀ u ≤ t, a u = b u) :
    publicCombined m fuel B s a t = publicCombined m fuel B s b t := by
  induction fuel generalizing B s with
  | zero => simp only [publicCombined, h t le_rfl]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    by_cases hswitch : B < m
    · simp only [publicCombined, if_pos hswitch, publicFailures_congr B s t a b h]
      by_cases hf : (publicFailures B s b t).Nonempty
      · simp only [dif_pos hf]
        have ht := (mem_Icc.mp (mem_filter.mp (min'_mem _ hf)).1).2
        exact ih (2 * B) _ ht
      · simp only [dif_neg hf]
        apply (sffRawPolicy m B).decision_eq_of_history_eq
        intro u hu
        have hle : s + u ≤ t := by omega
        simp only [phaseHistory, h (s + u) hle]
    · simp only [publicCombined, if_neg hswitch, h t le_rfl]

decl_866.name: Scheduling.publicFailures_empty
decl_866.label: publicFailures_empty
decl_866.statement:
∀ {B s t : ℕ} {history : ℕ → Scheduling.FIFOObservation},
  (∀ (u : ℕ), s ≤ u → u ≤ t → Scheduling.deadlineVisible B u (history u) = false) →
    Scheduling.publicFailures B s history t = ∅
decl_866.source:
theorem publicFailures_empty {B s t : ℕ} {history : ℕ → FIFOObservation}
    (h : ∀ u, s ≤ u → u ≤ t → deadlineVisible B u (history u) = false) :
    publicFailures B s history t = ∅ := by
  apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro u hu
  have hh := mem_filter.mp hu
  have ht := mem_Icc.mp hh.1
  have he := h u ht.1 ht.2
  simp [he] at hh

decl_867.name: Scheduling.publicFailures_min_eq
decl_867.label: publicFailures_min_eq
decl_867.statement:
∀ {B s t f : ℕ} {history : ℕ → Scheduling.FIFOObservation},
  s ≤ f →
    f ≤ t →
      Scheduling.deadlineVisible B f (history f) = true →
        (∀ (u : ℕ), s ≤ u → u < f → Scheduling.deadlineVisible B u (history u) = false) →
          ∀ (hne : (Scheduling.publicFailures B s history t).Nonempty),
            (Scheduling.publicFailures B s history t).min' hne = f
decl_867.source:
theorem publicFailures_min_eq {B s t f : ℕ} {history : ℕ → FIFOObservation}
    (hs : s ≤ f) (ht : f ≤ t)
    (hvisible : deadlineVisible B f (history f) = true)
    (hbefore : ∀ u, s ≤ u → u < f → deadlineVisible B u (history u) = false)
    (hne : (publicFailures B s history t).Nonempty) :
    (publicFailures B s history t).min' hne = f := by
  have hmem : f ∈ publicFailures B s history t :=
    mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hs, ht⟩, hvisible⟩
  apply le_antisymm (min'_le _ _ hmem)
  by_contra hn
  have hx := mem_filter.mp (min'_mem _ hne)
  have hh := hbefore _ (mem_Icc.mp hx.1).1 (by omega)
  simp [hh] at hx

decl_855.name: Scheduling.phaseDecision_congr
decl_855.label: phaseDecision_congr
decl_855.statement:
∀ (m B s t : ℕ),
  s ≤ t →
    ∀ (a b : ℕ → Scheduling.FIFOObservation),
      (∀ u ≤ t, a u = b u) →
        (Scheduling.sffRawPolicy m B).decision (Scheduling.phaseHistory B s a) (t - s) =
          (Scheduling.sffRawPolicy m B).decision (Scheduling.phaseHistory B s b) (t - s)
decl_855.source:
theorem phaseDecision_congr (m B s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (a b : ℕ → FIFOObservation) (h : ∀ u ≤ t, a u = b u) :
    (sffRawPolicy m B).decision (phaseHistory B s a) (t - s) =
      (sffRawPolicy m B).decision (phaseHistory B s b) (t - s) := by
  apply (sffRawPolicy m B).decision_eq_of_history_eq
  intro u hu
  have ht : s + u ≤ t := by omega
  simp only [phaseHistory, h (s + u) ht]

namespace Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

decl_295.name: Scheduling.Instance.combinedAux_execution_prefix
decl_295.label: Instance.combinedAux_execution_prefix
decl_295.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B)
  (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (s t : ℕ), t < s → {v | I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s v = t} = {v | S v = t}
decl_295.source:
theorem combinedAux_execution_prefix {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s t : ℕ)
    (ht : t < s) :
    univ.filter (fun v => I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s v = t) =
      univ.filter (fun v => S v = t) := by
  classical
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  have h₀ := I.combinedAux_prefix_time hm fuel B hB S s t ht.le v
  have h₁ := I.combinedAux_prefix_time hm fuel B hB S s (t + 1) (by omega) v
  omega

variable [DecidableRel I.edge]

decl_474.name: Scheduling.Instance.sffPhase_publicPolicy_at
decl_474.label: Instance.sffPhase_publicPolicy_at
decl_474.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m B s t : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (hB : 0 < B) {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
      s ≤ t →
        (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) →
          Finset.image Fin.val {v | I.sffPhase m B hB S s v = t} =
            (Scheduling.sffRawPolicy m B).decision
              (Scheduling.phaseHistory B s (I.readyObservation (I.sffPhase m B hB S s))) (t - s)
decl_474.source:
theorem sffPhase_publicPolicy_at {m B s t : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hB : 0 < B)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.sffPhase m B hB S s v = t)).image Fin.val =
      (sffRawPolicy m B).decision (phaseHistory B s (I.readyObservation (I.sffPhase m B hB S s)))
        (t - s) := by
  have h := I.sffPhase_publicPolicy hm hB hs (t - s)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hst] at h
  exact h

decl_333.name: Scheduling.Instance.fifoPhase_publicPolicy_at
decl_333.label: Instance.fifoPhase_publicPolicy_at
decl_333.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m B s t : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  s ≤ t →
    (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) →
      Finset.image Fin.val {v | I.fifoPhase m hm B S s v = t} =
        Scheduling.fifoPolicy m
          (Scheduling.delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s t (I.readyObservation (I.fifoPhase m hm B S s) t))
decl_333.source:
theorem fifoPhase_publicPolicy_at {m B s t : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.fifoPhase m hm B S s v = t)).image Fin.val =
      fifoPolicy m (delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s t (I.readyObservation (I.fifoPhase m hm B S s) t)) := by
  have h := I.fifoPhase_publicPolicy hm hs (t - s)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hst] at h
  exact h

/-- The finite phase construction realizes the causal public-history
controller. This proof uses no optimum or performance bound. -/

decl_297.name: Scheduling.Instance.combinedAux_publicPolicy
decl_297.label: Instance.combinedAux_publicPolicy
decl_297.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
  (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (s t : ℕ),
  s ≤ t →
    (∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) →
      Finset.image Fin.val {v | I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s v = t} =
        Scheduling.publicCombined m fuel B s (I.readyObservation (I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s)) t
decl_297.source:
theorem combinedAux_publicPolicy {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s t : ℕ)
    (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s v = t)).image Fin.val =
      publicCombined m fuel B s (I.readyObservation (I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s)) t := by
  classical
  induction fuel generalizing B S s with
  | zero => exact I.fifoPhase_publicPolicy_at hm hst hs
  | succ fuel ih =>
    by_cases hswitch : B < m
    · simp only [combinedAux, if_pos hswitch]
      by_cases hf : I.PhaseFails (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) s B
      · rw [dif_pos hf]
        let C := I.sffPhase m B hB S s
        let f := I.failureTime hf
        let A := I.combinedAux m hm fuel (2 * B) (by omega) C f
        have hsf : s ≤ f := (I.failureTime_spec hf).1
        have hobs : ∀ u ≤ f, I.readyObservation A u = I.readyObservation C u := by
          intro u hu
          exact I.combinedAux_readyObservation hm fuel (2 * B) (by omega) C f u hu
        have hstart := I.sffPhase_start_bound (m := m) hB hs
        have hbefore : ∀ u, s ≤ u → u < f →
            deadlineVisible B u (I.readyObservation A u) = false := by
          intro u hsu huf
          rw [hobs u huf.le]
          exact I.before_failure_not_visible hf hstart hsu huf
        change (univ.filter (fun v => A v = t)).image Fin.val =
          publicCombined m (fuel + 1) B s (I.readyObservation A) t
        by_cases htf : t < f
        · have he : publicFailures B s (I.readyObservation A) t = ∅ :=
            publicFailures_empty (by intro u hsu hut; exact hbefore u hsu (by omega))
          have hn : ¬ (publicFailures B s (I.readyObservation A) t).Nonempty := by
            rw [he]
            exact Finset.not_nonempty_empty
          rw [publicCombined, if_pos hswitch, dif_neg hn]
          have hexec := I.combinedAux_execution_prefix hm fuel (2 * B) (by omega) C f t htf
          change univ.filter (fun v => A v = t) = univ.filter (fun v => C v = t) at hexec
          rw [hexec]
          exact (I.sffPhase_publicPolicy_at hm hB hst hs).trans
            (phaseDecision_congr m B s t hst _ _ (by intro u hu; exact (hobs u (by omega)).symm))
        · have hft : f ≤ t := by omega
          have hv : deadlineVisible B f (I.readyObservation A f) = true := by
            rw [hobs f le_rfl]
            exact I.failureTime_visible hf
          have hne : (publicFailures B s (I.readyObservation A) t).Nonempty :=
            ⟨f, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hsf, hft⟩, hv⟩⟩
          rw [publicCombined, if_pos hswitch, dif_pos hne,
            publicFailures_min_eq hsf hft hv hbefore hne]
          exact ih (2 * B) (by omega) C f hft (I.doubled_phase_start hB hs hf)
      · rw [dif_neg hf]
        have hstart := I.sffPhase_start_bound (m := m) hB hs
        have he : publicFailures B s (I.readyObservation (I.sffPhase m B hB S s)) t = ∅ :=
          publicFailures_empty (by intro u hsu _; exact I.no_failure_not_visible hf hstart hsu)
        have hn : ¬ (publicFailures B s (I.readyObservation (I.sffPhase m B hB S s)) t).Nonempty := by
          rw [he]
          exact Finset.not_nonempty_empty
        rw [publicCombined, if_pos hswitch, dif_neg hn]
        exact I.sffPhase_publicPolicy_at hm hB hst hs
    · simp only [combinedAux, if_neg hswitch, publicCombined]
      exact I.fifoPhase_publicPolicy_at hm hst hs

decl_302.name: Scheduling.Instance.combinedSchedule_publicPolicy
decl_302.label: Instance.combinedSchedule_publicPolicy
decl_302.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ),
  Finset.image Fin.val {v | I.combinedSchedule m hm v = t} =
    Scheduling.publicCombined m m 1 0 (I.readyObservation (I.combinedSchedule m hm)) t
decl_302.source:
theorem combinedSchedule_publicPolicy {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.combinedSchedule m hm v = t)).image Fin.val =
      publicCombined m m 1 0 (I.readyObservation (I.combinedSchedule m hm)) t :=
  I.combinedAux_publicPolicy hm m 1 (by omega) I.serialSchedule 0 t (by omega) (by intros; omega)

/-- Full cross-instance non-clairvoyance of the combined scheduler. Its
guesses, restarts, and execution decisions require only observed history. -/

decl_301.name: Scheduling.Instance.combinedSchedule_nonclairvoyant
decl_301.label: Combined algorithm causality
decl_301.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge]
  {otherJobs otherVertices m : ℕ} (J : Scheduling.Instance otherJobs otherVertices) [inst_1 : DecidableRel J.edge]
  (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ),
  (∀ u ≤ t, I.readyObservation (I.combinedSchedule m hm) u = J.readyObservation (J.combinedSchedule m hm) u) →
    Finset.image Fin.val {v | I.combinedSchedule m hm v = t} = Finset.image Fin.val {v | J.combinedSchedule m hm v = t}
decl_301.source:
theorem combinedSchedule_nonclairvoyant {otherJobs otherVertices m : ℕ}
    (J : Instance otherJobs otherVertices) [DecidableRel J.edge]
    (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ u ≤ t, I.readyObservation (I.combinedSchedule m hm) u =
      J.readyObservation (J.combinedSchedule m hm) u) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.combinedSchedule m hm v = t)).image Fin.val =
      (univ.filter (fun v => J.combinedSchedule m hm v = t)).image Fin.val := by
  rw [I.combinedSchedule_publicPolicy hm, J.combinedSchedule_publicPolicy hm]
  exact publicCombined_causal m m 1 0 t (by omega) _ _ h

end Instance
end Scheduling

decl_226.name: Scheduling.GraphObservation
decl_226.label: GraphObservation
decl_226.source:
structure GraphObservation where
  arrivals : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)
  visible : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)
  edges : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)
  ready : Finset ℕ
  deriving DecidableEq

decl_820.name: Scheduling.executionPrefix
decl_820.label: executionPrefix

decl_822.name: Scheduling.executionSlot
decl_822.label: executionSlot

decl_898.name: Scheduling.val_mem_executionPrefix
decl_898.label: val_mem_executionPrefix
decl_898.statement: ∀ {vertices t : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment} (v : Fin vertices), ↑v ∈ Scheduling.executionPrefix S t ↔ S v < t
decl_898.source:
@[simp] theorem val_mem_executionPrefix {vertices t : ℕ}
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (v : Fin vertices) :
    v.val ∈ executionPrefix S t ↔ S v < t := by
  simp only [executionPrefix, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, hval⟩
    have : w = v := Fin.ext hval
    subst w
    exact hw
  · intro h; exact ⟨v, h, rfl⟩

decl_899.name: Scheduling.val_mem_executionSlot
decl_899.label: val_mem_executionSlot
decl_899.statement: ∀ {vertices t : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment} (v : Fin vertices), ↑v ∈ Scheduling.executionSlot S t ↔ S v = t
decl_899.source:
@[simp] theorem val_mem_executionSlot {vertices t : ℕ}
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (v : Fin vertices) :
    v.val ∈ executionSlot S t ↔ S v = t := by
  simp only [executionSlot, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, hval⟩
    have : w = v := Fin.ext hval
    subst w
    exact hw
  · intro h; exact ⟨v, h, rfl⟩

decl_850.name: Scheduling.mem_executionPrefix
decl_850.label: mem_executionPrefix
decl_850.statement:
∀ {vertices n t : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  n ∈ Scheduling.executionPrefix S t ↔ ∃ u < t, n ∈ Scheduling.executionSlot S u
decl_850.source:
theorem mem_executionPrefix {vertices n t : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} :
    n ∈ executionPrefix S t ↔ ∃ u < t, n ∈ executionSlot S u := by
  simp only [executionPrefix, executionSlot, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hn⟩
    exact ⟨S v, hv, v, rfl, hn⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, v, hv, hn⟩
    exact ⟨v, by omega, hn⟩

decl_821.name: Scheduling.executionPrefix_eq_of_slots
decl_821.label: executionPrefix_eq_of_slots
decl_821.statement:
∀ {vertices otherVertices t : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment} {T : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (∀ u < t, Scheduling.executionSlot S u = Scheduling.executionSlot T u) →
    Scheduling.executionPrefix S t = Scheduling.executionPrefix T t
decl_821.source:
theorem executionPrefix_eq_of_slots {vertices otherVertices t : ℕ}
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {T : Assignment (vertices := otherVertices)}
    (h : ∀ u < t, executionSlot S u = executionSlot T u) :
    executionPrefix S t = executionPrefix T t := by
  ext n
  simp only [mem_executionPrefix]
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨u, hu, hn⟩
  · exact ⟨u, hu, by rwa [← h u hu]⟩
  · exact ⟨u, hu, by rwa [h u hu]⟩

namespace Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

decl_464.name: Scheduling.Instance.revealedVertices
decl_464.label: Instance.revealedVertices
decl_464.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Finset ℕ → ℕ → Finset (Fin vertices)
decl_464.source:
noncomputable def revealedVertices (done : Finset ℕ) (t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => I.release (I.owner v) ≤ t ∧ ∀ u, I.edge u v → u.val ∈ done)

decl_378.name: Scheduling.Instance.graphObservation
decl_378.label: Instance.graphObservation
decl_378.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Finset ℕ → ℕ → Scheduling.GraphObservation
decl_378.source:
noncomputable def graphObservation (done : Finset ℕ) (t : ℕ) : GraphObservation where
  arrivals := (univ.filter (fun j => I.release j ≤ t)).image (fun j => (j.val, I.release j))
  visible := (I.revealedVertices done t).image (fun v => (v.val, (I.owner v).val))
  edges := ((I.revealedVertices done t).product (I.revealedVertices done t)).filter
    (fun e => I.edge e.1 e.2) |>.image (fun e => (e.1.val, e.2.val))
  ready := ((I.revealedVertices done t).filter (fun v => v.val ∉ done)).image Fin.val

decl_379.name: Scheduling.Instance.graphObservation_congr
decl_379.label: Instance.graphObservation_congr
decl_379.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I J : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (done : Finset ℕ) (t : ℕ),
  I.owner = J.owner →
    I.release = J.release →
      I.revealedVertices done t = J.revealedVertices done t →
        (∀ u ∈ I.revealedVertices done t, ∀ v ∈ I.revealedVertices done t, I.edge u v ↔ J.edge u v) →
          I.graphObservation done t = J.graphObservation done t
decl_379.source:
theorem graphObservation_congr (J : Instance jobs vertices) (done : Finset ℕ) (t : ℕ)
    (ho : I.owner = J.owner) (hr : I.release = J.release)
    (hv : I.revealedVertices done t = J.revealedVertices done t)
    (he : ∀ u ∈ I.revealedVertices done t, ∀ v ∈ I.revealedVertices done t,
      I.edge u v ↔ J.edge u v) : I.graphObservation done t = J.graphObservation done t := by
  have hedges :
      ((I.revealedVertices done t).product (I.revealedVertices done t)).filter (fun e => I.edge e.1 e.2) =
      ((I.revealedVertices done t).product (I.revealedVertices done t)).filter (fun e => J.edge e.1 e.2) := by
    apply filter_congr
    intro e he'
    exact he _ (mem_product.mp he').1 _ (mem_product.mp he').2
  unfold graphObservation
  rw [hedges, ho, hr, hv]

decl_380.name: Scheduling.Instance.hidden_graphObservation_congr
decl_380.label: Instance.hidden_graphObservation_congr
decl_380.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I J : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (hidden : Finset (Fin vertices)) (done : Finset ℕ)
  (t : ℕ),
  I.owner = J.owner →
    I.release = J.release →
      (∀ (u v : Fin vertices), v ∉ hidden → (I.edge u v ↔ J.edge u v)) →
        (∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, I.edge u v ∧ ↑u ∉ done) →
