          (∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, J.edge u v ∧ ↑u ∉ done) → I.graphObservation done t = J.graphObservation done t
decl_380.source:
theorem hidden_graphObservation_congr (J : Instance jobs vertices)
    (hidden : Finset (Fin vertices)) (done : Finset ℕ) (t : ℕ)
    (ho : I.owner = J.owner) (hr : I.release = J.release)
    (he : ∀ u v, v ∉ hidden → (I.edge u v ↔ J.edge u v))
    (hI : ∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, I.edge u v ∧ u.val ∉ done)
    (hJ : ∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, J.edge u v ∧ u.val ∉ done) :
    I.graphObservation done t = J.graphObservation done t := by
  have houtside : ∀ v ∈ I.revealedVertices done t, v ∉ hidden := by
    intro v hv hhidden
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hn⟩ := hI v hhidden
    exact hn ((mem_filter.mp hv).2.2 u hu)
  apply I.graphObservation_congr J done t ho hr
  · ext v
    simp only [revealedVertices, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    by_cases hv : v ∈ hidden
    · obtain ⟨u, hu, hn⟩ := hI v hv
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hm⟩ := hJ v hv
      constructor
      · intro h; exact False.elim (hn (h.2 u hu))
      · intro h; exact False.elim (hm (h.2 w hw))
    · simp only [ho, hr]
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact ⟨h.1, fun u hu => h.2 u ((he u v hv).mpr hu)⟩
      · intro h
        exact ⟨h.1, fun u hu => h.2 u ((he u v hv).mp hu)⟩
  · intro u _ v hv
    exact he u v (houtside v hv)

end Instance

/-- Extensional formulation of a deterministic online scheduler. Total
assignments suffice for lower bounds against algorithms with finite flow.
The causality field uses the full revealed graph, not just ready labels. -/

decl_187.name: Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler
decl_187.label: DeterministicScheduler
decl_187.source:
structure DeterministicScheduler (m : ℕ) where
  schedule : {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Instance jobs vertices → Assignment (vertices := vertices)
  valid : ∀ {jobs vertices} (I : Instance jobs vertices), I.Valid m (schedule I)
  causal : ∀ {jobs vertices otherJobs otherVertices}
    (I : Instance jobs vertices) (J : Instance otherJobs otherVertices) (t : ℕ),
    (∀ u ≤ t, I.graphObservation (executionPrefix (schedule I) u) u =
      J.graphObservation (executionPrefix (schedule J) u) u) →
    executionSlot (schedule I) t = executionSlot (schedule J) t

namespace DeterministicScheduler
variable {m : ℕ} (A : DeterministicScheduler m)

/-- An adaptive replacement can be checked along the old execution alone.
If it changes no observations through `T`, the new instance reproduces
every old decision through `T`. This removes the apparent circularity in
changing hidden edges while preserving a scheduler's past behavior. -/

decl_197.name: Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler.transfer_slots
decl_197.label: DeterministicScheduler.transfer_slots
decl_197.statement:
∀ {m : ℕ} (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) {jobs vertices otherJobs otherVertices T : ℕ}
  (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (J : Scheduling.Instance otherJobs otherVertices),
  (∀ u ≤ T,
      I.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u =
        J.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u) →
    ∀ t ≤ T, Scheduling.executionSlot (A.schedule I) t = Scheduling.executionSlot (A.schedule J) t
decl_197.source:
theorem transfer_slots {jobs vertices otherJobs otherVertices T : ℕ}
    (I : Instance jobs vertices) (J : Instance otherJobs otherVertices)
    (h : ∀ u ≤ T, I.graphObservation (executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u =
      J.graphObservation (executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u) :
    ∀ t ≤ T, executionSlot (A.schedule I) t = executionSlot (A.schedule J) t := by
  intro t
  induction t using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h t ih =>
    intro ht
    apply A.causal I J t
    intro u hu
    have hp : executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u = executionPrefix (A.schedule J) u :=
      executionPrefix_eq_of_slots (by
        intro k hk
        exact ih k (by omega) (by omega))
    rw [← hp]
    exact h u (by omega)

decl_196.name: Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler.transfer_prefix
decl_196.label: DeterministicScheduler.transfer_prefix
decl_196.statement:
∀ {m : ℕ} (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) {jobs vertices otherJobs otherVertices T : ℕ}
  (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (J : Scheduling.Instance otherJobs otherVertices),
  (∀ u ≤ T,
      I.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u =
        J.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u) →
    Scheduling.executionPrefix (A.schedule I) (T + 1) = Scheduling.executionPrefix (A.schedule J) (T + 1)
decl_196.source:
theorem transfer_prefix {jobs vertices otherJobs otherVertices T : ℕ}
    (I : Instance jobs vertices) (J : Instance otherJobs otherVertices)
    (h : ∀ u ≤ T, I.graphObservation (executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u =
      J.graphObservation (executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u) :
    executionPrefix (A.schedule I) (T + 1) = executionPrefix (A.schedule J) (T + 1) :=
  executionPrefix_eq_of_slots (by intro u hu; exact A.transfer_slots I J h u (by omega))

decl_198.name: Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler.transfer_time
decl_198.label: DeterministicScheduler.transfer_time
decl_198.statement:
∀ {m : ℕ} (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) {jobs vertices T : ℕ} (I J : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices),
  (∀ u ≤ T,
      I.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u =
        J.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u) →
    ∀ (v : Fin vertices), A.schedule I v ≤ T → A.schedule J v = A.schedule I v
decl_198.source:
theorem transfer_time {jobs vertices T : ℕ}
    (I J : Instance jobs vertices)
    (h : ∀ u ≤ T, I.graphObservation (executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u =
      J.graphObservation (executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u)
    (v : Fin vertices) (ht : A.schedule I v ≤ T) : A.schedule J v = A.schedule I v := by
  have he := A.transfer_slots I J h (A.schedule I v) ht
  have hm : v.val ∈ executionSlot (A.schedule I) (A.schedule I v) :=
    mem_image.mpr ⟨v, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [he] at hm
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hv⟩ := mem_image.mp hm
  have heq : w = v := Fin.ext hv
  subst w
  exact (mem_filter.mp hw).2

decl_194.name: Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler.hidden_replacement
decl_194.label: DeterministicScheduler.hidden_replacement
decl_194.statement:
∀ {m : ℕ} (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) {jobs vertices T : ℕ} (I J : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices)
  (hidden : Finset (Fin vertices)),
  I.owner = J.owner →
    I.release = J.release →
      (∀ (u v : Fin vertices), v ∉ hidden → (I.edge u v ↔ J.edge u v)) →
        (∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, I.edge u v ∧ T ≤ A.schedule I u) →
          (∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, J.edge u v ∧ T ≤ A.schedule I u) →
            (∀ t ≤ T, Scheduling.executionSlot (A.schedule I) t = Scheduling.executionSlot (A.schedule J) t) ∧
              ∀ (v : Fin vertices), A.schedule I v ≤ T → A.schedule J v = A.schedule I v
decl_194.source:
theorem hidden_replacement {jobs vertices T : ℕ}
    (I J : Instance jobs vertices) (hidden : Finset (Fin vertices))
    (ho : I.owner = J.owner) (hr : I.release = J.release)
    (he : ∀ u v, v ∉ hidden → (I.edge u v ↔ J.edge u v))
    (hI : ∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, I.edge u v ∧ T ≤ A.schedule I u)
    (hJ : ∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, J.edge u v ∧ T ≤ A.schedule I u) :
    (∀ t ≤ T, executionSlot (A.schedule I) t = executionSlot (A.schedule J) t) ∧
      (∀ v, A.schedule I v ≤ T → A.schedule J v = A.schedule I v) := by
  have hobs : ∀ t ≤ T, I.graphObservation (executionPrefix (A.schedule I) t) t =
      J.graphObservation (executionPrefix (A.schedule I) t) t := by
    intro t ht
    apply I.hidden_graphObservation_congr J hidden _ t ho hr he
    · intro v hv
      obtain ⟨u, hu, htime⟩ := hI v hv
      refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
      simp only [executionPrefix, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
      rintro ⟨w, hw, hwu⟩
      have : w = u := Fin.ext hwu
      subst w
      omega
    · intro v hv
      obtain ⟨u, hu, htime⟩ := hJ v hv
      refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
      simp only [executionPrefix, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
      rintro ⟨w, hw, hwu⟩
      have : w = u := Fin.ext hwu
      subst w
      omega
  exact ⟨A.transfer_slots I J hobs, A.transfer_time I J hobs⟩

end DeterministicScheduler
end Scheduling

decl_668.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot
decl_668.label: PublicSnapshot
decl_668.source:
structure PublicSnapshot where
  support : Finset ℕ
  ready : ℕ → Finset ℕ
  supported : ∀ b, b ∈ support ↔ (ready b).Nonempty

namespace PublicSnapshot

decl_671.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.ext_ready
decl_671.label: PublicSnapshot.ext_ready
decl_671.statement: ∀ {Q R : Scheduling.PublicSnapshot}, Q.ready = R.ready → Q = R
decl_671.source:
theorem ext_ready {Q R : PublicSnapshot} (h : Q.ready = R.ready) : Q = R := by
  cases Q with
  | mk qs qr qp =>
    cases R with
    | mk rs rr rp =>
      change qr = rr at h
      subst rr
      have hs : qs = rs := by
        ext b
        exact (qp b).trans (rp b).symm
      subst rs
      rfl

decl_683.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.small
decl_683.label: PublicSnapshot.small
decl_683.source:
def small (Q : PublicSnapshot) (m : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  Q.support.filter (fun b => (Q.ready b).card ≤ m)

decl_674.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.large
decl_674.label: PublicSnapshot.large
decl_674.source:
def large (Q : PublicSnapshot) (m : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  Q.support.filter (fun b => m < (Q.ready b).card)

decl_684.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.smallFront
decl_684.label: PublicSnapshot.smallFront
decl_684.source: def smallFront (Q : PublicSnapshot) (m : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := (Q.small m).biUnion Q.ready

decl_672.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.filler
decl_672.label: PublicSnapshot.filler
decl_672.source:
def filler (Q : PublicSnapshot) (m : ℕ) : Option ℕ :=
  if h : (Q.large m).Nonempty then some ((Q.large m).min' h) else none

decl_673.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.fillerFront
decl_673.label: PublicSnapshot.fillerFront
decl_673.source:
def fillerFront (Q : PublicSnapshot) (m : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  match Q.filler m with | none => ∅ | some b => Q.ready b

decl_670.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.duration
decl_670.label: PublicSnapshot.duration
decl_670.source: def duration (Q : PublicSnapshot) (m : ℕ) : ℕ := Packing.duration (Q.smallFront m).card m

decl_669.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.action
decl_669.label: PublicSnapshot.action
decl_669.source:
def action (Q : PublicSnapshot) (m k : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k ∪
    if k + 1 = Q.duration m then
      Packing.slice (Q.fillerFront m) 0 (m - (Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k).card)
    else ∅

end PublicSnapshot

namespace ReadySnapshot
variable {vertices batches : ℕ} (Q : ReadySnapshot (Fin vertices) batches)

decl_697.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose
decl_697.label: ReadySnapshot.expose
decl_697.statement: {vertices batches : ℕ} → Scheduling.ReadySnapshot (Fin vertices) batches → Scheduling.PublicSnapshot
decl_697.source:
def expose : PublicSnapshot where
  support := (univ.filter (fun b => (Q.ready b).Nonempty)).image Fin.val
  ready := fun n => if hn : n < batches then (Q.ready ⟨n, hn⟩).image Fin.val else ∅
  supported := by
    intro n
    by_cases hn : n < batches
    · simp only [dif_pos hn, image_nonempty, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨b, hb, he⟩
        have hb' : b = ⟨n, hn⟩ := Fin.ext he
        simpa [hb'] using hb
      · intro h
        exact ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, h, rfl⟩
    · simp only [dif_neg hn, Finset.not_nonempty_empty, iff_false, mem_image, mem_filter,
        mem_univ, true_and]
      rintro ⟨b, _, he⟩
      exact hn (he ▸ b.isLt)

decl_703.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose_ready
decl_703.label: ReadySnapshot.expose_ready
decl_703.statement:
∀ {vertices batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot (Fin vertices) batches) (b : Fin batches),
  Q.expose.ready ↑b = Finset.image Fin.val (Q.ready b)
decl_703.source:
@[simp] theorem expose_ready (b : Fin batches) :
    Q.expose.ready b.val = (Q.ready b).image Fin.val := by
  simp [expose]

decl_715.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.mem_expose_ready
decl_715.label: ReadySnapshot.mem_expose_ready
decl_715.statement:
∀ {vertices batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot (Fin vertices) batches) (b n : ℕ),
  n ∈ Q.expose.ready b ↔ ∃ c, ↑c = b ∧ ∃ v ∈ Q.ready c, ↑v = n
decl_715.source:
theorem mem_expose_ready (b n : ℕ) : n ∈ Q.expose.ready b ↔
    ∃ c : Fin batches, c.val = b ∧ ∃ v, v ∈ Q.ready c ∧ v.val = n := by
  by_cases hb : b < batches
  · simp only [expose, dif_pos hb, mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, he⟩
      exact ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, rfl, v, hv, he⟩
    · rintro ⟨c, hc, v, hv, he⟩
      have hcb : c = ⟨b, hb⟩ := Fin.ext hc
      exact ⟨v, by simpa [hcb] using hv, he⟩
  · simp only [expose, dif_neg hb, notMem_empty, false_iff]
    rintro ⟨c, hc, _⟩
    exact hb (hc ▸ c.isLt)

decl_704.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose_small
decl_704.label: ReadySnapshot.expose_small
decl_704.statement:
∀ {vertices batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot (Fin vertices) batches) (m : ℕ),
  Q.expose.small m = Finset.image Fin.val (Q.small m)
decl_704.source:
theorem expose_small (m : ℕ) : Q.expose.small m = (Q.small m).image Fin.val := by
  ext n
  constructor
  · intro hn
    have hn' := mem_filter.mp hn
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hn'.1
    have hp : 0 < (Q.ready b).card := card_pos.mpr (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    have hc : (Q.ready b).card ≤ m := by
      simpa only [Q.expose_ready, card_image_of_injective _ Fin.val_injective] using hn'.2
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨b, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hp, hc⟩, rfl⟩
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hn
    have hb' := (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    refine mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact mem_image.mpr ⟨b, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, card_pos.mp hb'.1⟩, rfl⟩
    · simpa only [Q.expose_ready, card_image_of_injective _ Fin.val_injective] using hb'.2

decl_702.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose_large
decl_702.label: ReadySnapshot.expose_large
decl_702.statement:
∀ {vertices batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot (Fin vertices) batches) (m : ℕ),
  Q.expose.large m = Finset.image Fin.val (Q.large m)
decl_702.source:
theorem expose_large (m : ℕ) : Q.expose.large m = (Q.large m).image Fin.val := by
  ext n
  constructor
  · intro hn
    have hn' := mem_filter.mp hn
    obtain ⟨b, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hn'.1
    have hc : m < (Q.ready b).card := by
      simpa only [Q.expose_ready, card_image_of_injective _ Fin.val_injective] using hn'.2
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨b, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hc⟩, rfl⟩
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hn
    have hb' := (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    refine mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact mem_image.mpr ⟨b, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, card_pos.mp (by omega)⟩, rfl⟩
    · simpa only [Q.expose_ready, card_image_of_injective _ Fin.val_injective] using hb'

decl_705.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose_smallFront
decl_705.label: ReadySnapshot.expose_smallFront
decl_705.statement:
∀ {vertices batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot (Fin vertices) batches) (m : ℕ),
  Q.expose.smallFront m = Finset.image Fin.val (Q.smallFront m)
decl_705.source:
theorem expose_smallFront (m : ℕ) :
    Q.expose.smallFront m = (Q.smallFront m).image Fin.val := by
  ext n
  constructor
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hv⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp hn
    rw [Q.expose_small] at hk
    obtain ⟨b, hb, he⟩ := mem_image.mp hk
    subst k
    rw [Q.expose_ready] at hv
    obtain ⟨v, hw, he⟩ := mem_image.mp hv
    subst n
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨v, mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨b, hb, hw⟩, rfl⟩
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hn
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hv⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp hv
    apply mem_biUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨b.val, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Q.expose_small]
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    · rw [Q.expose_ready]
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩

decl_700.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose_filler
decl_700.label: ReadySnapshot.expose_filler
decl_700.statement:
∀ {vertices batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot (Fin vertices) batches) (m : ℕ),
  Q.expose.filler m = Option.map Fin.val (Q.filler m)
decl_700.source:
theorem expose_filler (m : ℕ) : Q.expose.filler m = (Q.filler m).map Fin.val := by
  unfold PublicSnapshot.filler ReadySnapshot.filler
  rw [Q.expose_large]
  by_cases h : (Q.large m).Nonempty
  · simp only [h, image_nonempty, ↓reduceDIte, Option.map_some]
    congr 1
    exact min'_image (f := Fin.val) (show Monotone (Fin.val : Fin batches → ℕ) from fun _ _ hab => hab) _ _
  · simp only [h, image_nonempty, ↓reduceDIte, Option.map_none]

decl_701.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose_fillerFront
decl_701.label: ReadySnapshot.expose_fillerFront
decl_701.statement:
∀ {vertices batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot (Fin vertices) batches) (m : ℕ),
  Q.expose.fillerFront m = Finset.image Fin.val (Q.fillerFront m)
decl_701.source:
theorem expose_fillerFront (m : ℕ) :
    Q.expose.fillerFront m = (Q.fillerFront m).image Fin.val := by
  unfold PublicSnapshot.fillerFront ReadySnapshot.fillerFront
  rw [Q.expose_filler]
  cases h : Q.filler m with
  | none => simp
  | some b => simp only [Option.map_some, Q.expose_ready]

decl_699.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose_duration
decl_699.label: ReadySnapshot.expose_duration
decl_699.statement:
∀ {vertices batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot (Fin vertices) batches) (m : ℕ),
  Q.expose.duration m = Q.duration m
decl_699.source:
theorem expose_duration (m : ℕ) : Q.expose.duration m = Q.duration m := by
  unfold PublicSnapshot.duration ReadySnapshot.duration
  rw [Q.expose_smallFront, card_image_of_injective _ Fin.val_injective]

/-- The public planner computes exactly the finite executor's round actions. -/

decl_698.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose_action
decl_698.label: ReadySnapshot.expose_action
decl_698.statement:
∀ {vertices batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot (Fin vertices) batches) (m k : ℕ),
  Q.expose.action m k = Finset.image Fin.val (Q.action m k)
decl_698.source:
theorem expose_action (m k : ℕ) : Q.expose.action m k = (Q.action m k).image Fin.val := by
  have hmono : StrictMono (Fin.val : Fin vertices → ℕ) := fun _ _ h => h
  unfold PublicSnapshot.action ReadySnapshot.action
  rw [Q.expose_smallFront, Q.expose_fillerFront, Q.expose_duration]
  rw [← Packing.slot_image _ _ hmono, card_image_of_injective _ Fin.val_injective]
  rw [image_union]
  split_ifs <;> simp only [Packing.slice_image _ _ hmono, image_empty]

end ReadySnapshot
end Scheduling

decl_685.name: Scheduling.RandomizedScheduler
decl_685.label: RandomizedScheduler
decl_685.statement: (Ω : Type u_1) → [MeasurableSpace Ω] → ℕ → Type u_1
decl_685.source:
structure RandomizedScheduler (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (m : ℕ) where
  scheduler : Ω → DeterministicScheduler m
  measurableFlow : ∀ {jobs vertices} (I : Instance jobs vertices),
    Measurable (fun ω => (I.maxFlow ((scheduler ω).schedule I) : ℝ≥0∞))

namespace RandomizedScheduler
variable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {m : ℕ}

/-- Extended nonnegative expectation also covers infinite expected flow. -/

decl_686.name: Scheduling.RandomizedScheduler.expectedFlow
decl_686.label: RandomizedScheduler.expectedFlow
decl_686.statement:
{Ω : Type u_1} →
  [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] →
    {m : ℕ} →
      Scheduling.RandomizedScheduler Ω m →
        MeasureTheory.Measure Ω → {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → ENNReal
decl_686.source:
noncomputable def expectedFlow (A : RandomizedScheduler Ω m) (μ : Measure Ω)
    {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ∫⁻ ω, (I.maxFlow ((A.scheduler ω).schedule I) : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μ

end RandomizedScheduler

namespace FiniteAmplification

/-- Finite-input averaging over an arbitrary probability space of seeds.
The selected input is independent of the seed. -/

decl_207.name: Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.exists_expected_large
decl_207.label: Average over arbitrary random seeds
decl_207.statement:
∀ {β : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype β] [Nonempty β] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (cost : β → Ω → ℕ) (F : ℕ),
  (∀ (b : β), Measurable fun ω => ↑(cost b ω)) →
    (∀ (ω : Ω), Fintype.card β * F ≤ 2 * ∑ b, cost b ω) → ∃ b, ↑F ≤ 2 * ∫⁻ (ω : Ω), ↑(cost b ω) ∂μ
decl_207.source:
theorem exists_expected_large {β Ω : Type*} [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (cost : β → Ω → ℕ) (F : ℕ)
    (hmeas : ∀ b, Measurable (fun ω => (cost b ω : ℝ≥0∞)))
    (hlower : ∀ ω, Fintype.card β * F ≤ 2 * ∑ b, cost b ω) :
    ∃ b, (F : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2 * ∫⁻ ω, (cost b ω : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μ := by
  have hp : ∀ ω, (Fintype.card β : ℝ≥0∞) * F ≤ 2 * ∑ b, (cost b ω : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    intro ω
    exact_mod_cast hlower ω
  have hi := lintegral_mono hp (μ := μ)
  rw [lintegral_const, measure_univ, mul_one,
    lintegral_const_mul' _ _ (by norm_num), lintegral_finsetSum univ (fun b _ => hmeas b)] at hi
  have hs : (∑ _b : β, (F : ℝ≥0∞)) ≤ ∑ b : β, 2 * ∫⁻ ω, (cost b ω : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μ := by
    simpa only [sum_const, card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_sum] using hi
  obtain ⟨b, _, hb⟩ := ENNReal.exists_le_of_sum_le (s := univ) univ_nonempty hs
  exact ⟨b, hb⟩

end FiniteAmplification

namespace InstanceSequence
variable {α Ω : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α] [MeasurableSpace Ω] {m : ℕ}

decl_511.name: Scheduling.InstanceSequence.sum_flow_lower
decl_511.label: InstanceSequence.sum_flow_lower
decl_511.statement:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [Nonempty α] {m : ℕ} (G : α → Scheduling.PackedInstance) (D F : ℕ)
  (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m),
  (∀ (x : α) (j : Fin (G x).jobs), (G x).graph.release j + F ≤ D) →
    (∀ (P : Scheduling.PackedInstance) (d : ℕ), ∃ x, F ≤ (P.append (G x) d).onlineFlow A) →
      Fintype.card (Fin (Fintype.card α) → α) * F ≤
        2 * ∑ w, (Scheduling.InstanceSequence.concatenate G D (List.ofFn w)).onlineFlow A
decl_511.source:
theorem sum_flow_lower (G : α → PackedInstance) (D F : ℕ) (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (hgap : ∀ x j, (G x).graph.release j + F ≤ D)
    (hhard : ∀ P : PackedInstance, ∀ d, ∃ x, F ≤ (P.append (G x) d).onlineFlow A) :
    Fintype.card (Fin (Fintype.card α) → α) * F ≤
      2 * ∑ w : Fin (Fintype.card α) → α, (concatenate G D (List.ofFn w)).onlineFlow A :=
  FiniteAmplification.cost_sum_lower (fun xs => (concatenate G D xs).onlineFlow A) F
    (bad_persists G D F A hgap) (exists_bad_next G D F A hhard)

decl_506.name: Scheduling.InstanceSequence.exists_expected_flow
decl_506.label: InstanceSequence.exists_expected_flow
decl_506.statement:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype α] [Nonempty α] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace Ω] {m : ℕ}
  (G : α → Scheduling.PackedInstance) (D F : ℕ) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  (A : Scheduling.RandomizedScheduler Ω m),
  (∀ (x : α) (j : Fin (G x).jobs), (G x).graph.release j + F ≤ D) →
    (∀ (B : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) (P : Scheduling.PackedInstance) (d : ℕ),
        ∃ x, F ≤ (P.append (G x) d).onlineFlow B) →
      ∃ w, ↑F ≤ 2 * A.expectedFlow μ (Scheduling.InstanceSequence.concatenate G D (List.ofFn w)).graph
decl_506.source:
theorem exists_expected_flow (G : α → PackedInstance) (D F : ℕ)
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : RandomizedScheduler Ω m)
    (hgap : ∀ x j, (G x).graph.release j + F ≤ D)
    (hhard : ∀ B : DeterministicScheduler m, ∀ P : PackedInstance, ∀ d,
      ∃ x, F ≤ (P.append (G x) d).onlineFlow B) :
    ∃ w : Fin (Fintype.card α) → α,
      (F : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2 * A.expectedFlow μ (concatenate G D (List.ofFn w)).graph := by
  apply FiniteAmplification.exists_expected_large μ
    (fun w ω => (concatenate G D (List.ofFn w)).onlineFlow (A.scheduler ω)) F
  · intro w
    exact A.measurableFlow _
  · intro ω
    exact sum_flow_lower G D F (A.scheduler ω) hgap (hhard _)

end InstanceSequence
end Scheduling

decl_234.name: Scheduling.HardFamily.expected_lower
decl_234.label: One fixed input with large expected flow
decl_234.statement:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {jobs m L b c : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L) (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : Scheduling.RandomizedScheduler Ω m)
  (S : Finset (Scheduling.ForestCode jobs (m * L))),
  (∀ P ∈ S, L ≤ (P.toInstance L ⋯).optimum m hm ∧ (P.toInstance L ⋯).optimum m hm ≤ b * L) →
    (∀ (B : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) (Q : Scheduling.PackedInstance) (d : ℕ),
        ∃ P ∈ S,
          c * L ≤ (Q.graph.append (P.toInstance L ⋯) d).maxFlow (B.schedule (Q.graph.append (P.toInstance L ⋯) d))) →
      ∃ Q,
        (∀ (u v w : Fin Q.vertices), Q.graph.edge u w → Q.graph.edge v w → u = v) ∧
          L ≤ Q.graph.optimum m hm ∧
            Q.graph.optimum m hm ≤ b * L ∧
              (∀ (j : Fin Q.jobs), L ∣ Q.graph.release j) ∧ ↑c * ↑L ≤ 2 * A.expectedFlow μ Q.graph
decl_234.source:
theorem expected_lower {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {jobs m L b c : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L)
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : RandomizedScheduler Ω m)
    (S : Finset (ForestCode jobs (m * L)))
    (hopt : ∀ P ∈ S, L ≤ (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)).optimum m hm ∧
      (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)).optimum m hm ≤ b * L)
    (hhard : ∀ B : DeterministicScheduler m, ∀ Q : PackedInstance, ∀ d,
      ∃ P ∈ S, c * L ≤ (Q.graph.append (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)) d).maxFlow
        (B.schedule (Q.graph.append (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)) d))) :
    ∃ Q : PackedInstance,
      (∀ u v w, Q.graph.edge u w → Q.graph.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      L ≤ Q.graph.optimum m hm ∧ Q.graph.optimum m hm ≤ b * L ∧
      (∀ j, L ∣ Q.graph.release j) ∧ (c * L : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2 * A.expectedFlow μ Q.graph := by
  let α := {P // P ∈ S}
  have hΩ := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure μ
  obtain ⟨ω⟩ := hΩ
  obtain ⟨P, hP, _⟩ := hhard (A.scheduler ω) PackedInstance.empty 0
  let : Nonempty α := ⟨⟨P, hP⟩⟩
  let G : α → PackedInstance := fun x => ⟨jobs, jobs * (m * L), x.val.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)⟩
  let D := (jobs + b + c) * L
  have hgapB : ∀ x j, (G x).graph.release j + b * L ≤ D := by
    intro x j
    have hj := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (Nat.le_of_lt j.isLt)
    change j.val * L + b * L ≤ (jobs + b + c) * L
    nlinarith
  have hgapC : ∀ x j, (G x).graph.release j + c * L ≤ D := by
    intro x j
    have hj := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (Nat.le_of_lt j.isLt)
    change j.val * L + c * L ≤ (jobs + b + c) * L
    nlinarith
  have hoff : ∀ x, ∃ O, (G x).graph.Valid m O ∧ (G x).graph.FlowBound O (b * L) := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨O, hO, hf⟩ := (G x).graph.optimum_attained hm
    refine ⟨O, hO, ?_⟩
    intro v
    exact (hf v).trans_le (Nat.add_le_add_left (hopt x.val x.property).2 _)
  have hnext : ∀ B : DeterministicScheduler m, ∀ Q : PackedInstance, ∀ d,
      ∃ x, c * L ≤ (Q.append (G x) d).onlineFlow B := by
    intro B Q d
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hf⟩ := hhard B Q d
    exact ⟨⟨P, hP⟩, hf⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := InstanceSequence.exists_expected_flow G D (c * L) μ A hgapC hnext
  have hne : List.ofFn w ≠ [] := by
    intro he
    have hh := congrArg List.length he
    simp only [List.length_ofFn, List.length_nil] at hh
    exact (Nat.ne_of_gt (Fintype.card_pos (α := α))) hh
  let Q := InstanceSequence.concatenate G D (List.ofFn w)
  refine ⟨Q, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact InstanceSequence.outForest G D (fun x _ _ _ hu hv => x.val.outForest L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL) hu hv) _
  · exact InstanceSequence.optimum_ge G D L hm (fun x => (hopt x.val x.property).1) _ hne
  · obtain ⟨O, hO, hf⟩ := InstanceSequence.offline G D (b * L) m hoff hgapB (List.ofFn w)
    exact Q.graph.optimum_le hm hO hf
  · exact InstanceSequence.batched_releases G D L (dvd_mul_left L _) (fun x j => dvd_mul_left L j.val) _
  · simpa only [Nat.cast_mul] using hw

end Scheduling.HardFamily

decl_871.name: Scheduling.randomized_lower_bound
decl_871.label: randomized_lower_bound
decl_871.statement:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {m c L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m),
  0 < c →
    0 < L →
      2 * (L / 2) = L →
        16 * c ≤ L →
          2 * c ≤ m →
            ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
              (A : Scheduling.RandomizedScheduler Ω m),
              ∃ jobs vertices I,
                (∀ (u v w : Fin vertices), I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
                  L ≤ I.optimum m ⋯ ∧ I.optimum m ⋯ ≤ 2 * L ∧ ↑c * ↑L ≤ 2 * A.expectedFlow μ I
decl_871.source:
theorem randomized_lower_bound {m c L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hc : 0 < c) (hL : 0 < L)
    (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L) (hcL : 16 * c ≤ L) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : RandomizedScheduler Ω m) :
    ∃ jobs vertices, ∃ I : Instance jobs vertices,
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      L ≤ I.optimum m (by omega) ∧ I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 2 * L ∧
      (c * L : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2 * A.expectedFlow μ I := by
  obtain ⟨Q, hf, hlo, hhi, _, hexp⟩ := HardFamily.expected_lower (b := 2) (c := c)
    (by omega : 0 < m) hL μ A (HardFamily.general (c * (c * (m * L))) m L (by omega) hL)
    (fun P hP => (HardFamily.mem_general P).mp hP)
    (fun B Q d => HardFamily.general_hard_after hm hc hL heven hcL hcm B Q.graph d)
  exact ⟨Q.jobs, Q.vertices, Q.graph, hf, hlo, hhi, hexp⟩

/-- The `Ω(min(m, OPT))` lower bound for arbitrary measurable randomized
causal schedulers, at every positive scale divisible by sixteen. -/

decl_870.name: Scheduling.randomized_competitive_lower
decl_870.label:
Theorem 1 · Randomized
General lower bound
decl_870.statement:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m),
  16 ≤ L →
    16 ∣ L →
      ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : Scheduling.RandomizedScheduler Ω m),
        ∃ jobs vertices I,
          (∀ (u v w : Fin vertices), I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
            L ≤ I.optimum m ⋯ ∧
              I.optimum m ⋯ ≤ 2 * L ∧ ↑(min m (I.optimum m ⋯)) * ↑(I.optimum m ⋯) ≤ 128 * A.expectedFlow μ I
decl_870.source:
theorem randomized_competitive_lower {m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (hL : 16 ≤ L) (hdiv : 16 ∣ L)
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : RandomizedScheduler Ω m) :
    ∃ jobs vertices, ∃ I : Instance jobs vertices,
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      L ≤ I.optimum m (by omega) ∧ I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 2 * L ∧
      (↑(min m (I.optimum m (by omega))) : ℝ≥0∞) * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤
        128 * A.expectedFlow μ I := by
  let c := min (m / 2) (L / 16)
  have hc : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; omega
  have hcL : 16 * c ≤ L := by dsimp [c]; omega
  have hcm : 2 * c ≤ m := by dsimp [c]; omega
  have hmod := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hdiv
  have heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L := by omega
  obtain ⟨jobs, vertices, I, hf, hlo, hhi, hexp⟩ :=
    randomized_lower_bound hm hc (by omega) heven hcL hcm μ A
  refine ⟨jobs, vertices, I, hf, hlo, hhi, ?_⟩
  have hmin : min m (I.optimum m (by omega)) ≤ 32 * c := by
    by_cases hh : m / 2 ≤ L / 16
    · have he : c = m / 2 := min_eq_left hh
      omega
    · have he : c = L / 16 := min_eq_right (by omega)
      omega
  have hn : min m (I.optimum m (by omega)) * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 64 * (c * L) := by
    have h₁ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (I.optimum m (by omega)) hmin
    have h₂ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c hhi
    nlinarith
  calc
    (↑(min m (I.optimum m (by omega))) : ℝ≥0∞) * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤
        64 * (c * L : ℝ≥0∞) := by
          have hh : (↑(min m (I.optimum m (by omega)) * I.optimum m (by omega)) : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ↑(64 * (c * L)) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hn
          simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hh
    _ ≤ 64 * (2 * A.expectedFlow μ I) := mul_le_mul le_rfl hexp zero_le zero_le
    _ = 128 * A.expectedFlow μ I := by ring

/-- Randomized batched lower bound with exact optimum and releases at
multiples of that optimum. The entire instance is fixed before the seed. -/

decl_869.name: Scheduling.randomized_batched_lower_bound
decl_869.label: randomized_batched_lower_bound
decl_869.statement:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {m c : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m),
  0 < c →
    2 * c ≤ m →
      ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : Scheduling.RandomizedScheduler Ω m),
        ∃ jobs vertices I,
          (∀ (u v w : Fin vertices), I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
            I.optimum m ⋯ = 8 * c * 5 ^ c ∧
              (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.optimum m ⋯ ∣ I.release j) ∧ ↑c * ↑(I.optimum m ⋯) ≤ 2 * A.expectedFlow μ I
decl_869.source:
theorem randomized_batched_lower_bound {m c : ℕ}
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hc : 0 < c) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : RandomizedScheduler Ω m) :
    ∃ jobs vertices, ∃ I : Instance jobs vertices,
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      I.optimum m (by omega) = 8 * c * 5 ^ c ∧
      (∀ j, I.optimum m (by omega) ∣ I.release j) ∧
      (c : ℝ≥0∞) * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 2 * A.expectedFlow μ I := by
  let L := 8 * c * 5 ^ c
  have hL : 0 < L := Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hc) (pow_pos (by omega) c)
  have hdiv : 2 ∣ L := ⟨4 * c * 5 ^ c, by dsimp [L]; ring⟩
  have heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L := by
    have := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hdiv
    omega
  obtain ⟨Q, hf, hlo, hhi, hrel, hexp⟩ := HardFamily.expected_lower (b := 1) (c := c)
    (by omega : 0 < m) hL μ A (HardFamily.batched (c * (m * L)) m L (by omega) hL)
    (fun P hP => by
      have he := (HardFamily.mem_batched P).mp hP
      exact ⟨he.ge, by simpa only [one_mul] using he.le⟩)
    (fun B Q d => HardFamily.batched_hard_after hm hc hL heven hcm rfl B Q.graph d)
  simp only [one_mul] at hhi
  have he : Q.graph.optimum m (by omega) = L := le_antisymm hhi hlo
  refine ⟨Q.jobs, Q.vertices, Q.graph, hf, he, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [he] using hrel
  · simpa only [he] using hexp

/-- The logarithmic batched lower bound for randomized causal schedulers. -/

decl_868.name: Scheduling.randomized_batched_competitive_lower
decl_868.label:
Theorem 4 · Randomized
Batched lower bound
decl_868.statement:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {m c : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m),
  0 < c →
    2 * c ≤ m →
      ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : Scheduling.RandomizedScheduler Ω m),
        ∃ jobs vertices I,
          (∀ (u v w : Fin vertices), I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
            I.optimum m ⋯ = 8 * c * 5 ^ c ∧
              (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.optimum m ⋯ ∣ I.release j) ∧
                ↑(min m (Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m ⋯))) * ↑(I.optimum m ⋯) ≤ 14 * A.expectedFlow μ I
decl_868.source:
theorem randomized_batched_competitive_lower {m c : ℕ}
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hc : 0 < c) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : RandomizedScheduler Ω m) :
    ∃ jobs vertices, ∃ I : Instance jobs vertices,
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      I.optimum m (by omega) = 8 * c * 5 ^ c ∧
      (∀ j, I.optimum m (by omega) ∣ I.release j) ∧
      (↑(min m (Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m (by omega)))) : ℝ≥0∞) * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤
        14 * A.expectedFlow μ I := by
  obtain ⟨jobs, vertices, I, hf, hopt, hrel, hexp⟩ := randomized_batched_lower_bound hm hc hcm μ A
  refine ⟨jobs, vertices, I, hf, hopt, hrel, ?_⟩
  have hlog : Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m (by omega)) ≤ 7 * c := by
    rw [hopt]
    exact batched_scale_clog_le hc
  have hmin := (min_le_right m (Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m (by omega)))).trans hlog
  have hn := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (I.optimum m (by omega)) hmin
  calc
    (↑(min m (Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m (by omega)))) : ℝ≥0∞) * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤
        7 * ((c : ℝ≥0∞) * I.optimum m (by omega)) := by
          have hh : (↑(min m (Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m (by omega))) * I.optimum m (by omega)) : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ↑((7 * c) * I.optimum m (by omega)) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hn
          simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_assoc] using hh
    _ ≤ 7 * (2 * A.expectedFlow μ I) := mul_le_mul le_rfl hexp zero_le zero_le
    _ = 14 * A.expectedFlow μ I := by ring

end Scheduling

decl_873.name: Scheduling.recordedKeys_append
decl_873.label: recordedKeys_append
decl_873.statement:
∀ {jobs work : ℕ} (a b : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs),
  Scheduling.recordedKeys (a ++ b) j = Scheduling.recordedKeys a j ∪ Scheduling.recordedKeys b j
decl_873.source:
theorem recordedKeys_append {jobs work : ℕ} (a b : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs) :
    recordedKeys (a ++ b) j = recordedKeys a j ∪ recordedKeys b j := by
  simp [recordedKeys, List.filter_append, image_union]

decl_875.name: Scheduling.recordedKeys_prefix_le
decl_875.label: recordedKeys_prefix_le
decl_875.statement:
∀ {jobs work p : ℕ} (a b : List (Scheduling.LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs),
  (∀ k ∈ Scheduling.recordedKeys b j, p ≤ ↑k) →
    {k ∈ Scheduling.recordedKeys (a ++ b) j | ↑k < p}.card ≤ (List.filter (fun r => decide (r.owner = j)) a).length
decl_875.source:
theorem recordedKeys_prefix_le {jobs work p : ℕ} (a b : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs)
    (hb : ∀ k ∈ recordedKeys b j, p ≤ k.val) :
    ((recordedKeys (a ++ b) j).filter (fun k => k.val < p)).card ≤
      (a.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)).length := by
  have hs : (recordedKeys (a ++ b) j).filter (fun k => k.val < p) ⊆ recordedKeys a j := by
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨hk, hlt⟩ := mem_filter.mp hk
    rw [recordedKeys_append] at hk
    rcases mem_union.mp hk with h | h
    · exact h
    · have hh := hb k h
      omega
  exact (card_le_card hs).trans (recordedKeys_card_le a j)

namespace LayeredPrefix
variable {jobs work m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : DeterministicScheduler m}
variable {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work}
variable {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}

decl_591.name: Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.keys_lower
decl_591.label: LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.keys_lower
decl_591.source:
theorem RecordedRun.keys_lower (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records)
    (j : Fin jobs) (k : Fin work) (hk : k ∈ recordedKeys records j) : P.closed j ≤ k.val := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hkey⟩ := mem_image.mp hk
  obtain ⟨hr, ho⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp (List.mem_toFinset.mp hr)
  have ho' : r.owner = j := of_decide_eq_true ho
  have hs := h.start_lower r hr
  have ht := (h.final_times r hr).1
  rw [ho'] at hs
  rw [hkey] at ht
  omega

decl_590.name: Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.keys_card
decl_590.label: LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.keys_card
decl_590.source:
theorem RecordedRun.keys_card (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records) (j : Fin jobs) :
    (recordedKeys records j).card = (records.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)).length := by
  let rs := records.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)
  have hpair : rs.Pairwise (fun a b => a.key < b.key) := by
    have hp := h.ordered_intervals.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)
    apply hp.imp_of_mem
    intro a b ha hb hab
    obtain ⟨ha', hoa⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp ha
    obtain ⟨hb', hob⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hb
    have hoa' : a.owner = j := of_decide_eq_true hoa
    have hob' : b.owner = j := of_decide_eq_true hob
    have hstop := hab (hoa'.trans hob'.symm)
    have hka := (h.final_times a ha').2.1
    have hkb := (h.final_times b hb').1
    change a.key.val < b.key.val
    omega
  have hn : (rs.map LayerRecord.key).Nodup := by
    rw [List.nodup_iff_pairwise_ne, List.pairwise_map]
    exact hpair.imp (fun h => ne_of_lt h)
  change (rs.toFinset.image LayerRecord.key).card = rs.length
  have he : rs.toFinset.image LayerRecord.key = (rs.map LayerRecord.key).toFinset := by
    ext k
    simp
  rw [he, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hn, List.length_map]

end LayeredPrefix
end Scheduling

decl_382.name: Scheduling.Instance.interval_card_eq_sum
decl_382.label: Instance.interval_card_eq_sum
decl_382.statement:
∀ {vertices : ℕ} (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (a b : ℕ),
  {v | a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b}.card = ∑ t ∈ Finset.Ico a b, {v | S v = t}.card
decl_382.source:
theorem interval_card_eq_sum (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (a b : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)).card =
      ∑ t ∈ Ico a b, (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card := by
  classical
  rw [card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := S)
    (fun v hv => mem_Ico.mpr (mem_filter.mp hv).2)]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro t ht
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · exact And.right
  · intro he
    exact ⟨by rw [he]; exact mem_Ico.mp ht, he⟩

decl_383.name: Scheduling.Instance.interval_deficit_has_idle
decl_383.label: Instance.interval_deficit_has_idle
decl_383.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m a b : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S → {v | a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b}.card < m * (b - a) → ∃ t ∈ Finset.Ico a b, {v | S v = t}.card < m
decl_383.source:
theorem interval_deficit_has_idle {m a b : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S)
    (hdeficit : (univ.filter (fun v => a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)).card < m * (b - a)) :
    ∃ t ∈ Ico a b, (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card < m := by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  have he : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card = m := by
    intro t ht; exact (hS.capacity t).antisymm (hn t ht)
  rw [interval_card_eq_sum S a b, sum_congr rfl he] at hdeficit
  simp [Nat.mul_comm] at hdeficit

decl_306.name: Scheduling.Instance.epochWork
decl_306.label: Instance.epochWork
decl_306.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ
decl_306.source:
noncomputable def epochWork (_I : Instance jobs vertices)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (L i : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter (fun v => S v / L = i)).card

decl_307.name: Scheduling.Instance.epochWork_eq_sum
decl_307.label: Instance.epochWork_eq_sum
decl_307.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) {L : ℕ},
  0 < L → ∀ (i : ℕ), I.epochWork S L i = ∑ t ∈ Finset.Ico (i * L) ((i + 1) * L), {v | S v = t}.card
decl_307.source:
theorem epochWork_eq_sum (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) {L : ℕ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (i : ℕ) :
    I.epochWork S L i = ∑ t ∈ Ico (i * L) ((i + 1) * L),
      (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card := by
  rw [← interval_card_eq_sum S]
  unfold epochWork
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  have hd := Nat.div_add_mod (S v) L
  have hr := Nat.mod_lt (S v) hL
  generalize S v % L = r at *
  constructor
  · intro he; rw [he] at hd; constructor <;> nlinarith
  · intro h
    have hlo := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hL).mpr h.1
    have hhi := (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hL).mpr h.2
    omega

decl_309.name: Scheduling.Instance.epochWork_lt_of_idle
decl_309.label: Instance.epochWork_lt_of_idle
decl_309.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L i t : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S → 0 < L → t ∈ Finset.Ico (i * L) ((i + 1) * L) → {v | S v = t}.card < m → I.epochWork S L i < m * L
decl_309.source:
theorem epochWork_lt_of_idle {m L i t : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hL : 0 < L) (ht : t ∈ Ico (i * L) ((i + 1) * L))
    (hidle : (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card < m) : I.epochWork S L i < m * L := by
  rw [I.epochWork_eq_sum S hL i]
  have h := sum_lt_sum (s := Ico (i * L) ((i + 1) * L))
    (f := fun t => (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card) (g := fun _ => m)
    (by intro u _; exact hS.capacity u) ⟨t, ht, hidle⟩
  have hlen : (i + 1) * L - i * L = L := by rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  simp only [sum_const, Nat.card_Ico, hlen] at h
  simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using h

decl_308.name: Scheduling.Instance.epochWork_le
decl_308.label: Instance.epochWork_le
decl_308.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S → 0 < L → ∀ (i : ℕ), I.epochWork S L i ≤ m * L
decl_308.source:
theorem epochWork_le {m L : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hL : 0 < L) (i : ℕ) : I.epochWork S L i ≤ m * L := by
  classical
  have h := card_le_slots S m (i * L) ((i + 1) * L)
    (univ.filter (fun v => S v / L = i)) hS.capacity (by
      intro v hv
      have he := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      have hd := Nat.div_add_mod (S v) L
      have hr := Nat.mod_lt (S v) hL
      rw [he] at hd
      generalize S v % L = r at *
      constructor <;> nlinarith)
  simpa only [epochWork, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using h

decl_442.name: Scheduling.Instance.regular_vertex_count
decl_442.label: Instance.regular_vertex_count
decl_442.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {W : ℕ},
  (∀ (j : Fin jobs), (I.jobVertices j).card = W) → vertices = jobs * W
decl_442.source:
theorem regular_vertex_count {W : ℕ}
    (hwork : ∀ j, (I.jobVertices j).card = W) : vertices = jobs * W := by
  classical
  have h := card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (s := (univ : Finset (Fin vertices)))
    (t := (univ : Finset (Fin jobs))) (f := I.owner) (by simp)
  simp only [jobVertices] at hwork
  simpa [hwork] using h

decl_437.name: Scheduling.Instance.regular_alive_card_le
decl_437.label: Instance.regular_alive_card_le
decl_437.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {L c : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  0 < L → (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.release j = ↑j * L) → I.FlowBound S (c * L) → ∀ (i : ℕ), (I.alive S (i * L)).card ≤ c
decl_437.source:
theorem regular_alive_card_le {L c : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hL : 0 < L) (hrelease : ∀ j, I.release j = j.val * L)
    (hflow : I.FlowBound S (c * L)) (i : ℕ) : (I.alive S (i * L)).card ≤ c := by
  classical
  have hc := card_le_card_of_injOn Fin.val (s := I.alive S (i * L))
    (t := Ico (i + 1 - c) (i + 1)) (by
      intro j hj
      obtain ⟨hr, v, ho, ht⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hj).2
      rw [hrelease] at hr
      have hf := hflow v
      rw [ho, hrelease] at hf
      have hji : j.val ≤ i := by
        by_contra hn
        have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (show i + 1 ≤ j.val by omega)
        nlinarith
      have hij : i < j.val + c := by
        by_contra hn
        have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (show j.val + c ≤ i by omega)
        nlinarith
      exact mem_Ico.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩)
    (by intro u _ v _ huv; exact Fin.ext huv)
  have hcard : (Ico (i + 1 - c) (i + 1)).card ≤ c := by rw [Nat.card_Ico]; omega
  exact hc.trans hcard

decl_438.name: Scheduling.Instance.regular_epoch_no_arrivals
decl_438.label: Instance.regular_epoch_no_arrivals
decl_438.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L i : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    0 < L →
      (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.release j = ↑j * L) → ∀ (v : Fin vertices), S v < (i + 1) * L → I.release (I.owner v) ≤ i * L
decl_438.source:
theorem regular_epoch_no_arrivals {m L i : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (_hL : 0 < L)
    (hrelease : ∀ j, I.release j = j.val * L)
    (v : Fin vertices) (ht : S v < (i + 1) * L) : I.release (I.owner v) ≤ i * L := by
  have hr := hS.release v
  rw [hrelease] at hr ⊢
  have hj : (I.owner v).val ≤ i := by
    by_contra hn
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (show i + 1 ≤ (I.owner v).val by omega)
    omega
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right L hj

decl_310.name: Scheduling.Instance.epochWork_sum
decl_310.label: Instance.epochWork_sum
decl_310.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) {L : ℕ},
  0 < L → ∀ (N : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, I.epochWork S L i = {v | S v < N * L}.card
decl_310.source:
theorem epochWork_sum (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) {L : ℕ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range N, I.epochWork S L i = (univ.filter (fun v => S v < N * L)).card := by
  classical
  have h := card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
    (s := univ.filter (fun v : Fin vertices => S v < N * L))
    (t := range N) (f := fun v => S v / L) (by
      intro v hv
      exact mem_range.mpr ((Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hL).mpr (mem_filter.mp hv).2))
  rw [h]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  unfold epochWork
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · intro he
    exact ⟨(Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hL).mp (by rw [he]; exact mem_range.mp hi), he⟩
  · exact And.right

/-- The abstract sum of idle capacity is exactly the number of vertices
unfinished after the last arrival epoch. -/

decl_381.name: Scheduling.Instance.idleBacklog_eq_remaining
decl_381.label: Instance.idleBacklog_eq_remaining
decl_381.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L N : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    0 < L →
      vertices = N * (m * L) → Scheduling.Accounting.idleBacklog (m * L) (I.epochWork S L) N = {v | N * L ≤ S v}.card
decl_381.source:
theorem idleBacklog_eq_remaining {m L N : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hL : 0 < L) (hvertices : vertices = N * (m * L)) :
    Accounting.idleBacklog (m * L) (I.epochWork S L) N =
      (univ.filter (fun v => N * L ≤ S v)).card := by
  have hc := Accounting.idleBacklog_conservation (I.epochWork_le hS hL) N
  rw [I.epochWork_sum S hL] at hc
  have hp := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := univ)
    (fun v : Fin vertices => S v < N * L)
  simp only [not_lt, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hp
  omega

decl_441.name: Scheduling.Instance.regular_idleBacklog_eq
decl_441.label: Instance.regular_idleBacklog_eq
decl_441.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m S →
    0 < L →
      (∀ (j : Fin jobs), (I.jobVertices j).card = m * L) →
        Scheduling.Accounting.idleBacklog (m * L) (I.epochWork S L) jobs = {v | jobs * L ≤ S v}.card
decl_441.source:
theorem regular_idleBacklog_eq {m L : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hwork : ∀ j, (I.jobVertices j).card = m * L) :
    Accounting.idleBacklog (m * L) (I.epochWork S L) jobs =
      (univ.filter (fun v => jobs * L ≤ S v)).card := by
  classical
  have hc := Accounting.idleBacklog_conservation (I.epochWork_le hS hL) jobs
  rw [I.epochWork_sum S hL] at hc
  have hp := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := univ) (fun v : Fin vertices => S v < jobs * L)
  simp only [not_lt, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hp
  have ht := I.regular_vertex_count hwork
  omega

/-- Under a `cL` flow bound, only the last `c-1` jobs can remain at `jobs*L`.
The count includes all unrevealed vertices of those jobs. -/

decl_443.name: Scheduling.Instance.regular_young_backlog
decl_443.label: Instance.regular_young_backlog
decl_443.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L c : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  c ≤ jobs →
    0 < L →
      (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.release j = ↑j * L) →
        (∀ (j : Fin jobs), (I.jobVertices j).card = m * L) →
          I.FlowBound S (c * L) → {v | jobs * L ≤ S v}.card ≤ (c - 1) * (m * L)
decl_443.source:
theorem regular_young_backlog {m L c : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hc : c ≤ jobs) (_hL : 0 < L)
    (hrelease : ∀ j, I.release j = j.val * L)
    (hwork : ∀ j, (I.jobVertices j).card = m * L)
    (hflow : I.FlowBound S (c * L)) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => jobs * L ≤ S v)).card ≤ (c - 1) * (m * L) := by
  classical
  let R := univ.filter (fun v : Fin vertices => jobs * L ≤ S v)
  have hyoung : ∀ v ∈ R, (I.owner v).val ∈ Ioo (jobs - c) jobs := by
    intro v hv
    have ht := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hf := hflow v
    rw [hrelease] at hf
    have hj := (I.owner v).isLt
    have ho : jobs < (I.owner v).val + c := by
      by_contra hn
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (show (I.owner v).val + c ≤ jobs by omega)
      nlinarith
    exact mem_Ioo.mpr ⟨by omega, hj⟩
  have he := card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (s := R) (f := fun v => (I.owner v).val) hyoung
  rw [show (univ.filter (fun v => jobs * L ≤ S v)).card = R.card from rfl, he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ Ioo (jobs - c) jobs, m * L := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      have hjn := (mem_Ioo.mp hj).2
      have hsub : R.filter (fun v => (I.owner v).val = j) ⊆ I.jobVertices ⟨j, hjn⟩ := by
        intro v hv
        simp only [jobVertices, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
        exact Fin.ext (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      exact (card_le_card hsub).trans (hwork ⟨j, hjn⟩).le
    _ ≤ (c - 1) * (m * L) := by
      have hcard : (Ioo (jobs - c) jobs).card ≤ c - 1 := by
        rw [Nat.card_Ioo]
        omega
      simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (m * L) hcard

/-- The deterministic lower-bound contradiction for a concrete schedule.
Only the adversary's idle-slot property remains as a hypothesis. -/

decl_440.name: Scheduling.Instance.regular_forcing_flow_lower
decl_440.label: Instance.regular_forcing_flow_lower
decl_440.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m L c : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  0 < m →
    0 < L →
      0 < c →
        jobs = c * (c * (m * L)) →
          I.Valid m S →
            (∀ (j : Fin jobs), I.release j = ↑j * L) →
              (∀ (j : Fin jobs), (I.jobVertices j).card = m * L) →
                (∀ k < c * (m * L), I.epochWork S L (c * k) < m * L) → c * L ≤ I.maxFlow S
decl_440.source:
theorem regular_forcing_flow_lower {m L c : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hn : jobs = c * (c * (m * L)))
    (hS : I.Valid m S)
    (hrelease : ∀ j, I.release j = j.val * L)
    (hwork : ∀ j, (I.jobVertices j).card = m * L)
    (hidle : ∀ k < c * (m * L), I.epochWork S L (c * k) < m * L) :
    c * L ≤ I.maxFlow S := by
  by_contra h
  have hflow : I.FlowBound S (c * L) :=
    (I.flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le S _).mpr (by omega)
  have hcap : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos hm hL
  have hcj : c ≤ jobs := by
    rw [hn]
    have hp : 0 < c * (m * L) := Nat.mul_pos hc hcap
    simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (show 1 ≤ c * (m * L) by omega)
  have hy := I.regular_young_backlog hcj hL hrelease hwork hflow
  rw [← I.regular_idleBacklog_eq hS hL hwork] at hy
  conv at hy => lhs; arg 3; rw [hn]
  exact Accounting.forcing_backlog_contradiction hc hcap hidle hy

end Scheduling.Instance

decl_876.name: Scheduling.renameKey
decl_876.label: renameKey
decl_876.source: def renameKey (f : ℕ → ℕ) (x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ := toLex ((ofLex x).1, f (ofLex x).2)

decl_879.name: Scheduling.renameObservation
decl_879.label: renameObservation
decl_879.source: def renameObservation (f : ℕ → ℕ) (Q : FIFOObservation) : FIFOObservation := Q.image (renameKey f)

decl_877.name: Scheduling.renameKey_strictMono
decl_877.label: renameKey_strictMono
decl_877.statement: ∀ {f : ℕ → ℕ}, StrictMono f → StrictMono (Scheduling.renameKey f)
decl_877.source:
theorem renameKey_strictMono {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) : StrictMono (renameKey f) := by
  intro x y h
  rw [Prod.Lex.lt_iff] at h ⊢
  rcases h with h | ⟨he, h⟩
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr ⟨he, hf h⟩

decl_825.name: Scheduling.fifoPolicy_rename
decl_825.label: fifoPolicy_rename
decl_825.statement:
∀ {f : ℕ → ℕ},
  StrictMono f →
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (Q : Scheduling.FIFOObservation),
      Scheduling.fifoPolicy m (Scheduling.renameObservation f Q) = Finset.image f (Scheduling.fifoPolicy m Q)
decl_825.source:
theorem fifoPolicy_rename {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) (m : ℕ) (Q : FIFOObservation) :
    fifoPolicy m (renameObservation f Q) = (fifoPolicy m Q).image f := by
  unfold fifoPolicy renameObservation
  rw [← Packing.slice_image _ _ (renameKey_strictMono hf), image_image, image_image]
  rfl

namespace PublicSnapshot

decl_675.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.rename
decl_675.label: PublicSnapshot.rename
decl_675.source:
def rename (Q : PublicSnapshot) (f : ℕ → ℕ) : PublicSnapshot where
  support := Q.support
  ready := fun b => (Q.ready b).image f
  supported := by intro b; simpa only [image_nonempty] using Q.supported b

decl_681.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.rename_small
decl_681.label: PublicSnapshot.rename_small
decl_681.statement: ∀ (Q : Scheduling.PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ}, Function.Injective f → ∀ (m : ℕ), (Q.rename f).small m = Q.small m
decl_681.source:
theorem rename_small (Q : PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Function.Injective f) (m : ℕ) :
    (Q.rename f).small m = Q.small m := by
  simp only [small, rename, card_image_of_injective _ hf]

decl_680.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.rename_large
decl_680.label: PublicSnapshot.rename_large
decl_680.statement: ∀ (Q : Scheduling.PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ}, Function.Injective f → ∀ (m : ℕ), (Q.rename f).large m = Q.large m
decl_680.source:
theorem rename_large (Q : PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Function.Injective f) (m : ℕ) :
    (Q.rename f).large m = Q.large m := by
  simp only [large, rename, card_image_of_injective _ hf]

decl_682.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.rename_smallFront
decl_682.label: PublicSnapshot.rename_smallFront
decl_682.statement:
∀ (Q : Scheduling.PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ},
  Function.Injective f → ∀ (m : ℕ), (Q.rename f).smallFront m = Finset.image f (Q.smallFront m)
decl_682.source:
theorem rename_smallFront (Q : PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Function.Injective f) (m : ℕ) :
    (Q.rename f).smallFront m = (Q.smallFront m).image f := by
  unfold smallFront
  rw [Q.rename_small hf, biUnion_image]
  rfl

decl_678.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.rename_filler
decl_678.label: PublicSnapshot.rename_filler
decl_678.statement: ∀ (Q : Scheduling.PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ}, Function.Injective f → ∀ (m : ℕ), (Q.rename f).filler m = Q.filler m
decl_678.source:
theorem rename_filler (Q : PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Function.Injective f) (m : ℕ) :
    (Q.rename f).filler m = Q.filler m := by
  unfold filler
  simp only [Q.rename_large hf]

decl_679.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.rename_fillerFront
decl_679.label: PublicSnapshot.rename_fillerFront
decl_679.statement:
∀ (Q : Scheduling.PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ},
  Function.Injective f → ∀ (m : ℕ), (Q.rename f).fillerFront m = Finset.image f (Q.fillerFront m)
decl_679.source:
theorem rename_fillerFront (Q : PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Function.Injective f) (m : ℕ) :
    (Q.rename f).fillerFront m = (Q.fillerFront m).image f := by
  unfold fillerFront
  rw [Q.rename_filler hf]
  cases Q.filler m <;> simp only [rename, image_empty]

decl_677.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.rename_duration
decl_677.label: PublicSnapshot.rename_duration
decl_677.statement: ∀ (Q : Scheduling.PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ}, Function.Injective f → ∀ (m : ℕ), (Q.rename f).duration m = Q.duration m
decl_677.source:
theorem rename_duration (Q : PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Function.Injective f) (m : ℕ) :
    (Q.rename f).duration m = Q.duration m := by
  unfold duration
  rw [Q.rename_smallFront hf, card_image_of_injective _ hf]

decl_676.name: Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.rename_action
decl_676.label: PublicSnapshot.rename_action
decl_676.statement:
∀ (Q : Scheduling.PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ},
  StrictMono f → ∀ (m k : ℕ), (Q.rename f).action m k = Finset.image f (Q.action m k)
decl_676.source:
theorem rename_action (Q : PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) (m k : ℕ) :
    (Q.rename f).action m k = (Q.action m k).image f := by
  unfold action
  rw [Q.rename_smallFront hf.injective, Q.rename_fillerFront hf.injective,
    Q.rename_duration hf.injective, ← Packing.slot_image _ _ hf,
    card_image_of_injective _ hf.injective, image_union]
  split_ifs <;> simp only [Packing.slice_image _ _ hf, image_empty]

end PublicSnapshot

decl_878.name: Scheduling.renameMemory
decl_878.label: renameMemory
decl_878.source:
def renameMemory (f : ℕ → ℕ) (state : SFFMemory) : SFFMemory :=
  state.map (fun plan => (plan.1.rename f, plan.2))

decl_893.name: Scheduling.sffStep_rename
decl_893.label: sffStep_rename
decl_893.statement:
∀ {f : ℕ → ℕ},
  StrictMono f →
    ∀ (m t : ℕ) (Q : Scheduling.PublicSnapshot) (state : Scheduling.SFFMemory),
      Scheduling.sffStep m t (Q.rename f) (Scheduling.renameMemory f state) =
        (Finset.image f (Scheduling.sffStep m t Q state).1,
          Scheduling.renameMemory f (Scheduling.sffStep m t Q state).2)
decl_893.source:
theorem sffStep_rename {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) (m t : ℕ)
    (Q : PublicSnapshot) (state : SFFMemory) :
    sffStep m t (Q.rename f) (renameMemory f state) =
      ((sffStep m t Q state).1.image f, renameMemory f (sffStep m t Q state).2) := by
  cases state with
  | none =>
    simp only [sffStep, renameMemory, Option.map_none, Option.getD_none,
      PublicSnapshot.rename_action _ hf, PublicSnapshot.rename_duration _ hf.injective]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  | some plan =>
    rcases plan with ⟨R, k⟩
    simp only [sffStep, renameMemory, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some,
      PublicSnapshot.rename_action _ hf, PublicSnapshot.rename_duration _ hf.injective]
    split_ifs <;> rfl

decl_887.name: Scheduling.sffPolicy_state_rename
decl_887.label: sffPolicy_state_rename
decl_887.statement:
∀ {f : ℕ → ℕ},
  StrictMono f →
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (history : ℕ → Scheduling.PublicSnapshot) (t : ℕ),
      (Scheduling.sffPolicy m).state (fun u => (history u).rename f) t =
        Scheduling.renameMemory f ((Scheduling.sffPolicy m).state history t)
decl_887.source:
theorem sffPolicy_state_rename {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) (m : ℕ)
    (history : ℕ → PublicSnapshot) (t : ℕ) :
    (sffPolicy m).state (fun u => (history u).rename f) t =
      renameMemory f ((sffPolicy m).state history t) := by
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    simp only [OnlinePolicy.state]
    rw [ih]
    exact congrArg Prod.snd (sffStep_rename hf m t (history t) _)

decl_884.name: Scheduling.sffPolicy_decision_rename
decl_884.label: sffPolicy_decision_rename
decl_884.statement:
∀ {f : ℕ → ℕ},
  StrictMono f →
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (history : ℕ → Scheduling.PublicSnapshot) (t : ℕ),
      (Scheduling.sffPolicy m).decision (fun u => (history u).rename f) t =
        Finset.image f ((Scheduling.sffPolicy m).decision history t)
decl_884.source:
theorem sffPolicy_decision_rename {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) (m : ℕ)
    (history : ℕ → PublicSnapshot) (t : ℕ) :
    (sffPolicy m).decision (fun u => (history u).rename f) t =
      ((sffPolicy m).decision history t).image f := by
  unfold OnlinePolicy.decision
  rw [sffPolicy_state_rename hf]
  exact congrArg Prod.fst (sffStep_rename hf m t (history t) _)

decl_804.name: Scheduling.batchObservation_rename
decl_804.label: batchObservation_rename
decl_804.statement:
∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (L t : ℕ) (Q : Scheduling.FIFOObservation),
  Scheduling.batchObservation L t (Scheduling.renameObservation f Q) = (Scheduling.batchObservation L t Q).rename f
decl_804.source:
theorem batchObservation_rename (f : ℕ → ℕ) (L t : ℕ) (Q : FIFOObservation) :
    batchObservation L t (renameObservation f Q) = (batchObservation L t Q).rename f := by
  apply PublicSnapshot.ext_ready
  funext b
  ext n
  rw [mem_batchObservation]
  change _ ↔ n ∈ ((batchObservation L t Q).ready b).image f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hb, he, hn⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨(ofLex y).2,
      (mem_batchObservation _ _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨y, hy, hb, he, rfl⟩, hn⟩
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hn
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hb, he, rfl⟩ := (mem_batchObservation _ _ _ _ _).mp hv
    exact ⟨renameKey f y, mem_image.mpr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hb, he, rfl⟩

decl_890.name: Scheduling.sffRawPolicy_decision_rename
decl_890.label: sffRawPolicy_decision_rename
decl_890.statement:
∀ {f : ℕ → ℕ},
  StrictMono f →
    ∀ (m L : ℕ) (history : ℕ → Scheduling.FIFOObservation) (t : ℕ),
      (Scheduling.sffRawPolicy m L).decision (fun u => Scheduling.renameObservation f (history u)) t =
        Finset.image f ((Scheduling.sffRawPolicy m L).decision history t)
decl_890.source:
theorem sffRawPolicy_decision_rename {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) (m L : ℕ)
    (history : ℕ → FIFOObservation) (t : ℕ) :
    (sffRawPolicy m L).decision (fun u => renameObservation f (history u)) t =
      ((sffRawPolicy m L).decision history t).image f := by
  rw [sffRawPolicy_decision, sffRawPolicy_decision]
  simp_rw [batchObservation_rename]
  exact sffPolicy_decision_rename hf m _ t

end Scheduling

decl_458.name: Scheduling.Instance.residualVertex
decl_458.label: Instance.residualVertex
decl_458.statement: {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) → Fin R.card → Fin vertices
decl_458.source:
noncomputable def residualVertex (_I : Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (v : Fin R.card) : Fin vertices :=
  ((R.orderIsoOfFin rfl) v).val

decl_448.name: Scheduling.Instance.residualJob
decl_448.label: Instance.residualJob
decl_448.statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) → (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) → Fin (Finset.image I.owner R).card → Fin jobs
decl_448.source:
noncomputable def residualJob (R : Finset (Fin vertices))
    (j : Fin (R.image I.owner).card) : Fin jobs :=
  (((R.image I.owner).orderIsoOfFin rfl) j).val

decl_454.name: Scheduling.Instance.residualOwner
decl_454.label: Instance.residualOwner
decl_454.statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) → (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) → Fin R.card → Fin (Finset.image I.owner R).card
decl_454.source:
noncomputable def residualOwner (R : Finset (Fin vertices))
    (v : Fin R.card) : Fin (R.image I.owner).card :=
  ((R.image I.owner).orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨I.owner (I.residualVertex R v),
    mem_image.mpr ⟨I.residualVertex R v, ((R.orderIsoOfFin rfl) v).property, rfl⟩⟩

decl_459.name: Scheduling.Instance.residualVertex_injective
decl_459.label: Instance.residualVertex_injective
decl_459.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)),
  Function.Injective (I.residualVertex R)
decl_459.source:
theorem residualVertex_injective (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) :
    Function.Injective (I.residualVertex R) := by
  intro u v h
  apply (R.orderIsoOfFin rfl).injective
  exact Subtype.ext h

decl_461.name: Scheduling.Instance.residualVertex_strictMono
decl_461.label: Instance.residualVertex_strictMono
decl_461.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)),
  StrictMono (I.residualVertex R)
decl_461.source:
theorem residualVertex_strictMono (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) :
    StrictMono (I.residualVertex R) := by
  intro u v huv
  exact (R.orderIsoOfFin rfl).strictMono huv

decl_449.name: Scheduling.Instance.residualJob_injective
decl_449.label: Instance.residualJob_injective
decl_449.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)),
  Function.Injective (I.residualJob R)
decl_449.source:
theorem residualJob_injective (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) :
    Function.Injective (I.residualJob R) := by
  intro u v h
  apply ((R.image I.owner).orderIsoOfFin rfl).injective
  exact Subtype.ext h

decl_450.name: Scheduling.Instance.residualJob_owner
decl_450.label: Instance.residualJob_owner
decl_450.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (v : Fin R.card),
  I.residualJob R (I.residualOwner R v) = I.owner (I.residualVertex R v)
decl_450.source:
@[simp] theorem residualJob_owner (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (v : Fin R.card) :
    I.residualJob R (I.residualOwner R v) = I.owner (I.residualVertex R v) := by
  simp [residualJob, residualOwner]

/-- The induced DAGs on any chosen set of surviving vertices, with all
release times shifted by D. Jobs with no surviving vertex are removed. -/

decl_447.name: Scheduling.Instance.residualInstance
decl_447.label: Instance.residualInstance
decl_447.statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) →
    (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) → ℕ → Scheduling.Instance (Finset.image I.owner R).card R.card
decl_447.source:
noncomputable def residualInstance (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D : ℕ) :
    Instance (R.image I.owner).card R.card where
  owner := I.residualOwner R
  release := fun j => I.release (I.residualJob R j) + D
  edge := fun u v => I.edge (I.residualVertex R u) (I.residualVertex R v)
  same_job := by
    intro u v he
    apply I.residualJob_injective R
    simpa using I.same_job he
  rank := fun v => I.rank (I.residualVertex R v)
  rank_increases := by intro u v he; exact I.rank_increases he
  nonempty_job := by
    intro j
    have hj : I.residualJob R j ∈ R.image I.owner :=
      (((R.image I.owner).orderIsoOfFin rfl) j).property
    obtain ⟨v, hv, ho⟩ := mem_image.mp hj
    refine ⟨(R.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨v, hv⟩, ?_⟩
    apply I.residualJob_injective R
    simpa [residualVertex] using ho

decl_455.name: Scheduling.Instance.residualSchedule
decl_455.label: Instance.residualSchedule
decl_455.statement:
{jobs vertices : ℕ} →
  Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices → (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) → ℕ → Scheduling.Assignment → Scheduling.Assignment
decl_455.source:
noncomputable def residualSchedule (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D : ℕ)
    (O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) : Assignment (vertices := R.card) :=
  fun v => O (I.residualVertex R v) + D

decl_457.name: Scheduling.Instance.residualSchedule_valid
decl_457.label: Instance.residualSchedule_valid
decl_457.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} {O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O → ∀ (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D : ℕ), (I.residualInstance R D).Valid m (I.residualSchedule R D O)
decl_457.source:
theorem residualSchedule_valid {m : ℕ} {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D : ℕ) :
    (I.residualInstance R D).Valid m (I.residualSchedule R D O) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro v
    have h := hO.release (I.residualVertex R v)
    simpa [residualInstance, residualSchedule] using Nat.add_le_add_right h D
  · intro u v he
    have h := hO.precedence he
    simpa [residualSchedule] using Nat.add_lt_add_right h D
  · intro t
    let A := univ.filter (fun v => I.residualSchedule R D O v = t)
    have hinj := I.residualVertex_injective R
    have him : (A.image (I.residualVertex R)).card = A.card := card_image_of_injective A hinj
    have hsub : A.image (I.residualVertex R) ⊆ univ.filter (fun v => O v = t - D) := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hw
      have ht := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      dsimp [residualSchedule] at ht
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega⟩
    have hc := (card_le_card hsub).trans (hO.capacity (t - D))
    rw [him] at hc
    exact hc

decl_456.name: Scheduling.Instance.residualSchedule_flowBound
decl_456.label: Instance.residualSchedule_flowBound
decl_456.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {L : ℕ} {O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.FlowBound O L →
    ∀ (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D : ℕ), (I.residualInstance R D).FlowBound (I.residualSchedule R D O) L
decl_456.source:
theorem residualSchedule_flowBound {L : ℕ} {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D : ℕ) :
    (I.residualInstance R D).FlowBound (I.residualSchedule R D O) L := by
  intro v
  have h := hL (I.residualVertex R v)
  simpa [residualInstance, residualSchedule, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_comm]
    using Nat.add_lt_add_right h D

/-- The artificial residual instance's optimum is no larger than the original
optimum. The result holds for every vertex restriction and every common shift. -/

decl_463.name: Scheduling.Instance.residual_optimum_le
decl_463.label: Instance.residual_optimum_le
decl_463.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D : ℕ),
  (I.residualInstance R D).optimum m hm ≤ I.optimum m hm
decl_463.source:
theorem residual_optimum_le {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D : ℕ) :
    (I.residualInstance R D).optimum m hm ≤ I.optimum m hm := by
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hL⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm
  exact (I.residualInstance R D).optimum_le hm
    (I.residualSchedule_valid hO R D) (I.residualSchedule_flowBound hL R D)

end Scheduling.Instance

decl_687.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot
decl_687.label: ReadySnapshot
decl_687.source:
structure ReadySnapshot (V : Type*) (batches : ℕ) where
  batchOf : V → Fin batches
  ready : Fin batches → Finset V
  ready_batch : ∀ b v, v ∈ ready b → batchOf v = b

namespace ReadySnapshot
variable {V : Type*} [LinearOrder V] {batches : ℕ} (Q : ReadySnapshot V batches)

decl_719.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.small
decl_719.label: ReadySnapshot.small
decl_719.statement: {V : Type u_1} → {batches : ℕ} → Scheduling.ReadySnapshot V batches → ℕ → Finset (Fin batches)
decl_719.source:
def small (m : ℕ) : Finset (Fin batches) :=
  univ.filter (fun b => 0 < (Q.ready b).card ∧ (Q.ready b).card ≤ m)

decl_714.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.large
decl_714.label: ReadySnapshot.large
decl_714.statement: {V : Type u_1} → {batches : ℕ} → Scheduling.ReadySnapshot V batches → ℕ → Finset (Fin batches)
decl_714.source:
def large (m : ℕ) : Finset (Fin batches) :=
  univ.filter (fun b => m < (Q.ready b).card)

decl_720.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.smallFront
decl_720.label: ReadySnapshot.smallFront
decl_720.statement: {V : Type u_1} → [LinearOrder V] → {batches : ℕ} → Scheduling.ReadySnapshot V batches → ℕ → Finset V
decl_720.source: def smallFront (m : ℕ) : Finset V := (Q.small m).biUnion Q.ready

decl_706.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.filler
decl_706.label: ReadySnapshot.filler
decl_706.statement: {V : Type u_1} → {batches : ℕ} → Scheduling.ReadySnapshot V batches → ℕ → Option (Fin batches)
decl_706.source:
def filler (m : ℕ) : Option (Fin batches) :=
  if h : (Q.large m).Nonempty then some ((Q.large m).min' h) else none

decl_707.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.fillerFront
decl_707.label: ReadySnapshot.fillerFront
decl_707.statement: {V : Type u_1} → {batches : ℕ} → Scheduling.ReadySnapshot V batches → ℕ → Finset V
decl_707.source:
def fillerFront (m : ℕ) : Finset V :=
  match Q.filler m with | none => ∅ | some b => Q.ready b

decl_696.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.duration
decl_696.label: ReadySnapshot.duration
decl_696.statement: {V : Type u_1} → [LinearOrder V] → {batches : ℕ} → Scheduling.ReadySnapshot V batches → ℕ → ℕ
decl_696.source: def duration (m : ℕ) : ℕ := Packing.duration (Q.smallFront m).card m

decl_688.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.action
decl_688.label: ReadySnapshot.action
decl_688.statement: {V : Type u_1} → [LinearOrder V] → {batches : ℕ} → Scheduling.ReadySnapshot V batches → ℕ → ℕ → Finset V
decl_688.source:
def action (m k : ℕ) : Finset V :=
  Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k ∪
    if k + 1 = Q.duration m then
      Packing.slice (Q.fillerFront m) 0 (m - (Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k).card)
    else ∅

omit [LinearOrder V] in

decl_710.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.filler_mem
decl_710.label: ReadySnapshot.filler_mem
decl_710.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} {batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot V batches) {m : ℕ} {b : Fin batches},
  Q.filler m = some b → b ∈ Q.large m
decl_710.source:
theorem filler_mem {m : ℕ} {b : Fin batches} (hb : Q.filler m = some b) : b ∈ Q.large m := by
  unfold filler at hb
  split_ifs at hb with h
  · have he := Option.some.inj hb
    rw [← he]
    exact min'_mem _ _

omit [LinearOrder V] in

decl_711.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.filler_oldest
decl_711.label: ReadySnapshot.filler_oldest
decl_711.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} {batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot V batches) {m : ℕ} {b c : Fin batches},
  Q.filler m = some b → c ∈ Q.large m → b ≤ c
decl_711.source:
theorem filler_oldest {m : ℕ} {b c : Fin batches}
    (hb : Q.filler m = some b) (hc : c ∈ Q.large m) : b ≤ c := by
  unfold filler at hb
  split_ifs at hb with h
  · have he := Option.some.inj hb
    rw [← he]
    exact min'_le _ _ hc

omit [LinearOrder V] in

decl_709.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.filler_exists
decl_709.label: ReadySnapshot.filler_exists
decl_709.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} {batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot V batches) {m : ℕ},
  (Q.large m).Nonempty → ∃ b, Q.filler m = some b
decl_709.source:
theorem filler_exists {m : ℕ} (h : (Q.large m).Nonempty) : ∃ b, Q.filler m = some b := by
  exact ⟨(Q.large m).min' h, by simp [filler, h]⟩

decl_721.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.smallFront_ready
decl_721.label: ReadySnapshot.smallFront_ready
decl_721.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder V] {batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot V batches) {m : ℕ} {v : V},
  v ∈ Q.smallFront m → Q.batchOf v ∈ Q.small m ∧ v ∈ Q.ready (Q.batchOf v)
decl_721.source:
theorem smallFront_ready {m : ℕ} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ Q.smallFront m) :
    Q.batchOf v ∈ Q.small m ∧ v ∈ Q.ready (Q.batchOf v) := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hv⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp hv
  have he := Q.ready_batch b v hv
  rw [he]
  exact ⟨hb, hv⟩

omit [LinearOrder V] in

decl_708.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.fillerFront_ready
decl_708.label: ReadySnapshot.fillerFront_ready
decl_708.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} {batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot V batches) {m : ℕ} {v : V},
  v ∈ Q.fillerFront m → Q.filler m = some (Q.batchOf v) ∧ v ∈ Q.ready (Q.batchOf v)
decl_708.source:
theorem fillerFront_ready {m : ℕ} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ Q.fillerFront m) :
    Q.filler m = some (Q.batchOf v) ∧ v ∈ Q.ready (Q.batchOf v) := by
  unfold fillerFront at hv
  cases he : Q.filler m with
  | none => simp [he] at hv
  | some b =>
    rw [he] at hv
    have ho := Q.ready_batch b v hv
    exact ⟨by simp [ho], by simpa [ho] using hv⟩

decl_712.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.frontiers_disjoint
decl_712.label: ReadySnapshot.frontiers_disjoint
decl_712.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder V] {batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot V batches) (m : ℕ),
  Disjoint (Q.smallFront m) (Q.fillerFront m)
decl_712.source:
theorem frontiers_disjoint (m : ℕ) : Disjoint (Q.smallFront m) (Q.fillerFront m) := by
  apply disjoint_left.mpr
  intro v hv hw
  have hs := Q.smallFront_ready hv
  have hf := Q.fillerFront_ready hw
  have hl := Q.filler_mem hf.1
  have h₁ := (mem_filter.mp hs.1).2.2
  have h₂ := (mem_filter.mp hl).2
  omega

decl_690.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.action_scope
decl_690.label: ReadySnapshot.action_scope
decl_690.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder V] {batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot V batches) {m k : ℕ} {v : V},
  v ∈ Q.action m k →
    Q.batchOf v ∈ Q.small m ∧ v ∈ Q.ready (Q.batchOf v) ∨ Q.filler m = some (Q.batchOf v) ∧ v ∈ Q.ready (Q.batchOf v)
decl_690.source:
theorem action_scope {m k : ℕ} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ Q.action m k) :
    (Q.batchOf v ∈ Q.small m ∧ v ∈ Q.ready (Q.batchOf v)) ∨
      (Q.filler m = some (Q.batchOf v) ∧ v ∈ Q.ready (Q.batchOf v)) := by
  rcases mem_union.mp hv with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (Q.smallFront_ready (Packing.slice_subset _ _ _ h))
  · split_ifs at h with hk
    · exact Or.inr (Q.fillerFront_ready (Packing.slice_subset _ _ _ h))
    · exact False.elim (notMem_empty _ h)

decl_689.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.action_card_le
decl_689.label: ReadySnapshot.action_card_le
decl_689.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder V] {batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot V batches) (m k : ℕ),
  (Q.action m k).card ≤ m
decl_689.source:
theorem action_card_le (m k : ℕ) : (Q.action m k).card ≤ m := by
  have hp := Packing.slot_card_le (Q.smallFront m) m k
  unfold action
  split_ifs with hk
  · have hf : (Packing.slice (Q.fillerFront m) 0
        (m - (Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k).card)).card ≤
        m - (Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k).card := by
      rw [Packing.slice_card]
      omega
    have hu := card_union_le (Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k)
      (Packing.slice (Q.fillerFront m) 0 (m - (Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k).card))
    omega
  · simpa using hp

decl_695.name: Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.clears_small
decl_695.label: ReadySnapshot.clears_small
decl_695.statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder V] {batches : ℕ} (Q : Scheduling.ReadySnapshot V batches) {m : ℕ},
