/-- Lemma 12. Both bounds are proved simultaneously by strong induction on
the round index, from the operational fixed-frontier routine. -/

decl_739.name: Scheduling.SFFRounds.round_bounds
decl_739.label: SFF round bounds
decl_739.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices batches m L : ℕ} {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} {B : Scheduling.Batching I L batches}
  {S O : Scheduling.Assignment} (R : Scheduling.SFFRounds B m S),
  0 < m →
    0 < L →
      I.Valid m O →
        I.FlowBound O L →
          ∀ (K : ℕ), (B.small m S (R.boundary K)).card ≤ 4 * L ∧ R.boundary (K + 1) - R.boundary K ≤ 4 * L
decl_739.source:
theorem round_bounds (hm : 0 < m) (hLp : 0 < L)
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (K : ℕ) :
    (B.small m S (R.boundary K)).card ≤ 4 * L ∧
    R.boundary (K + 1) - R.boundary K ≤ 4 * L := by
  classical
  induction K using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h K ih =>
    have hprev : ∀ k < K, R.boundary (k + 1) - R.boundary k ≤ 4 * L :=
      fun k hk => (ih k hk).2
    have hspan := R.boundary_span (a := K - L) (Nat.sub_le K L) hprev
    have hwin : R.boundary K ≤ R.boundary (K - L) + 4 * L ^ 2 := by
      have hd : K - (K - L) ≤ L := by omega
      have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (4 * L) hd
      nlinarith
    have hnew := B.eligible_count_bound hLp hwin
    have hturn : ((Ico (K - L) K).biUnion R.switches).card ≤ L := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ∑ r ∈ Ico (K - L) K, (R.switches r).card := card_biUnion_le
        _ ≤ ∑ _r ∈ Ico (K - L) K, 1 := by
          apply sum_le_sum
          intro r _
          exact R.switches_card_le_one r
        _ ≤ L := by simp; omega
    have hcover := card_le_card (R.small_cover hO hL hLp K)
    have hu := card_union_le
      (univ.filter (fun b => R.boundary (K - L) < B.eligible b ∧ B.eligible b ≤ R.boundary K))
      ((Ico (K - L) K).biUnion R.switches)
    have hsmall : (B.small m S (R.boundary K)).card ≤ 4 * L := by omega
    refine ⟨hsmall, (R.round_length_le_small_count hm K).trans ?_⟩
    exact max_le (by omega) hsmall

end Scheduling.SFFRounds

decl_137.name: Scheduling.Batching.eligibleWork
decl_137.label: Batching.eligibleWork
decl_137.statement:
{jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} →
  {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} → Scheduling.Batching I L batches → ℕ → ℕ → Finset (Fin vertices)
decl_137.source:
noncomputable def eligibleWork (u v : ℕ) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun w => u < B.eligible (B.vertexBatch w) ∧ B.eligible (B.vertexBatch w) ≤ v)

decl_127.name: Scheduling.Batching.admittedRemaining
decl_127.label: Batching.admittedRemaining
decl_127.statement:
{jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} →
  {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} →
    Scheduling.Batching I L batches → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → Finset (Fin vertices)
decl_127.source:
noncomputable def admittedRemaining (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun w => B.eligible (B.vertexBatch w) ≤ t ∧ t ≤ S w)

/-- Work admitted through an interval of eligibility times (Lemma 11). -/

decl_142.name: Scheduling.Batching.eligible_work_bound
decl_142.label: Batching.eligible_work_bound
decl_142.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices batches L m : ℕ} {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} (B : Scheduling.Batching I L batches)
  {O : Scheduling.Assignment},
  I.Valid m O → I.FlowBound O L → ∀ {u v : ℕ}, u ≤ v → (B.eligibleWork u v).card ≤ m * (v - u + 3 * L)
decl_142.source:
theorem eligible_work_bound (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    {u v : ℕ} (huv : u ≤ v) : (B.eligibleWork u v).card ≤ m * (v - u + 3 * L) := by
  classical
  have h := card_le_slots O m (u - 2 * L) (v + L) (B.eligibleWork u v) hO.capacity (by
    intro w hw
    have hw' := (mem_filter.mp hw).2
    have hl := B.lower (I.owner w)
    have hu := B.upper (I.owner w)
    have he : B.eligible (B.vertexBatch w) ≤ I.release (I.owner w) + 2 * L := by
      dsimp [eligible, vertexBatch]
      nlinarith
    have hp := hO.release w
    have hf := hL w
    have hrel := B.released_by_eligible (v := w) rfl
    exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩)
  have he : v + L - (u - 2 * L) ≤ v - u + 3 * L := by omega
  exact h.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left m he)

/-- Conservation of all admitted work, including unrevealed vertices. -/

decl_128.name: Scheduling.Batching.admitted_accounting
decl_128.label: Batching.admitted_accounting
decl_128.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} (B : Scheduling.Batching I L batches)
  {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (∀ (w : Fin vertices), B.eligible (B.vertexBatch w) ≤ S w) →
    ∀ {u v : ℕ},
      u ≤ v →
        (B.admittedRemaining S v).card + (I.executedDuring S u v).card ≤
          (B.admittedRemaining S u).card + (B.eligibleWork u v).card
decl_128.source:
theorem admitted_accounting (hE : ∀ w, B.eligible (B.vertexBatch w) ≤ S w)
    {u v : ℕ} (huv : u ≤ v) :
    (B.admittedRemaining S v).card + (I.executedDuring S u v).card ≤
      (B.admittedRemaining S u).card + (B.eligibleWork u v).card := by
  classical
  have hd : Disjoint (B.admittedRemaining S v) (I.executedDuring S u v) := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro w hw hz
    have hw' := (mem_filter.mp hw).2
    have hz' := (mem_filter.mp hz).2
    omega
  have hsub : B.admittedRemaining S v ∪ I.executedDuring S u v ⊆
      B.admittedRemaining S u ∪ B.eligibleWork u v := by
    intro w hw
    have hs : u ≤ S w := by
      rcases mem_union.mp hw with h | h
      · have := (mem_filter.mp h).2; omega
      · exact (mem_filter.mp h).2.1
    have he : B.eligible (B.vertexBatch w) ≤ v := by
      rcases mem_union.mp hw with h | h
      · exact (mem_filter.mp h).2.1
      · have := (mem_filter.mp h).2; have := hE w; omega
    by_cases hold : B.eligible (B.vertexBatch w) ≤ u
    · exact mem_union_left _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hold, hs⟩)
    · exact mem_union_right _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega, he⟩)
  have hc := (card_le_card hsub).trans (card_union_le _ _)
  simpa [card_union_of_disjoint hd] using hc

end Scheduling.Batching

namespace Scheduling.Instance
open Finset
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

decl_313.name: Scheduling.Instance.executedDuring_card_sum
decl_313.label: Instance.executedDuring_card_sum
decl_313.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (u v : ℕ),
  (I.executedDuring S u v).card = ∑ t ∈ Finset.Ico u v, {w | S w = t}.card
decl_313.source:
theorem executedDuring_card_sum (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (u v : ℕ) :
    (I.executedDuring S u v).card = ∑ t ∈ Ico u v, (univ.filter (fun w => S w = t)).card := by
  classical
  have h := card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := S) (s := I.executedDuring S u v) (t := Ico u v)
    (by intro w hw; exact mem_Ico.mpr (mem_filter.mp hw).2)
  rw [h]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro t ht
  have ht' := mem_Ico.mp ht
  congr 1
  ext w
  simp only [executedDuring, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h.2
  · intro h; exact ⟨by omega, h⟩

/-- Full service except possibly at one timestep loses at most m capacity. -/

decl_471.name: Scheduling.Instance.service_except_one
decl_471.label: Instance.service_except_one
decl_471.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) {m u v bad : ℕ} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (∀ (t : ℕ), u ≤ t → t < v → t ≠ bad → {w | S w = t}.card = m) → m * (v - u) ≤ (I.executedDuring S u v).card + m
decl_471.source:
theorem service_except_one {m u v bad : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hfull : ∀ t, u ≤ t → t < v → t ≠ bad → (univ.filter (fun w => S w = t)).card = m) :
    m * (v - u) ≤ (I.executedDuring S u v).card + m := by
  classical
  have hslot : ∀ t ∈ Ico u v,
      m ≤ (univ.filter (fun w => S w = t)).card + (if t = bad then m else 0) := by
    intro t ht
    by_cases he : t = bad
    · simp [he]
    · rw [if_neg he, hfull t (mem_Ico.mp ht).1 (mem_Ico.mp ht).2 he]
      omega
  have hs := sum_le_sum hslot
  rw [sum_add_distrib, ← I.executedDuring_card_sum] at hs
  have hbad : (∑ t ∈ Ico u v, if t = bad then m else 0) ≤ m := by
    simp only [sum_ite_eq']
    split_ifs <;> omega
  have hc : (∑ _t ∈ Ico u v, m) = m * (v - u) := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]
  rw [hc] at hs
  omega

end Scheduling.Instance

namespace Scheduling.SFFRounds
open Finset
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {jobs vertices batches m L : ℕ} {I : Instance jobs vertices}
variable {B : Batching I L batches} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
variable (R : SFFRounds B m S)

decl_747.name: Scheduling.SFFRounds.sparse_work_bound
decl_747.label: SFFRounds.sparse_work_bound
decl_747.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices batches m L : ℕ} {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} {B : Scheduling.Batching I L batches}
  {S O : Scheduling.Assignment} (R : Scheduling.SFFRounds B m S),
  0 < m →
    0 < L →
      I.Valid m O →
        I.FlowBound O L →
          ∀ {K : ℕ}, B.large m S (R.boundary K) = ∅ → (B.admittedRemaining S (R.boundary K)).card ≤ 12 * m * L ^ 2
decl_747.source:
theorem sparse_work_bound (hm : 0 < m) (hLp : 0 < L)
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) {K : ℕ}
    (hn : B.large m S (R.boundary K) = ∅) :
    (B.admittedRemaining S (R.boundary K)).card ≤ 12 * m * L ^ 2 := by
  classical
  have heq : (B.admittedRemaining S (R.boundary K)).card =
      ∑ b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary K),
        ((B.admittedRemaining S (R.boundary K)).filter (fun v => B.vertexBatch v = b)).card :=
    card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (by
      intro v hv
      have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      have ha : B.Active S (R.boundary K) (B.vertexBatch v) := ⟨hv'.1, v, rfl, hv'.2⟩
      rcases B.active_small_or_large (m := m) ha with hs | hl
      · exact hs
      · rw [hn] at hl; exact False.elim (notMem_empty _ hl))
  have hc : (B.admittedRemaining S (R.boundary K)).card ≤
      (B.small m S (R.boundary K)).card * (3 * m * L) := by
    rw [heq]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary K), 3 * m * L := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro b _
        apply (card_le_card (t := B.batchVertices b) ?_).trans (B.batch_work_bound hO hL b)
        intro v hv
        exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, (mem_filter.mp hv).2⟩
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hcount := (R.round_bounds hm hLp hO hL K).1
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (3 * m * L) hcount
  nlinarith

decl_730.name: Scheduling.SFFRounds.containing_round
decl_730.label: SFFRounds.containing_round
decl_730.source:
theorem containing_round {u K t : ℕ} (huK : u ≤ K)
    (htu : R.boundary u ≤ t) (htK : t < R.boundary K) :
    ∃ r, u ≤ r ∧ r < K ∧ R.boundary r ≤ t ∧ t < R.boundary (r + 1) := by
  classical
  let A := (range (K + 1)).filter (fun r => R.boundary r ≤ t)
  have hu : u ∈ A := mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_range.mpr (by omega), htu⟩
  have hn : A.Nonempty := ⟨u, hu⟩
  let r := A.max' hn
  have hr := mem_filter.mp (Finset.max'_mem A hn)
  have hur : u ≤ r := le_max' A u hu
  have hrK : r < K := by
    have hrle : r ≤ K := by have := mem_range.mp hr.1; omega
    by_contra hge
    have he : r = K := by omega
    have hr' : R.boundary r ≤ t := hr.2
    rw [he] at hr'
    omega
  refine ⟨r, hur, hrK, hr.2, ?_⟩
  by_contra hn'
  have hnext : r + 1 ∈ A := mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_range.mpr (by omega), by omega⟩
  have hmax := le_max' A (r + 1) hnext
  change r + 1 ≤ r at hmax
  omega

/-- Lemma 13. The last boundary with no large batch resets the backlog;
all later rounds are full, except possibly the last slot of that one round. -/

decl_738.name: Scheduling.SFFRounds.remaining_work_bound
decl_738.label: SFF remaining work
decl_738.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices batches m L : ℕ} {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} {B : Scheduling.Batching I L batches}
  {S O : Scheduling.Assignment} (R : Scheduling.SFFRounds B m S),
  0 < m →
    0 < L → I.Valid m O → I.FlowBound O L → ∀ (K : ℕ), (B.admittedRemaining S (R.boundary K)).card ≤ 16 * m * L ^ 2
decl_738.source:
theorem remaining_work_bound (hm : 0 < m) (hLp : 0 < L)
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (K : ℕ) :
    (B.admittedRemaining S (R.boundary K)).card ≤ 16 * m * L ^ 2 := by
  classical
  let E := (range (K + 1)).filter (fun k => B.large m S (R.boundary k) = ∅)
  have hzero : B.large m S (R.boundary 0) = ∅ := by
    apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    intro b hb
    have he := (mem_filter.mp hb).2.1.1
    rw [R.starts_zero] at he
    have hp := B.eligible_positive hLp b
    omega
  have he0 : 0 ∈ E := mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_range.mpr (by omega), hzero⟩
  have hne : E.Nonempty := ⟨0, he0⟩
  let u := E.max' hne
  have hu := mem_filter.mp (Finset.max'_mem E hne)
  have huK : u ≤ K := by have := mem_range.mp hu.1; omega
  have hwu := R.sparse_work_bound hm hLp hO hL hu.2
  have hlarge : ∀ r, u < r → r ≤ K → (B.large m S (R.boundary r)).Nonempty := by
    intro r hur hrK
    by_contra hn
    have he : r ∈ E := mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_range.mpr (by omega), not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hn⟩
    have hmax := le_max' E r he
    change r ≤ u at hmax
    omega
  have htimes : R.boundary u ≤ R.boundary K := R.strict.monotone huK
  have hserved : m * (R.boundary K - R.boundary u) ≤
      (I.executedDuring S (R.boundary u) (R.boundary K)).card + m := by
    apply I.service_except_one (bad := R.boundary (u + 1) - 1)
    intro t htu htK htbad
    obtain ⟨r, hur, hrK, htr, hrt⟩ := R.containing_round huK htu htK
    by_cases he : r = u
    · subst r
      apply R.packed u t htr
      omega
    · exact R.fill_last r (hlarge r (by omega) (by omega)) t htr hrt
  have hacc := B.admitted_accounting R.eligible_service htimes
  have harr := B.eligible_work_bound hO hL htimes
  have hl : 3 * L + 1 ≤ 4 * L ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hmL := Nat.mul_le_mul_left m hl
  nlinarith

end Scheduling.SFFRounds

decl_395.name: Scheduling.Instance.mem_graph_ready
decl_395.label: Instance.mem_graph_ready
decl_395.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices) (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (t n : ℕ),
  n ∈ (I.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix S t) t).ready ↔ ∃ v, I.Ready S t v ∧ ↑v = n
decl_395.source:
theorem mem_graph_ready (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (t n : ℕ) :
    n ∈ (I.graphObservation (executionPrefix S t) t).ready ↔
      ∃ v, I.Ready S t v ∧ v.val = n := by
  simp only [graphObservation, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and,
    revealedVertices, val_mem_executionPrefix, not_lt, Ready]
  aesop

/-- The frontier interface of the executable algorithms is determined
by the full revealed-graph observation used in the lower bounds. -/

decl_429.name: Scheduling.Instance.readyObservation_subset_of_graphObservation_eq
decl_429.label: Instance.readyObservation_subset_of_graphObservation_eq
decl_429.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices otherJobs otherVertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance otherJobs otherVertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] [inst_1 : DecidableRel J.edge]
  (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (T : Scheduling.Assignment) (t : ℕ),
  I.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix S t) t = J.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix T t) t →
    I.readyObservation S t ⊆ J.readyObservation T t
decl_429.source:
theorem readyObservation_subset_of_graphObservation_eq
    [DecidableRel I.edge] [DecidableRel J.edge]
    (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (T : Assignment (vertices := otherVertices)) (t : ℕ)
    (h : I.graphObservation (executionPrefix S t) t = J.graphObservation (executionPrefix T t) t) :
    I.readyObservation S t ⊆ J.readyObservation T t := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := (I.mem_readyObservation S t x).mp hx
  have hr : v.val ∈ (J.graphObservation (executionPrefix T t) t).ready := by
    rw [← h]
    exact (I.mem_graph_ready S t v.val).mpr ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hval⟩ := (J.mem_graph_ready T t v.val).mp hr
  have hvrevealed : v ∈ I.revealedVertices (executionPrefix S t) t := by
    simp only [revealedVertices, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, val_mem_executionPrefix]
    exact ⟨hv.1, hv.2.2⟩
  have hvis : (v.val, (I.owner v).val) ∈ (J.graphObservation (executionPrefix T t) t).visible := by
    rw [← h]
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hvrevealed, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨z, _, hz⟩ := mem_image.mp hvis
  have hzw : z = w := Fin.ext ((congrArg Prod.fst hz).trans hval.symm)
  subst z
  have howner : (J.owner w).val = (I.owner v).val := congrArg Prod.snd hz
  have ha : ((I.owner v).val, I.release (I.owner v)) ∈
      (J.graphObservation (executionPrefix T t) t).arrivals := by
    rw [← h]
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨I.owner v, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hv.1⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := mem_image.mp ha
  have hjw : j = J.owner w := Fin.ext ((congrArg Prod.fst hj).trans howner.symm)
  subst j
  have hrelease : J.release (J.owner w) = I.release (I.owner v) := congrArg Prod.snd hj
  apply (J.mem_readyObservation T t _).mpr
  exact ⟨w, hw, by simp only [fifoPriority, hrelease, hval]⟩

decl_427.name: Scheduling.Instance.readyObservation_eq_of_graphObservation_eq
decl_427.label: Instance.readyObservation_eq_of_graphObservation_eq
decl_427.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices otherJobs otherVertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices)
  (J : Scheduling.Instance otherJobs otherVertices) [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] [inst_1 : DecidableRel J.edge]
  (S : Scheduling.Assignment) (T : Scheduling.Assignment) (t : ℕ),
  I.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix S t) t = J.graphObservation (Scheduling.executionPrefix T t) t →
    I.readyObservation S t = J.readyObservation T t
decl_427.source:
theorem readyObservation_eq_of_graphObservation_eq
    [DecidableRel I.edge] [DecidableRel J.edge]
    (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (T : Assignment (vertices := otherVertices)) (t : ℕ)
    (h : I.graphObservation (executionPrefix S t) t = J.graphObservation (executionPrefix T t) t) :
    I.readyObservation S t = J.readyObservation T t :=
  subset_antisymm (I.readyObservation_subset_of_graphObservation_eq J S T t h)
    (J.readyObservation_subset_of_graphObservation_eq I T S t h.symm)

end Instance

/-- Executable FIFO, packaged in the same causal scheduler model used
by all the quantified lower bounds. -/

decl_827.name: Scheduling.fifoScheduler
decl_827.label: fifoScheduler
decl_827.source:
noncomputable def fifoScheduler (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : DeterministicScheduler m where
  schedule I := I.fifoSchedule m hm
  valid I := I.fifoSchedule_valid hm
  causal I J t h := by
    change (univ.filter (fun v => I.fifoSchedule m hm v = t)).image Fin.val =
      (univ.filter (fun v => J.fifoSchedule m hm v = t)).image Fin.val
    rw [I.fifoSchedule_publicPolicy hm, J.fifoSchedule_publicPolicy hm]
    rw [I.readyObservation_eq_of_graphObservation_eq J _ _ t (h t le_rfl)]

/-- The combined upper-bound algorithm, in the shared scheduler model. -/

decl_813.name: Scheduling.combinedScheduler
decl_813.label: combinedScheduler
decl_813.source:
noncomputable def combinedScheduler (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : DeterministicScheduler m where
  schedule I := I.combinedSchedule m hm
  valid := by
    intro jobs vertices I
    by_cases hj : 0 < jobs
    · exact (I.combinedSchedule_spec hm hj).1
    · have hzero : jobs = 0 := by omega
      have hv : ∀ v : Fin vertices, False := by intro v; have := (I.owner v).isLt; omega
      refine ⟨fun v => (hv v).elim, fun {u} {_} _ => (hv u).elim, ?_⟩
      intro t
      have he : (univ.filter (fun v => I.combinedSchedule m hm v = t)) = ∅ := by
        apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
        intro v _
        exact hv v
      simp only [he, card_empty, Nat.zero_le]
  causal I J t h := by
    apply I.combinedSchedule_nonclairvoyant J hm
    intro u hu
    exact I.readyObservation_eq_of_graphObservation_eq J _ _ u (h u hu)

decl_828.name: Scheduling.fifoScheduler_isFIFO
decl_828.label: fifoScheduler_isFIFO
decl_828.statement:
∀ {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices),
  I.IsFIFO m ((Scheduling.fifoScheduler m hm).schedule I)
decl_828.source:
theorem fifoScheduler_isFIFO {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {jobs vertices : ℕ}
    (I : Instance jobs vertices) : I.IsFIFO m ((fifoScheduler m hm).schedule I) :=
  I.fifoSchedule_isFIFO hm

/-- Theorem 2 as a single existence statement about a causal algorithm. -/

decl_823.name: Scheduling.exists_optimal_order_scheduler
decl_823.label:
Theorem 2
Optimal-order causal scheduler
decl_823.statement:
∀ {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m),
  ∃ A,
    ∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices),
      I.maxFlow (A.schedule I) ≤ 352 * I.optimum m hm * min m (I.optimum m hm)
decl_823.source:
theorem exists_optimal_order_scheduler {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ A : DeterministicScheduler m, ∀ {jobs vertices} (I : Instance jobs vertices),
      I.maxFlow (A.schedule I) ≤ 352 * I.optimum m hm * min m (I.optimum m hm) := by
  refine ⟨combinedScheduler m hm, ?_⟩
  intro jobs vertices I
  by_cases hj : 0 < jobs
  · exact (I.combinedSchedule_spec hm hj).2
  · have hz : jobs = 0 := by omega
    subst jobs
    simp [Instance.maxFlow]

/-- The constant-optimum lower bound applies to the constructed FIFO
algorithm as well as to the abstract class of causal FIFO schedulers. -/

decl_826.name: Scheduling.fifoSchedule_constant_optimum_lower
decl_826.label: fifoSchedule_constant_optimum_lower
decl_826.statement:
∀ {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m),
  ∃ jobs vertices I,
    (∀ (u v w : Fin vertices), I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      I.optimum m ⋯ ≤ 6 ∧ 3 * (m - 1) ≤ I.maxFlow (I.fifoSchedule m ⋯)
decl_826.source:
theorem fifoSchedule_constant_optimum_lower {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    ∃ jobs vertices, ∃ I : Instance jobs vertices,
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 6 ∧
      3 * (m - 1) ≤ I.maxFlow (I.fifoSchedule m (by omega)) :=
  fifo_constant_optimum_lower hm (fifoScheduler m (by omega)) (fun I => fifoScheduler_isFIFO (by omega) I)

end Scheduling

decl_801.name: Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance
decl_801.label: StarChain.toInstance
decl_801.statement: {jobs m : ℕ} → (Fin jobs → Bool) → 0 < m → Scheduling.Instance jobs (jobs * (3 * m))
decl_801.source:
def toInstance (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) : Instance jobs (jobs * (3 * m)) where
  owner := job
  release j := j.val * 3
  edge u v := job u = job v ∧
    if long (job v) then
      ((position u).val = 0 ∧ (position v).val = 1) ∨
      ((position u).val = 1 ∧ 2 ≤ (position v).val)
    else (position u).val = 0 ∧ 1 ≤ (position v).val
  same_job h := h.1
  rank v := (position v).val
  rank_increases := by
    intro u v h
    have hh := h.2
    split_ifs at hh <;> omega
  nonempty_job j := ⟨finProdFinEquiv (j, ⟨0, by omega⟩), by simp⟩

decl_794.name: Scheduling.StarChain.root
decl_794.label: StarChain.root
decl_794.statement: {jobs m : ℕ} → 0 < m → Fin jobs → Fin (jobs * (3 * m))
decl_794.source:
def root (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) : Fin (jobs * (3 * m)) :=
  finProdFinEquiv (j, ⟨0, by omega⟩)

decl_779.name: Scheduling.StarChain.middle
decl_779.label: StarChain.middle
decl_779.statement: {jobs m : ℕ} → 0 < m → Fin jobs → Fin (jobs * (3 * m))
decl_779.source:
def middle (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) : Fin (jobs * (3 * m)) :=
  finProdFinEquiv (j, ⟨1, by omega⟩)

decl_773.name: Scheduling.StarChain.job_root
decl_773.label: StarChain.job_root
decl_773.statement: ∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs), Scheduling.LayeredForest.job (Scheduling.StarChain.root hm j) = j
decl_773.source: @[simp] theorem job_root (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) : job (root hm j) = j := by simp [root]

decl_790.name: Scheduling.StarChain.position_root
decl_790.label: StarChain.position_root
decl_790.statement: ∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs), ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position (Scheduling.StarChain.root hm j)) = 0
decl_790.source: @[simp] theorem position_root (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) : (position (root hm j)).val = 0 := by simp [root]

decl_772.name: Scheduling.StarChain.job_middle
decl_772.label: StarChain.job_middle
decl_772.statement: ∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs), Scheduling.LayeredForest.job (Scheduling.StarChain.middle hm j) = j
decl_772.source: @[simp] theorem job_middle (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) : job (middle hm j) = j := by simp [middle]

decl_789.name: Scheduling.StarChain.position_middle
decl_789.label: StarChain.position_middle
decl_789.statement: ∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs), ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position (Scheduling.StarChain.middle hm j)) = 1
decl_789.source: @[simp] theorem position_middle (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) : (position (middle hm j)).val = 1 := by simp [middle]

decl_767.name: Scheduling.StarChain.eq_root
decl_767.label: StarChain.eq_root
decl_767.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))),
  ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) = 0 → v = Scheduling.StarChain.root hm (Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v)
decl_767.source:
theorem eq_root (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) (hv : (position v).val = 0) :
    v = root hm (job v) := by
  apply LayeredForest.coordinates_injective
  exact Prod.ext (by simp) (by simpa using hv)

decl_766.name: Scheduling.StarChain.eq_middle
decl_766.label: StarChain.eq_middle
decl_766.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))),
  ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) = 1 → v = Scheduling.StarChain.middle hm (Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v)
decl_766.source:
theorem eq_middle (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) (hv : (position v).val = 1) :
    v = middle hm (job v) := by
  apply LayeredForest.coordinates_injective
  exact Prod.ext (by simp) (by simpa using hv)

decl_754.name: Scheduling.StarChain.IsLeaf
decl_754.label: StarChain.IsLeaf
decl_754.statement: {jobs m : ℕ} → (Fin jobs → Bool) → Fin (jobs * (3 * m)) → Prop
decl_754.source:
def IsLeaf (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) : Prop :=
  if long (job v) then 2 ≤ (position v).val else 1 ≤ (position v).val

decl_755.name: Scheduling.StarChain.IsMiddle
decl_755.label: StarChain.IsMiddle
decl_755.statement: {jobs m : ℕ} → (Fin jobs → Bool) → Fin (jobs * (3 * m)) → Prop
decl_755.source:
def IsMiddle (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) : Prop :=
  long (job v) = true ∧ (position v).val = 1

decl_802.name: Scheduling.StarChain.vertex_kinds
decl_802.label: StarChain.vertex_kinds
decl_802.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))),
  ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) = 0 ∨ Scheduling.StarChain.IsMiddle long v ∨ Scheduling.StarChain.IsLeaf long v
decl_802.source:
theorem vertex_kinds (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) :
    (position v).val = 0 ∨ IsMiddle long v ∨ IsLeaf long v := by
  unfold IsMiddle IsLeaf
  cases long (job v) <;> simp <;> omega

decl_783.name: Scheduling.StarChain.no_parent_root
decl_783.label: StarChain.no_parent_root
decl_783.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) (u : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))),
  ¬(Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).edge u (Scheduling.StarChain.root hm j)
decl_783.source:
theorem no_parent_root (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs)
    (u : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) : ¬ (toInstance long hm).edge u (root hm j) := by
  simp [toInstance, root]

decl_780.name: Scheduling.StarChain.middle_parent
decl_780.label: StarChain.middle_parent
decl_780.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs),
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).edge (Scheduling.StarChain.root hm j) (Scheduling.StarChain.middle hm j)
decl_780.source:
theorem middle_parent (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) :
    (toInstance long hm).edge (root hm j) (middle hm j) := by
  constructor
  · simp
  · simp [root, middle]

decl_761.name: Scheduling.StarChain.at_most_one_parent
decl_761.label: StarChain.at_most_one_parent
decl_761.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) {u v w : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))},
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).edge u w → (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).edge v w → u = v
decl_761.source:
theorem at_most_one_parent (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m)
    {u v w : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))}
    (hu : (toInstance long hm).edge u w) (hv : (toInstance long hm).edge v w) : u = v := by
  apply LayeredForest.coordinates_injective
  refine Prod.ext (hu.1.trans hv.1.symm) ?_
  have h₁ := hu.2
  have h₂ := hv.2
  change (position u).val = (position v).val
  split_ifs at h₁ h₂ <;> omega

decl_787.name: Scheduling.StarChain.parent_exists
decl_787.label: StarChain.parent_exists
decl_787.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))),
  0 < ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) → ∃ u, (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).edge u v
decl_787.source:
theorem parent_exists (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m)
    (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) (hv : 0 < (position v).val) :
    ∃ u, (toInstance long hm).edge u v := by
  by_cases hl : long (job v) = true
  · by_cases hmid : (position v).val = 1
    · refine ⟨root hm (job v), ?_⟩
      simp [toInstance, root, hl, hmid]
    · refine ⟨middle hm (job v), ?_⟩
      simp [toInstance, middle, hl, show 2 ≤ (position v).val by omega]
  · refine ⟨root hm (job v), ?_⟩
    simp [toInstance, root, hl, show 1 ≤ (position v).val by omega]

decl_788.name: Scheduling.StarChain.parent_position
decl_788.label: StarChain.parent_position
decl_788.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) {u v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))},
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).edge u v → ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position u) ≤ 1
decl_788.source:
theorem parent_position (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m)
    {u v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))} (he : (toInstance long hm).edge u v) :
    (position u).val ≤ 1 := by
  have hh := he.2
  split_ifs at hh <;> omega

decl_795.name: Scheduling.StarChain.root_before_nonroot
decl_795.label: StarChain.root_before_nonroot
decl_795.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Valid m S →
    ∀ (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))),
      0 < ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) →
        S (Scheduling.StarChain.root hm (Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v)) < S v
decl_795.source:
theorem root_before_nonroot (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m)
    {S : Assignment} (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) (hv : 0 < (position v).val) :
    S (root hm (job v)) < S v := by
  obtain ⟨u, he⟩ := parent_exists long hm v hv
  have hu := parent_position long hm he
  have ho := he.1
  have ht := hS.precedence he
  by_cases hz : (position u).val = 0
  · rw [eq_root hm u hz, ho] at ht
    exact ht
  · have hone : (position u).val = 1 := by omega
    rw [eq_middle hm u hone, ho] at ht
    exact (hS.precedence (middle_parent long hm (job v))).trans ht

/-- Every vertex is at distance at most two from its job's root. Together
with unique parents, this certifies rooted out-trees of height at most three. -/

decl_796.name: Scheduling.StarChain.root_reaches
decl_796.label: StarChain.root_reaches
decl_796.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))),
  v = Scheduling.StarChain.root hm (Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v) ∨
    (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).edge (Scheduling.StarChain.root hm (Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v)) v ∨
      ∃ u,
        (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).edge (Scheduling.StarChain.root hm (Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v))
            u ∧
          (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).edge u v
decl_796.source:
theorem root_reaches (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m)
    (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) :
    v = root hm (job v) ∨ (toInstance long hm).edge (root hm (job v)) v ∨
      ∃ u, (toInstance long hm).edge (root hm (job v)) u ∧ (toInstance long hm).edge u v := by
  by_cases hz : (position v).val = 0
  · exact Or.inl (eq_root hm v hz)
  · obtain ⟨u, he⟩ := parent_exists long hm v (by omega)
    have hu := parent_position long hm he
    have ho := he.1
    by_cases hu0 : (position u).val = 0
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by rwa [eq_root hm u hu0, ho] at he))
    · refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨u, ?_, he⟩)
      rw [eq_middle hm u (by omega), ho]
      exact middle_parent long hm _

decl_785.name: Scheduling.StarChain.offline_schedule
decl_785.label: StarChain.offline_schedule
decl_785.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 2 ≤ m),
  ∃ O, (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long ⋯).Valid m O ∧ (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long ⋯).FlowBound O 6
decl_785.source:
theorem offline_schedule (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    ∃ O, (toInstance (m := m) long (by omega)).Valid m O ∧ (toInstance (m := m) long (by omega)).FlowBound O 6 := by
  let I := toInstance long (show 0 < m by omega)
  let pos := fun v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m)) => (position v).val
  have hpos : ∀ v, pos v < m * 3 := by intro v; have := (position v).isLt; dsimp [pos]; omega
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun v => (I.owner v, pos v)) := LayeredForest.coordinates_injective
  have hedge : ∀ u v, I.edge u v → pos u < 3 ∧ pos u < pos v := by
    intro u v he
    have hp := I.rank_increases he
    have hh := he.2
    change (position u).val < 3 ∧ (position u).val < (position v).val
    split_ifs at hh <;> omega
  refine ⟨fun v => pipelineTime m 3 (I.owner v).val (pos v), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact I.pipeline_valid hm pos hpos hinj (by intros; rfl) hedge
  · exact I.pipeline_flowBound hm pos hpos (by intros; rfl)

decl_786.name: Scheduling.StarChain.optimum_le_six
decl_786.label:
Star-chain offline schedule
OPT ≤ 6
decl_786.statement: ∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 2 ≤ m), (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long ⋯).optimum m ⋯ ≤ 6
decl_786.source:
theorem optimum_le_six (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    (toInstance (m := m) long (by omega)).optimum m (by omega) ≤ 6 := by
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hflow⟩ := offline_schedule long hm
  exact (toInstance (m := m) long (by omega)).optimum_le (by omega) hO hflow

decl_771.name: Scheduling.StarChain.jobVertices_card
decl_771.label: StarChain.jobVertices_card
decl_771.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs),
  ((Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).jobVertices j).card = 3 * m
decl_771.source:
theorem jobVertices_card (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) :
    ((toInstance long hm).jobVertices j).card = 3 * m := by
  have he : (toInstance long hm).jobVertices j =
      univ.image (fun p : Fin (3 * m) => finProdFinEquiv (j, p)) := by
    ext v
    simp only [Instance.jobVertices, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_image]
    change job v = j ↔ ∃ p : Fin (3 * m), finProdFinEquiv (j, p) = v
    constructor
    · intro ho
      refine ⟨position v, ?_⟩
      apply LayeredForest.coordinates_injective
      simp only [LayeredForest.job_pair, LayeredForest.position_pair]
      exact Prod.ext ho.symm rfl
    · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
      simp
  rw [he, card_image_of_injective]
  · simp
  · intro p q hpq
    exact (Prod.mk.inj (finProdFinEquiv.injective hpq)).2

end Scheduling.StarChain

decl_756.name: Scheduling.StarChain.MiddleAt
decl_756.label: StarChain.MiddleAt
decl_756.statement: {jobs m : ℕ} → (Fin jobs → Bool) → 0 < m → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → Prop

decl_759.name: Scheduling.StarChain.TypeConsistent
decl_759.label: StarChain.TypeConsistent
decl_759.statement: {jobs m : ℕ} → (Fin jobs → Bool) → 0 < m → Scheduling.Assignment → Fin jobs → Prop
decl_759.source:
def TypeConsistent (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (3 * m))) (j : Fin jobs) : Prop :=
  long j = true ↔ ¬ MiddleAt long hm S (S (root hm j))

/-- A job's type can be chosen after the slot executing its root. All of
its nonroot vertices are still hidden at the beginning of that slot. -/

decl_763.name: Scheduling.StarChain.change_type
decl_763.label: StarChain.change_type
decl_763.source:
theorem change_type (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (hm : 0 < m)
    (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (j : Fin jobs) (b : Bool) :
    let I := toInstance long hm
    let J := toInstance (Function.update long j b) hm
    ∀ t ≤ A.schedule I (root hm j), ∀ v,
      A.schedule I v = t ↔ A.schedule J v = t := by
  dsimp only
  let I := toInstance long hm
  let J := toInstance (Function.update long j b) hm
  let hidden := univ.filter (fun v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m)) =>
    job v = j ∧ 0 < (position v).val)
  have hparent : ∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, J.edge u v ∧
      A.schedule I (root hm j) ≤ A.schedule I u := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨ho, hp⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    obtain ⟨u, he⟩ := parent_exists (Function.update long j b) hm v hp
    refine ⟨u, he, ?_⟩
    have hu := parent_position (Function.update long j b) hm he
    have howner : job u = j := he.1.trans ho
    by_cases hz : (position u).val = 0
    · rw [eq_root hm u hz, howner]
    · have hone : (position u).val = 1 := by omega
      rw [eq_middle hm u hone, howner]
      exact Nat.le_of_lt ((A.valid I).precedence (middle_parent long hm j))
  have hreplace := A.hidden_replacement I J hidden rfl rfl (by
    intro u v hv
    by_cases ho : job v = j
    · have hz : (position v).val = 0 := by
        simp only [hidden, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, ho, true_and] at hv
        omega
      rw [eq_root hm v hz]
      exact iff_of_false (no_parent_root long hm _ u)
        (no_parent_root (Function.update long j b) hm _ u)
    · change (job u = job v ∧ _) ↔ (job u = job v ∧ _)
      simp only [Function.update_of_ne ho]) (by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨ho, hp⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    obtain ⟨u, he⟩ := parent_exists long hm v hp
    refine ⟨u, he, ?_⟩
    have hu := parent_position long hm he
    have howner : job u = j := he.1.trans ho
    by_cases hz : (position u).val = 0
    · rw [eq_root hm u hz, howner]
    · have hone : (position u).val = 1 := by omega
      rw [eq_middle hm u hone, howner]
      exact Nat.le_of_lt ((A.valid I).precedence (middle_parent long hm j))) hparent
  intro t ht v
  have he := hreplace.1 t ht
  simpa only [val_mem_executionSlot] using
    (show v.val ∈ executionSlot (A.schedule I) t ↔
      v.val ∈ executionSlot (A.schedule J) t from by rw [he])

/-- Choosing a type cannot change which middle vertices execute in any
slot up to and including this job's root slot. -/

decl_764.name: Scheduling.StarChain.change_type_middle
decl_764.label: StarChain.change_type_middle
decl_764.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) (hm : 0 < m) (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (j : Fin jobs)
  (b : Bool),
  ∀ t ≤ A.schedule (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm) (Scheduling.StarChain.root hm j),
    Scheduling.StarChain.MiddleAt long hm (A.schedule (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm)) t ↔
      Scheduling.StarChain.MiddleAt (Function.update long j b) hm
        (A.schedule (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance (Function.update long j b) hm)) t
decl_764.source:
theorem change_type_middle (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (hm : 0 < m)
    (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (j : Fin jobs) (b : Bool)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ A.schedule (toInstance long hm) (root hm j)) :
    MiddleAt long hm (A.schedule (toInstance long hm)) t ↔
      MiddleAt (Function.update long j b) hm
        (A.schedule (toInstance (Function.update long j b) hm)) t := by
  have hs := change_type A hm long j b t ht
  have hmid := (A.valid (toInstance long hm)).precedence (middle_parent long hm j)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, htime⟩
    have hij : i ≠ j := by rintro rfl; omega
    exact ⟨i, by simpa [Function.update_of_ne hij] using hi, (hs _).mp htime⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, htime⟩
    have htime' := (hs _).mpr htime
    have hij : i ≠ j := by rintro rfl; omega
    exact ⟨i, by simpa [Function.update_of_ne hij] using hi, htime'⟩

decl_757.name: Scheduling.StarChain.Settled
decl_757.label: StarChain.Settled
decl_757.statement: {jobs m : ℕ} → Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m → 0 < m → (Fin jobs → Bool) → Finset (Fin jobs) → Prop
decl_757.source:
def Settled (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (hm : 0 < m)
    (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (fixed : Finset (Fin jobs)) : Prop :=
  (∀ j ∈ fixed, TypeConsistent long hm (A.schedule (toInstance long hm)) j) ∧
    ∀ j ∈ fixed, ∀ k ∉ fixed,
      A.schedule (toInstance long hm) (root hm j) ≤
        A.schedule (toInstance long hm) (root hm k)

decl_797.name: Scheduling.StarChain.settle_next
decl_797.label: StarChain.settle_next
decl_797.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) (hm : 0 < m) (long : Fin jobs → Bool)
  (fixed : Finset (Fin jobs)),
  Scheduling.StarChain.Settled A hm long fixed →
    ∀ j ∉ fixed,
      (∀ k ∉ fixed,
          A.schedule (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm) (Scheduling.StarChain.root hm j) ≤
            A.schedule (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm) (Scheduling.StarChain.root hm k)) →
        ∃ long', Scheduling.StarChain.Settled A hm long' (insert j fixed)
decl_797.source:
theorem settle_next (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (hm : 0 < m)
    (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (fixed : Finset (Fin jobs))
    (hfixed : Settled A hm long fixed) (j : Fin jobs) (hj : j ∉ fixed)
    (hmin : ∀ k ∉ fixed, A.schedule (toInstance long hm) (root hm j) ≤
      A.schedule (toInstance long hm) (root hm k)) :
    ∃ long', Settled A hm long' (insert j fixed) := by
  let S := A.schedule (toInstance long hm)
  let t := S (root hm j)
  let b := decide (¬ MiddleAt long hm S t)
  let long' := Function.update long j b
  let S' := A.schedule (toInstance long' hm)
  have hslot : ∀ u ≤ t, ∀ v, S v = u ↔ S' v = u := change_type A hm long j b
  have htime : ∀ v, S v ≤ t → S' v = S v := by
    intro v hv
    exact (hslot _ hv v).mp rfl
  have hmiddle : ∀ u ≤ t, MiddleAt long hm S u ↔ MiddleAt long' hm S' u :=
    change_type_middle A hm long j b
  have hnew : S' (root hm j) = t := htime _ le_rfl
  have hearly : ∀ i ∈ fixed, S' (root hm i) = S (root hm i) := by
    intro i hi
    exact htime _ (hfixed.2 i hi j hj)
  have hlate : ∀ k ∉ fixed, t ≤ S' (root hm k) := by
    intro k hk
    by_contra hn
    have hh : S' (root hm k) ≤ t := by omega
    have he := (hslot _ hh (root hm k)).mpr rfl
    have hle := hmin k hk
    change t ≤ S (root hm k) at hle
    omega
  refine ⟨long', ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    rcases mem_insert.mp hi with hij | hi
    · subst i
      change long' j = true ↔ ¬ MiddleAt long' hm S' (S' (root hm j))
      rw [hnew, ← hmiddle t le_rfl]
      simp only [long', Function.update_self, b, decide_eq_true_eq]
    · have hij : i ≠ j := by intro heq; exact hj (heq ▸ hi)
      change long' i = true ↔ ¬ MiddleAt long' hm S' (S' (root hm i))
      rw [hearly i hi, ← hmiddle _ (hfixed.2 i hi j hj)]
      simpa only [long', Function.update_of_ne hij, TypeConsistent, S] using hfixed.1 i hi
  · intro i hi k hk
    have hk' : k ∉ fixed := fun h => hk (mem_insert_of_mem h)
    change S' (root hm i) ≤ S' (root hm k)
    rcases mem_insert.mp hi with rfl | hi
    · rw [hnew]
      exact hlate k hk'
    · rw [hearly i hi]
      exact (hfixed.2 i hi j hj).trans (hlate k hk')

/-- The adaptive rule is realized by a fixed star-and-chain instance for
every deterministic non-clairvoyant scheduler. Simultaneous roots receive
the same rule; changing one of them leaves that slot's middle set intact. -/

decl_769.name: Scheduling.StarChain.exists_type_consistent
decl_769.label: Fixed star-chain adversary
decl_769.statement:
∀ {m : ℕ} (A : Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler m) (hm : 0 < m) (jobs : ℕ),
  ∃ long,
    ∀ (j : Fin jobs),
      Scheduling.StarChain.TypeConsistent long hm (A.schedule (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm)) j
decl_769.source:
theorem exists_type_consistent (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (hm : 0 < m)
    (jobs : ℕ) : ∃ long : Fin jobs → Bool,
      ∀ j, TypeConsistent long hm (A.schedule (toInstance long hm)) j := by
  have extend : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (fixed : Finset (Fin jobs)),
      (univ \ fixed).card = n → Settled A hm long fixed →
      ∃ final : Fin jobs → Bool,
        ∀ j, TypeConsistent final hm (A.schedule (toInstance final hm)) j := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro long fixed hn hf
      by_cases hempty : (univ \ fixed).Nonempty
      · obtain ⟨j, hj, hmin⟩ := exists_min_image (univ \ fixed)
          (fun j => A.schedule (toInstance long hm) (root hm j)) hempty
        have hj' : j ∉ fixed := (mem_sdiff.mp hj).2
        obtain ⟨long', hf'⟩ := settle_next A hm long fixed hf j hj' (by
          intro k hk
          exact hmin k (mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hk⟩))
        have he : univ \ insert j fixed = (univ \ fixed).erase j := by
          ext k
          simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_univ, mem_insert, mem_erase, true_and]
          tauto
        have hlt : (univ \ insert j fixed).card < n := by
          rw [he, ← hn]
          exact card_erase_lt_of_mem hj
        exact ih _ hlt long' (insert j fixed) rfl hf'
      · refine ⟨long, fun j => hf.1 j ?_⟩
        by_contra hj
        exact hempty ⟨j, mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hj⟩⟩
  exact extend _ (fun _ => true) ∅ rfl ⟨by simp, by simp⟩

end Scheduling.StarChain

decl_777.name: Scheduling.StarChain.leaf_positive
decl_777.label: StarChain.leaf_positive
decl_777.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))},
  Scheduling.StarChain.IsLeaf long v → 0 < ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v)
decl_777.source:
theorem leaf_positive {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))} (hv : IsLeaf long v) :
    0 < (position v).val := by
  unfold IsLeaf at hv
  split_ifs at hv <;> omega

decl_784.name: Scheduling.StarChain.nonleaf_position
decl_784.label: StarChain.nonleaf_position
decl_784.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))},
  ¬Scheduling.StarChain.IsLeaf long v → ↑(Scheduling.LayeredForest.position v) ≤ 1
decl_784.source:
theorem nonleaf_position {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))} (hv : ¬ IsLeaf long v) :
    (position v).val ≤ 1 := by
  unfold IsLeaf at hv
  split_ifs at hv <;> omega

decl_768.name: Scheduling.StarChain.executed_ready
decl_768.label: StarChain.executed_ready
decl_768.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {hm : 0 < m} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Valid m S →
    ∀ (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))), (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Ready S (S v) v
decl_768.source:
theorem executed_ready (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) : (toInstance long hm).Ready S (S v) v :=
  ⟨hS.release v, le_rfl, fun _ he => hS.precedence he⟩

decl_760.name: Scheduling.StarChain.alive_card_lt
decl_760.label: StarChain.alive_card_lt
decl_760.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {hm : 0 < m} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)) →
    ∀ (t : ℕ), ((Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).alive S t).card < m
decl_760.source:
theorem alive_card_lt (hflow : (toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)))
    (t : ℕ) : ((toInstance long hm).alive S t).card < m := by
  have hc := card_le_card_of_injOn Fin.val (s := (toInstance long hm).alive S t)
    (t := Ico (t / 3 + 1 - (m - 1)) (t / 3 + 1)) (by
      intro j hj
      obtain ⟨hr, v, ho, ht⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hj).2
      have hf := hflow v
      rw [ho] at hf
      change j.val * 3 ≤ t at hr
      change S v < j.val * 3 + 3 * (m - 1) at hf
      exact mem_Ico.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩)
    (by intro u _ v _ huv; exact Fin.ext huv)
  have hlen : (Ico (t / 3 + 1 - (m - 1)) (t / 3 + 1)).card ≤ m - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.card_Ico]
    omega
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hc.trans hlen) (by omega)

decl_791.name: Scheduling.StarChain.ready_nonleaf_injective
decl_791.label: StarChain.ready_nonleaf_injective
decl_791.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {hm : 0 < m} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Valid m S →
    ∀ {t : ℕ} {u v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))},
      (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Ready S t u →
        (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Ready S t v →
          ¬Scheduling.StarChain.IsLeaf long u →
            ¬Scheduling.StarChain.IsLeaf long v →
              Scheduling.LayeredForest.job u = Scheduling.LayeredForest.job v → u = v
decl_791.source:
theorem ready_nonleaf_injective (_hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    {t : ℕ} {u v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))}
    (hu : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t u) (hv : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v)
    (hlu : ¬ IsLeaf long u) (hlv : ¬ IsLeaf long v) (ho : job u = job v) : u = v := by
  have hpu := nonleaf_position hlu
  have hpv := nonleaf_position hlv
  apply LayeredForest.coordinates_injective
  refine Prod.ext ho ?_
  change (position u).val = (position v).val
  by_contra hne
  have hcases : ((position u).val = 0 ∧ (position v).val = 1) ∨
      ((position v).val = 0 ∧ (position u).val = 1) := by omega
  rcases hcases with ⟨hu0, hv1⟩ | ⟨hv0, hu1⟩
  · have he : (toInstance long hm).edge u v := by
      rw [eq_root hm u hu0, eq_middle hm v hv1, ho]
      exact middle_parent long hm _
    have hh := hv.2.2 u he
    have ht := hu.2.1
    omega
  · have he : (toInstance long hm).edge v u := by
      rw [eq_root hm v hv0, eq_middle hm u hu1, ho]
      exact middle_parent long hm _
    have hh := hu.2.2 v he
    have ht := hv.2.1
    omega

decl_781.name: Scheduling.StarChain.no_leaves_idle
decl_781.label: StarChain.no_leaves_idle
decl_781.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {hm : 0 < m} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Valid m S →
    (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)) →
      ∀ (t : ℕ),
        (∀ (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))),
            (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Ready S t v → ¬Scheduling.StarChain.IsLeaf long v) →
          {v | S v = t}.card < m
decl_781.source:
theorem no_leaves_idle (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (hflow : (toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)))
    (t : ℕ) (hn : ∀ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v → ¬ IsLeaf long v) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card < m := by
  have hcard := card_le_card_of_injOn job
    (s := univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)) (t := (toInstance long hm).alive S t) (by
      intro v hv
      have he := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      have hr := hS.release v
      refine mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, ?_, v, rfl, ?_⟩
      · change (toInstance long hm).release (job v) ≤ S v at hr
        omega
      · omega) (by
      intro u hu v hv ho
      have hut := (mem_filter.mp hu).2
      have hvt := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      have hru : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t u := hut ▸ executed_ready hS u
      have hrv : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v := hvt ▸ executed_ready hS v
      exact ready_nonleaf_injective hS hru hrv (hn u hru) (hn v hrv) ho)
  exact hcard.trans_lt (alive_card_lt hflow t)

decl_782.name: Scheduling.StarChain.no_leaves_process_all
decl_782.label: StarChain.no_leaves_process_all
decl_782.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {hm : 0 < m} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Valid m S →
    (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).IsFIFO m S →
      (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)) →
        ∀ (t : ℕ),
          (∀ (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))),
              (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Ready S t v → ¬Scheduling.StarChain.IsLeaf long v) →
            ∀ (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))), (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Ready S t v → S v = t
decl_782.source:
theorem no_leaves_process_all (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (hfifo : (toInstance long hm).IsFIFO m S)
    (hflow : (toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)))
    (t : ℕ) (hn : ∀ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v → ¬ IsLeaf long v)
    (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) (hv : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v) : S v = t := by
  by_contra he
  have hfull := hfifo.work_conserving t v hv he
  have hidle := no_leaves_idle hS hflow t hn
  omega

/-- Ready leaves are older than every unprocessed root and exclude
ready middle vertices. -/

decl_758.name: Scheduling.StarChain.StateInvariant
decl_758.label: StarChain.StateInvariant
decl_758.statement: {jobs m : ℕ} → (Fin jobs → Bool) → 0 < m → Scheduling.Assignment → ℕ → Prop
decl_758.source:
def StateInvariant (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (3 * m))) (t : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v → IsLeaf long v →
    ∀ j, t ≤ S (root hm j) → (job v).val < j.val) ∧
  (∀ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v → IsLeaf long v →
    ∀ w, (toInstance long hm).Ready S t w → ¬ IsMiddle long w)

decl_793.name: Scheduling.StarChain.ready_root_iff
decl_793.label: StarChain.ready_root_iff
decl_793.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {hm : 0 < m} {S : Scheduling.Assignment} (t : ℕ) (j : Fin jobs),
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Ready S t (Scheduling.StarChain.root hm j) ↔
    ↑j * 3 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ S (Scheduling.StarChain.root hm j)
decl_793.source:
theorem ready_root_iff (t : ℕ) (j : Fin jobs) :
    (toInstance long hm).Ready S t (root hm j) ↔ j.val * 3 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ S (root hm j) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨by simpa [toInstance] using h.1, h.2.1⟩
  · intro h
    exact ⟨by simpa [toInstance] using h.1, h.2,
      fun u he => False.elim (no_parent_root long hm j u he)⟩

decl_792.name: Scheduling.StarChain.ready_nonroot_iff
decl_792.label: StarChain.ready_nonroot_iff
decl_792.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {hm : 0 < m} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Valid m S →
    ∀ {u v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))},
      (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).edge u v →
        ∀ (t : ℕ), (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Ready S t v ↔ t ≤ S v ∧ S u < t
decl_792.source:
theorem ready_nonroot_iff (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    {u v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))} (he : (toInstance long hm).edge u v) (t : ℕ) :
    (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v ↔ t ≤ S v ∧ S u < t := by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨h.2.1, h.2.2 u he⟩
  · intro h
    have hr := hS.release u
    rw [(toInstance long hm).same_job he] at hr
    exact ⟨by omega, h.1, fun w hw => by
      rw [at_most_one_parent long hm hw he]
      exact h.2⟩

decl_774.name: Scheduling.StarChain.leafParent
decl_774.label: StarChain.leafParent
decl_774.statement: {jobs m : ℕ} → (Fin jobs → Bool) → 0 < m → Fin (jobs * (3 * m)) → Fin (jobs * (3 * m))

decl_775.name: Scheduling.StarChain.leaf_parent_edge
decl_775.label: StarChain.leaf_parent_edge
decl_775.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {hm : 0 < m} {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))},
  Scheduling.StarChain.IsLeaf long v →
    (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).edge (Scheduling.StarChain.leafParent long hm v) v
decl_775.source:
theorem leaf_parent_edge {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))} (hv : IsLeaf long v) :
    (toInstance long hm).edge (leafParent long hm v) v := by
  unfold leafParent IsLeaf at *
  split_ifs at * <;> simp_all [toInstance]

decl_770.name: Scheduling.StarChain.fresh_leaf_has_middle
decl_770.label: StarChain.fresh_leaf_has_middle
decl_770.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {hm : 0 < m} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Valid m S →
    (∀ (j : Fin jobs), Scheduling.StarChain.TypeConsistent long hm S j) →
      ∀ {t : ℕ} {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))},
        Scheduling.StarChain.IsLeaf long v →
          S (Scheduling.StarChain.leafParent long hm v) = t → Scheduling.StarChain.MiddleAt long hm S t
decl_770.source:
theorem fresh_leaf_has_middle (_hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (hc : ∀ j, TypeConsistent long hm S j)
    {t : ℕ} {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))} (_hv : IsLeaf long v)
    (hparent : S (leafParent long hm v) = t) : MiddleAt long hm S t := by
  by_cases hl : long (job v) = true
  · exact ⟨job v, hl, by simpa [leafParent, hl] using hparent⟩
  · have hr : S (root hm (job v)) = t := by simpa [leafParent, hl] using hparent
    have hh := hc (job v)
    unfold TypeConsistent at hh
    rw [hr] at hh
    by_contra hn
    exact hl (hh.mpr hn)

decl_776.name: Scheduling.StarChain.leaf_persists
decl_776.label: StarChain.leaf_persists
decl_776.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {hm : 0 < m} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Valid m S →
    (∀ (j : Fin jobs), Scheduling.StarChain.TypeConsistent long hm S j) →
      ∀ {t : ℕ},
        Scheduling.StarChain.StateInvariant long hm S t →
          (∃ w, (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Ready S t w ∧ Scheduling.StarChain.IsLeaf long w) →
            ∀ {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))},
              (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Ready S (t + 1) v →
                Scheduling.StarChain.IsLeaf long v → (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Ready S t v
decl_776.source:
theorem leaf_persists (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (hc : ∀ j, TypeConsistent long hm S j) {t : ℕ}
    (hinv : StateInvariant long hm S t)
    (hex : ∃ w, (toInstance long hm).Ready S t w ∧ IsLeaf long w)
    {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))} (hv : (toInstance long hm).Ready S (t + 1) v)
    (hl : IsLeaf long v) : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwl⟩ := hex
  have hp := (ready_nonroot_iff hS (leaf_parent_edge hl) (t + 1)).mp hv
  have hne : S (leafParent long hm v) ≠ t := by
    intro he
    obtain ⟨j, hj, ht⟩ := fresh_leaf_has_middle hS hc hl he
    have hr : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t (middle hm j) := ht ▸ executed_ready hS _
    exact hinv.2 w hw hwl _ hr ⟨by simpa, by simp⟩
  exact (ready_nonroot_iff hS (leaf_parent_edge hl) t).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩

decl_800.name: Scheduling.StarChain.stateInvariant_zero
decl_800.label: StarChain.stateInvariant_zero
decl_800.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {hm : 0 < m} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Valid m S → Scheduling.StarChain.StateInvariant long hm S 0
decl_800.source:
theorem stateInvariant_zero (_hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S) :
    StateInvariant long hm S 0 := by
  have hn : ∀ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S 0 v → ¬ IsLeaf long v := by
    intro v hv hl
    have hp := hv.2.2 _ (leaf_parent_edge hl)
    omega
  exact ⟨fun v hv hl => False.elim (hn v hv hl),
    fun v hv hl => False.elim (hn v hv hl)⟩

decl_799.name: Scheduling.StarChain.stateInvariant_step
decl_799.label: StarChain.stateInvariant_step
decl_799.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {hm : 0 < m} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Valid m S →
    (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).IsFIFO m S →
      (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)) →
        (∀ (j : Fin jobs), Scheduling.StarChain.TypeConsistent long hm S j) →
          ∀ {t : ℕ},
            Scheduling.StarChain.StateInvariant long hm S t → Scheduling.StarChain.StateInvariant long hm S (t + 1)
decl_799.source:
theorem stateInvariant_step (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (hfifo : (toInstance long hm).IsFIFO m S)
    (hflow : (toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)))
    (hc : ∀ j, TypeConsistent long hm S j) {t : ℕ}
    (hinv : StateInvariant long hm S t) : StateInvariant long hm S (t + 1) := by
  by_cases hex : ∃ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v ∧ IsLeaf long v
  · have hpersist := fun v hv hl => leaf_persists hS hc hinv hex (v := v) hv hl
    constructor
    · intro v hv hl j hj
      exact hinv.1 v (hpersist v hv hl) hl j (by omega)
    · intro v hv hl w hw hmid
      have hvt := hpersist v hv hl
      have hwpos := hmid.2
      have he : (toInstance long hm).edge (root hm (job w)) w := by
        rw [eq_middle hm w hwpos]
        simpa only [job_middle] using middle_parent long hm (job w)
      have hwp := (ready_nonroot_iff hS he (t + 1)).mp hw
      by_cases heq : S (root hm (job w)) = t
      · have hne : S v ≠ t := by have := hv.2.1; omega
        have hprio := hfifo.fifo_priority t v (root hm (job w)) hvt hne heq
        have hold := hinv.1 v hvt hl (job w) (by omega)
        simp only [toInstance, job_root] at hprio
        omega
      · have hwold : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t w :=
          (ready_nonroot_iff hS he t).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
        exact hinv.2 v hvt hl w hwold hmid
  · have hn : ∀ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v → ¬ IsLeaf long v := by
      intro v hv hl
      exact hex ⟨v, hv, hl⟩
    have hall := no_leaves_process_all hS hfifo hflow t hn
    have hroots : ∀ j, t + 1 ≤ S (root hm j) → t < j.val * 3 := by
      intro j hj
      by_contra hh
      have hr : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t (root hm j) :=
        (ready_root_iff t j).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
      have he := hall _ hr
      omega
    constructor
    · intro v hv hl j hj
      have hp := hv.2.2 _ (leaf_parent_edge hl)
      have hr := hS.release (leafParent long hm v)
      have howner : job (leafParent long hm v) = job v := by
        unfold leafParent
        split_ifs <;> simp
      change (job (leafParent long hm v)).val * 3 ≤ S (leafParent long hm v) at hr
      rw [howner] at hr
      have hh := hroots j hj
      omega
    · intro v hv hl w hw hmid
      have hp := (ready_nonroot_iff hS (leaf_parent_edge hl) (t + 1)).mp hv
      have hpt : S (leafParent long hm v) = t := by
        by_contra hh
        have hvold : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v :=
          (ready_nonroot_iff hS (leaf_parent_edge hl) t).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
        exact hn v hvold hl
      have hmiddle := fresh_leaf_has_middle hS hc hl hpt
      have he : (toInstance long hm).edge (root hm (job w)) w := by
        rw [eq_middle hm w hmid.2]
        simpa only [job_middle] using middle_parent long hm (job w)
      have hwp := (ready_nonroot_iff hS he (t + 1)).mp hw
      have hrt : S (root hm (job w)) = t := by
        by_contra hh
        have hwold : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t w :=
          (ready_nonroot_iff hS he t).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
        have hdone := hall w hwold
        omega
      have hnone := (hc (job w)).mp hmid.1
      rw [hrt] at hnone
      exact hnone hmiddle

decl_798.name: Scheduling.StarChain.stateInvariant_all
decl_798.label: StarChain.stateInvariant_all
decl_798.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {hm : 0 < m} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Valid m S →
    (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).IsFIFO m S →
      (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)) →
        (∀ (j : Fin jobs), Scheduling.StarChain.TypeConsistent long hm S j) →
          ∀ (t : ℕ), Scheduling.StarChain.StateInvariant long hm S t
decl_798.source:
theorem stateInvariant_all (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (hfifo : (toInstance long hm).IsFIFO m S)
    (hflow : (toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)))
    (hc : ∀ j, TypeConsistent long hm S j) (t : ℕ) : StateInvariant long hm S t := by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact stateInvariant_zero hS
  | succ t ih => exact stateInvariant_step hS hfifo hflow hc ih

decl_778.name: Scheduling.StarChain.leaf_run_subset
decl_778.label: StarChain.leaf_run_subset
decl_778.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {hm : 0 < m} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Valid m S →
    (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).IsFIFO m S →
      (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)) →
        (∀ (j : Fin jobs), Scheduling.StarChain.TypeConsistent long hm S j) →
          ∀ (a n : ℕ),
            (∀ k < n,
                ∃ v, (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Ready S (a + k) v ∧ Scheduling.StarChain.IsLeaf long v) →
              ∀ {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))},
                (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Ready S (a + n) v →
                  Scheduling.StarChain.IsLeaf long v → (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Ready S a v
decl_778.source:
theorem leaf_run_subset (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (hfifo : (toInstance long hm).IsFIFO m S)
    (hflow : (toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)))
    (hc : ∀ j, TypeConsistent long hm S j) (a n : ℕ)
    (hex : ∀ k < n, ∃ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S (a + k) v ∧ IsLeaf long v)
    {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))} (hv : (toInstance long hm).Ready S (a + n) v)
    (hl : IsLeaf long v) : (toInstance long hm).Ready S a v := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hv
  | succ n ih =>
    have hprev := leaf_persists hS hc (stateInvariant_all hS hfifo hflow hc (a + n))
      (hex n (by omega)) (by simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hv) hl
    exact ih (fun k hk => hex k (by omega)) hprev

/-- Every block of `3(m-1)+1` slots wastes capacity if the maximum flow
were at most `3(m-1)`. A continuous run of ready leaves can only shrink,
so no such run can last longer than the assumed flow bound. -/

decl_762.name: Scheduling.StarChain.block_has_idle
decl_762.label: FIFO recurring idle slots
decl_762.statement:
∀ {jobs m : ℕ} {long : Fin jobs → Bool} {hm : 0 < m} {S : Scheduling.Assignment},
  (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).Valid m S →
    (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).IsFIFO m S →
      (Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)) →
        (∀ (j : Fin jobs), Scheduling.StarChain.TypeConsistent long hm S j) →
          ∀ (a : ℕ), ∃ t ∈ Finset.Ico a (a + (3 * (m - 1) + 1)), {v | S v = t}.card < m
decl_762.source:
theorem block_has_idle (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (hfifo : (toInstance long hm).IsFIFO m S)
    (hflow : (toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)))
    (hc : ∀ j, TypeConsistent long hm S j) (a : ℕ) :
    ∃ t ∈ Ico a (a + (3 * (m - 1) + 1)),
      (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card < m := by
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  have hex : ∀ k ≤ 3 * (m - 1),
      ∃ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S (a + k) v ∧ IsLeaf long v := by
    intro k hk
    by_contra hnone
    have hno : ∀ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S (a + k) v → ¬ IsLeaf long v := by
      intro v hv hl; exact hnone ⟨v, hv, hl⟩
    have hidle := no_leaves_idle hS hflow (a + k) hno
    have hfull := hn (a + k) (mem_Ico.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩)
    omega
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hl⟩ := hex _ le_rfl
  have hstart := leaf_run_subset hS hfifo hflow hc a (3 * (m - 1))
    (fun k hk => hex k (by omega)) hv hl
  have hr := hstart.1
  have ht := hv.2.1
  have hf := hflow v
  omega

end Scheduling.StarChain

decl_152.name: Scheduling.Batching.exists_ready_unfinished
decl_152.label: Batching.exists_ready_unfinished
decl_152.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices : ℕ} {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} [DecidableRel I.edge]
  (s : Scheduling.ExecutionState vertices),
  (∃ v, s.stamp v = none) → ∃ v, s.stamp v = none ∧ ∀ (u : Fin vertices), I.edge u v → s.stamp u ≠ none
decl_152.source:
theorem exists_ready_unfinished (s : ExecutionState vertices)
    (hu : ∃ v, s.stamp v = none) :
    ∃ v, s.stamp v = none ∧ ∀ u, I.edge u v → s.stamp u ≠ none := by
  have aux : ∀ n v, I.rank v = n → s.stamp v = none →
      ∃ w, s.stamp w = none ∧ ∀ u, I.edge u w → s.stamp u ≠ none := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro v hv hs
      by_cases hp : ∀ u, I.edge u v → s.stamp u ≠ none
      · exact ⟨v, hs, hp⟩
      · push Not at hp
        obtain ⟨u, he, hu⟩ := hp
        exact ih (I.rank u) (by have := I.rank_increases he; omega) u rfl hu
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hu
  exact aux (I.rank v) v rfl hv

decl_130.name: Scheduling.Batching.advance_progress
decl_130.label: Batching.advance_progress
decl_130.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} (B : Scheduling.Batching I L batches)
  [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (s : Scheduling.ExecutionState vertices),
      (∀ (b : Fin batches), B.eligible b ≤ s.clock) →
        (∃ v, s.stamp v = none) → s.completed.card + 1 ≤ (B.advance m s).completed.card
decl_130.source:
theorem advance_progress {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (s : ExecutionState vertices)
    (he : ∀ b, B.eligible b ≤ s.clock) (hu : ∃ v, s.stamp v = none) :
    s.completed.card + 1 ≤ (B.advance m s).completed.card := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hp⟩ := exists_ready_unfinished (I := I) s hu
  have hobs : v ∈ (B.observe s).ready (B.vertexBatch v) :=
    mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, rfl, he _, hv, hp⟩
  obtain ⟨w, k, hk, hw⟩ := (B.observe s).progress hm hobs
  have hready := B.selected_ready hw
  have hn : w ∉ s.completed := by simp [ExecutionState.completed, hready.2.1]
  have hd : w ∈ (B.advance m s).completed := by
    simp [ExecutionState.completed, advance, hw]
  have hc := card_le_card (insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨hd, B.completed_mono m s⟩)
  rw [card_insert_of_notMem hn] at hc
  exact hc

decl_171.name: Scheduling.Batching.run_clock_ge
decl_171.label: Batching.run_clock_ge
decl_171.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} (B : Scheduling.Batching I L batches)
  [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] (m k : ℕ), k ≤ (B.run m k).clock
decl_171.source:
theorem run_clock_ge (m k : ℕ) : k ≤ (B.run m k).clock := by
  induction k with
  | zero => omega
  | succ k ih =>
    have h := B.clock_strict m (B.run m k)
    change (B.run m k).clock < (B.run m (k + 1)).clock at h
    omega

decl_174.name: Scheduling.Batching.run_preserves_stamp
decl_174.label: Batching.run_preserves_stamp
decl_174.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} (B : Scheduling.Batching I L batches)
  [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m a b : ℕ},
  a ≤ b → ∀ {v : Fin vertices} {t : ℕ}, (B.run m a).stamp v = some t → (B.run m b).stamp v = some t
decl_174.source:
theorem run_preserves_stamp {m a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) {v : Fin vertices} {t : ℕ}
    (hv : (B.run m a).stamp v = some t) : (B.run m b).stamp v = some t := by
  induction b, hab using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact hv
  | succ b hab ih => exact B.preserves_stamp ih

decl_156.name: Scheduling.Batching.lastEligibility
decl_156.label: Batching.lastEligibility
decl_156.statement: {jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} → {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} → Scheduling.Batching I L batches → ℕ

decl_135.name: Scheduling.Batching.completionRound
decl_135.label: Batching.completionRound
decl_135.statement: {jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} → {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} → Scheduling.Batching I L batches → ℕ
decl_135.source:
def completionRound : ℕ := B.lastEligibility + vertices

omit [DecidableRel I.edge] in

decl_138.name: Scheduling.Batching.eligible_by_last
decl_138.label: Batching.eligible_by_last
decl_138.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} (B : Scheduling.Batching I L batches)
  (b : Fin batches), B.eligible b ≤ B.lastEligibility
decl_138.source:
theorem eligible_by_last (b : Fin batches) : B.eligible b ≤ B.lastEligibility :=
  le_sup (mem_univ b)

/-- Once all batches are eligible, each unfinished round completes at least
one new vertex. Consequently the construction assigns every finite vertex
an execution time after at most lastEligibility + vertices rounds. -/

decl_185.name: Scheduling.Batching.terminates
decl_185.label: Batching.terminates
decl_185.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} (B : Scheduling.Batching I L batches)
  [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → ∀ (v : Fin vertices), (B.run m B.completionRound).stamp v ≠ none
decl_185.source:
theorem terminates {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin vertices) :
    (B.run m B.completionRound).stamp v ≠ none := by
  intro hn
  have hfinal : v ∉ (B.run m B.completionRound).completed := by
    simp [ExecutionState.completed, hn]
  have hcount : ∀ i, i ≤ vertices → i ≤ (B.run m (B.lastEligibility + i)).completed.card := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero => intro _; omega
    | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      have hip := ih (by omega)
      have hv : (B.run m (B.lastEligibility + i)).stamp v = none := by
        by_contra hne
        have hmem : v ∈ (B.run m (B.lastEligibility + i)).completed :=
          mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hne⟩
        have hsub := B.run_completed_mono m (show B.lastEligibility + i ≤ B.completionRound by unfold completionRound; omega)
        exact hfinal (hsub hmem)
      have he : ∀ b, B.eligible b ≤ (B.run m (B.lastEligibility + i)).clock := by
        intro b
        have h₁ := B.eligible_by_last b
        have h₂ := B.run_clock_ge m (B.lastEligibility + i)
        omega
      have hp := B.advance_progress hm (B.run m (B.lastEligibility + i)) he ⟨v, hv⟩
      have hidx : B.lastEligibility + i + 1 = B.lastEligibility + (i + 1) := by omega
      change (B.run m (B.lastEligibility + i)).completed.card + 1 ≤
        (B.run m (B.lastEligibility + i + 1)).completed.card at hp
      rw [hidx] at hp
      omega
  have hc := hcount vertices le_rfl
  change vertices ≤ (B.run m B.completionRound).completed.card at hc
  have heq : (B.run m B.completionRound).completed = univ :=
    eq_of_subset_of_card_le (subset_univ _) (by simpa using hc)
  rw [heq] at hfinal
  exact hfinal (mem_univ _)

decl_143.name: Scheduling.Batching.execution
decl_143.label: Batching.execution
decl_143.statement:
{jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} →
  {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} →
    Scheduling.Batching I L batches → [DecidableRel I.edge] → ℕ → Scheduling.Assignment
decl_143.source:
def execution (m : ℕ) : Assignment (vertices := vertices) :=
  fun v => ((B.run m B.completionRound).stamp v).getD 0

decl_149.name: Scheduling.Batching.execution_stamp
decl_149.label: Batching.execution_stamp
decl_149.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} (B : Scheduling.Batching I L batches)
  [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ},
  0 < m → ∀ (v : Fin vertices), (B.run m B.completionRound).stamp v = some (B.execution m v)
decl_149.source:
theorem execution_stamp {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin vertices) :
    (B.run m B.completionRound).stamp v = some (B.execution m v) := by
  have hn := B.terminates hm v
  cases h : (B.run m B.completionRound).stamp v with
  | none => exact False.elim (hn h)
  | some t => simp [execution, h]

/-- The executable construction produces a valid scheduling assignment.
It does not take an offline comparison schedule as input. -/

decl_150.name: Scheduling.Batching.execution_valid
decl_150.label: Batching.execution_valid
decl_150.statement:
∀ {jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} {I : Scheduling.Instance jobs vertices} (B : Scheduling.Batching I L batches)
  [inst : DecidableRel I.edge] {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → I.Valid m (B.execution m)
decl_150.source:
theorem execution_valid {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : I.Valid m (B.execution m) := by
  have hs := B.run_safe m B.completionRound
  constructor
  · intro v
    have ht := (hs.stamps v (B.execution m v) (B.execution_stamp hm v)).1
    have hr := B.released_by_eligible (v := v) rfl
    omega
  · intro u v he
    have ht := (hs.stamps v (B.execution m v) (B.execution_stamp hm v)).2.2 u he
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hav⟩ := ht
    have heq := Option.some.inj (ha.symm.trans (B.execution_stamp hm u))
    omega
  · intro t
    apply (card_le_card (t := univ.filter (fun v =>
      (B.run m B.completionRound).stamp v = some t)) ?_).trans (hs.capacity t)
    intro v hv
    have he := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by rw [B.execution_stamp hm v, he]⟩

end Scheduling.Batching
